name: attnIOSafeInv
text:
def attnIOSafeInv (K KScale V Out : RegionName) (s0 : BlockState)
    (stride_qz stride_qh H HEAD_DIM BLOCK_M BLOCK_N BLOCK_DMODEL numKVBlocks : Nat)
    (c : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  c % BLOCK_N = 0 ∧ c ≤ BLOCK_N * numKVBlocks ∧
  s.regs .nat [BLOCK_M] "offs_m"
      = some (Tile.vec (fun r : Fin BLOCK_M => s0.pids 0 * BLOCK_M + r.val)) ∧
  s.regs .nat [BLOCK_N] "offs_n" = some (Tile.vec (fun j : Fin BLOCK_N => j.val)) ∧
  (∃ mT : Tile .real [BLOCK_M], s.regs .real [BLOCK_M] "m_i" = some mT) ∧
  (∃ lT : Tile .real [BLOCK_M], s.regs .real [BLOCK_M] "l_i" = some lT) ∧
  (∃ aT : Tile .real [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_DMODEL],
    s.regs .real [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_DMODEL] "acc" = some aT) ∧
  (∃ qT : Tile .real [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_DMODEL],
    s.regs .real [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_DMODEL] "q" = some qT) ∧
  (∃ qsv : ℝ, s.regs .real [] "q_scale" = some (Tile.scalar (some qsv))) ∧
  s.regs .ptr [BLOCK_DMODEL, BLOCK_N] "K_ptrs"
      = some (attnIOkPtrs s0 K H stride_qz stride_qh HEAD_DIM BLOCK_N BLOCK_DMODEL (c / BLOCK_N)) ∧
  s.regs .ptr [] "K_scale_ptr"
      = some (attnIOsclPtr KScale
          (s0.pids 1 * ((BLOCK_N * numKVBlocks + BLOCK_N - 1) / BLOCK_N) + c / BLOCK_N)) ∧
  s.regs .ptr [BLOCK_N, BLOCK_DMODEL] "V_ptrs"
      = some (attnIOvPtrs s0 V H stride_qz stride_qh HEAD_DIM BLOCK_N BLOCK_DMODEL (c / BLOCK_N)) ∧
  s.regs .ptr [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_DMODEL] "O_block_ptr"
      = some (attnIOrowPtrs s0 Out H stride_qz stride_qh HEAD_DIM BLOCK_M BLOCK_DMODEL)

name: aft1InvG
text:
noncomputable def aft1InvG (Q K V H O : RegionName) (s_qh : Nat) (scale : ℝ) (BT BD : Nat)
    (s : BlockState) (n : Nat) (st : BlockState) : Prop :=
  st.pids = s.pids
  ∧ st.regs .nat [] "i_bh" = some (Tile.scalar (s.pids 0))
  ∧ st.regs .real [BD, BD] "b_h" = some (aft1BhTileG s K V s_qh BT BD n)
  ∧ (∀ off, st.readMem Q off = s.readMem Q off)
  ∧ (∀ off, st.readMem K off = s.readMem K off)
  ∧ (∀ off, st.readMem V off = s.readMem V off)
  ∧ (∀ off, st.readMem H off = s.readMem H off)
  ∧ (∀ j, j < n → ∀ (t : Fin BT) (d : Fin BD),
      st.readMem O (s.pids 0 * s_qh + (j * BT + t.val) * BD + d.val)
        = aft1OutG s Q K V s_qh scale BT BD j t d)

/-- `aft1BhTileG` depends only on `K`/`V` reads and `pids 0`. -/

name: Invariant
text:
structure Invariant (Q K V H O : RegionName) (s_qh s_hh s_ht : Nat)
    (scale : ℝ) (BT BD : Nat) (STORE : Bool) (s : BlockState) (n : Nat)
    (st : BlockState) : Prop where
  pids : st.pids = s.pids
  head : st.regs .nat [] "i_bh" = some (Tile.scalar (s.pids 0))
  carry : st.regs .real [BD, BD] "b_h" = some (aft1BhTileG s K V s_qh BT BD n)
  query : ∀ off, st.readMem Q off = s.readMem Q off
  keys : ∀ off, st.readMem K off = s.readMem K off
  values : ∀ off, st.readMem V off = s.readMem V off
  outputCells : ∀ c, c < n → ∀ (i : Fin BT) (j : Fin BD),
    st.mem O (s.pids 0 * s_qh + (c * BT + i.val) * BD + j.val) =
      MemCell.real (aft1OutG s Q K V s_qh scale BT BD c i j)
  snapshotCells : STORE = Bool.true → ∀ c, c < n → ∀ (i j : Fin BD),
    st.mem H (s.pids 0 * s_hh + (c * BD + i.val) * s_ht + j.val) =
      MemCell.real (aft1RecStateG s K V s_qh BT BD c i j)
  frame : ∀ rg off,
    (rg ≠ O ∨ ∀ c, c < n → ∀ (i : Fin BT) (j : Fin BD),
      off ≠ s.pids 0 * s_qh + (c * BT + i.val) * BD + j.val) →
    (STORE = Bool.false ∨ rg ≠ H ∨ ∀ c, c < n → ∀ (i j : Fin BD),
      off ≠ s.pids 0 * s_hh + (c * BD + i.val) * s_ht + j.val) →
    st.mem rg off = s.mem rg off

name: completed
text:
private def completed (STORE : Bool) (t : State ℝ) : Prop :=
  (t.mem "o" 0).read .real = 0 ∧
  (t.mem "o" 1).read .real = 0 ∧
  (t.mem "h" 0).read .real = (if STORE then 0 else 17) ∧
  (t.mem "h" 1).read .real = (if STORE then 0 else 17) ∧
  (t.mem "q" 0).read .real = 17 ∧
  (t.mem "o" 2).read .real = 17

aft3KeysUptoG
text:
noncomputable def aft3KeysUptoG {BM ND NC : Nat}
    (qT : TileIndex [BM, ND] → ℝ) (kT vT : TileIndex [NC, ND] → ℝ)
    (keyScale : Fin NC → ℝ) (keep : Fin BM → Fin NC → Prop)
    [∀ i j, Decidable (keep i j)] (hi : Nat) (i : Fin BM) (d : Fin ND) :
    List (ℝ × ℝ) :=
  (List.finRange NC).filterMap (fun j : Fin NC =>
    if j.val < hi ∧ keep i j then
      some (keyScale j * Finset.univ.sum (fun e : Fin ND =>
              qT (i, e, PUnit.unit) * kT (j, e, PUnit.unit)),
            vT (j, d, PUnit.unit))
    else none)

/-- General ⊥-seeded running max over the windowed prefix. -/

name: aft3RunningMaxG
text:
noncomputable def aft3RunningMaxG {BM ND NC : Nat}
    (qT : TileIndex [BM, ND] → ℝ) (kT vT : TileIndex [NC, ND] → ℝ)
    (keyScale : Fin NC → ℝ) (keep : Fin BM → Fin NC → Prop)
    [∀ i j, Decidable (keep i j)] (hi : Nat) (i : Fin BM) (d : Fin ND) :
    WithBot ℝ :=
  ((aft3KeysUptoG qT kT vT keyScale keep hi i d).map
    (fun p => ((p.1 : ℝ) : WithBot ℝ))).foldr (· ⊔ ·) ⊥

/-- General ⊥-seeded running `(max, denom, acc)` after the windowed prefix `[0, hi)`. -/

name: aft3StateBotG
text:
noncomputable def aft3StateBotG {BM ND NC : Nat}
    (qT : TileIndex [BM, ND] → ℝ) (kT vT : TileIndex [NC, ND] → ℝ)
    (keyScale : Fin NC → ℝ) (keep : Fin BM → Fin NC → Prop)
    [∀ i j, Decidable (keep i j)] (hi : Nat) (i : Fin BM) (d : Fin ND) :
    WithBot ℝ × ℝ × ℝ :=
  (aft3KeysUptoG qT kT vT keyScale keep hi i d).foldl aft3OsStepBot (⊥, 0, 0)

/-- General block `c` per-row key list: kept keys with `c·BN ≤ j < (c+1)·BN`. -/

name: aft3BlockG
text:
noncomputable def aft3BlockG {BM ND NC : Nat}
    (qT : TileIndex [BM, ND] → ℝ) (kT vT : TileIndex [NC, ND] → ℝ)
    (keyScale : Fin NC → ℝ) (keep : Fin BM → Fin NC → Prop)
    [∀ i j, Decidable (keep i j)] (BN c : Nat) (i : Fin BM) (d : Fin ND) :
    List (ℝ × ℝ) :=
  (List.finRange NC).filterMap (fun j : Fin NC =>
    if c * BN ≤ j.val ∧ j.val < (c + 1) * BN ∧ keep i j then
      some (keyScale j * Finset.univ.sum (fun e : Fin ND =>
              qT (i, e, PUnit.unit) * kT (j, e, PUnit.unit)),
            vT (j, d, PUnit.unit))
    else none)

/-- General resume-**SEEDED** running `(max, denom, acc)` after the windowed prefix
`[0, hi)`: the online-softmax `aft3OsStepBot` fold from an arbitrary initial state
`init i d`, rather than the `(⊥, 0, 0)` of `aft3StateBotG`. This is the case-4
(`INIT=False` cross-launch resume) analogue, where `init` is the prior
`(m_i, l_i, acc)` loaded from the input `M`/`L`/`Out` buffers. -/

name: aft3StateSeededG
text:
noncomputable def aft3StateSeededG {BM ND NC : Nat}
    (qT : TileIndex [BM, ND] → ℝ) (kT vT : TileIndex [NC, ND] → ℝ)
    (keyScale : Fin NC → ℝ) (keep : Fin BM → Fin NC → Prop)
    [∀ i j, Decidable (keep i j)]
    (init : Fin BM → Fin ND → WithBot ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)
    (hi : Nat) (i : Fin BM) (d : Fin ND) : WithBot ℝ × ℝ × ℝ :=
  (aft3KeysUptoG qT kT vT keyScale keep hi i d).foldl aft3OsStepBot (init i d)

/-- Per-row running-stat entry `R[off_hz·ROUND_CTX + start_m·BM + i]` — the
shared row layout of the `M` (running max) and `L` (running denom) buffers. -/

name: aft3StateBot1G
text:
noncomputable def aft3StateBot1G {BM ND NC : Nat}
    (qT : TileIndex [BM, ND] → ℝ) (kT vT : TileIndex [NC, ND] → ℝ)
    (keyScale : Fin NC → ℝ) (keep : Fin BM → Fin NC → Prop)
    [∀ i j, Decidable (keep i j)] (hi : Nat) (i : Fin BM) (d : Fin ND) :
    WithBot ℝ × ℝ × ℝ :=
  (aft3KeysUptoG qT kT vT keyScale keep hi i d).foldl aft3OsStepBot (⊥, 1, 0)

name: aft3StateBotKG
text:
noncomputable def aft3StateBotKG {BM ND NC : Nat}
    (qT : TileIndex [BM, ND] → ℝ) (kT vT : TileIndex [NC, ND] → ℝ)
    (keyScale : Fin NC → ℝ) (keep : Fin BM → Fin NC → Prop)
    [∀ i j, Decidable (keep i j)] (hi : Nat) (i : Fin BM) (d : Fin ND) :
    WithBot ℝ × ℝ × ℝ :=
  if hi = 0 then (⊥, 1, 0)
  else aft3StateBotG qT kT vT keyScale keep hi i d

name: attnInvariantKG
text:
noncomputable def attnInvariantKG
    (Q K V M Out L : RegionName) (s0 : BlockState)
    (base BM ND NC BN sqm sqk skn skk svk svn som son ROUND_CTX : Nat) (hND : 0 < ND) (sc : ℝ)
    (keep : Fin BM → Fin NC → Prop) [∀ i j, Decidable (keep i j)]
    (i : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  let qT := qTile3G s0 Q base BM ND sqm sqk
  let kT := kTile3G s0 K base NC ND skn skk
  let vT := vTile3G s0 V base NC ND svk svn
  s.pids = s0.pids ∧ i % BN = 0 ∧ i ≤ NC ∧
  (s.regs .real [BM] "m_i" = some ⟨fun r : TileIndex [BM] =>
      aft3RunningMaxG qT kT vT (keyScale3G sc NC) keep i r.1 ⟨0, hND⟩⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .real [BM] "l_i" = some ⟨fun r : TileIndex [BM] =>
      ((aft3StateBotKG qT kT vT (keyScale3G sc NC) keep i r.1 ⟨0, hND⟩).2.1 : ℝ)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .real [BM, ND] "acc" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BM, ND] =>
      ((aft3StateBotKG qT kT vT (keyScale3G sc NC) keep i idx.1 idx.2.1).2.2 : ℝ)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .real [BM, ND] "q" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BM, ND] => some (qT idx)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .real [] "qk_scale" = some (Tile.scalar (some sc))) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [] "start_m" = some (Tile.scalar (s0.pids 0))) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [] "off_hz" = some (Tile.scalar (s0.pids 1))) ∧
  (s.regs .blockPtr [ND, BN] "K_block_ptr" = some
    (⟨fun _ : TileIndex [ND, BN] =>
      { region := K, baseOffset := base, parentShape := [ND, NC], blockShape := [ND, BN],
        strides := [skk, skn], offsets := [0, i] }⟩)) ∧
  (s.regs .blockPtr [BN, ND] "V_block_ptr" = some
    (⟨fun _ : TileIndex [BN, ND] =>
      { region := V, baseOffset := base, parentShape := [NC, ND], blockShape := [BN, ND],
        strides := [svk, svn], offsets := [i, 0] }⟩)) ∧
  (s.regs .ptr [BM] "m_ptrs" = some
    (Tile.ptrAdd Broadcast.scalarL (Tile.scalar (M.cast, (0 : Nat)))
      (Tile.bop NumericDType.nat.add Broadcast.scalarL (Tile.scalar (s0.pids 1 * ROUND_CTX))
        (Tile.vec (fun r : Fin BM => s0.pids 0 * BM + r.val))))) ∧
  (s.regs .ptr [BM] "l_ptrs" = some
    (Tile.ptrAdd Broadcast.scalarL (Tile.scalar (L.cast, (0 : Nat)))
      (Tile.bop NumericDType.nat.add Broadcast.scalarL (Tile.scalar (s0.pids 1 * ROUND_CTX))
        (Tile.vec (fun r : Fin BM => s0.pids 0 * BM + r.val))))) ∧
  (s.regs .blockPtr [BM, ND] "O_block_ptr" = some
    (⟨fun _ : TileIndex [BM, ND] =>
      { region := Out, baseOffset := base, parentShape := [ROUND_CTX, ND], blockShape := [BM, ND],
        strides := [som, son], offsets := [s0.pids 0 * BM, 0] }⟩)) ∧
  (∀ rg o, s.undef rg o = 0) ∧ (s.mem = s0.mem)

/-- The resume-seeded fold at the empty window `hi = 0` is just the seed. -/

name: attnInvariantSeededG
text:
noncomputable def attnInvariantSeededG
    (Q K V M Out L : RegionName) (s0 : BlockState)
    (base BM ND NC BN sqm sqk skn skk svk svn som son ROUND_CTX : Nat) (hND : 0 < ND) (sc : ℝ)
    (keep : Fin BM → Fin NC → Prop) [∀ i j, Decidable (keep i j)]
    (seed : Fin BM → Fin ND → WithBot ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)
    (i : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  let qT := qTile3G s0 Q base BM ND sqm sqk
  let kT := kTile3G s0 K base NC ND skn skk
  let vT := vTile3G s0 V base NC ND svk svn
  s.pids = s0.pids ∧ i % BN = 0 ∧ i ≤ NC ∧
  (s.regs .real [BM] "m_i" = some ⟨fun r : TileIndex [BM] =>
      (aft3StateSeededG qT kT vT (keyScale3G sc NC) keep seed i r.1 ⟨0, hND⟩).1⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .real [BM] "l_i" = some ⟨fun r : TileIndex [BM] =>
      ((aft3StateSeededG qT kT vT (keyScale3G sc NC) keep seed i r.1 ⟨0, hND⟩).2.1 : ℝ)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .real [BM, ND] "acc" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BM, ND] =>
      ((aft3StateSeededG qT kT vT (keyScale3G sc NC) keep seed i idx.1 idx.2.1).2.2 : ℝ)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .real [BM, ND] "q" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BM, ND] => some (qT idx)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .real [] "qk_scale" = some (Tile.scalar (some sc))) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [] "start_m" = some (Tile.scalar (s0.pids 0))) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [] "off_hz" = some (Tile.scalar (s0.pids 1))) ∧
  (s.regs .blockPtr [ND, BN] "K_block_ptr" = some
    (⟨fun _ : TileIndex [ND, BN] =>
      { region := K, baseOffset := base, parentShape := [ND, NC], blockShape := [ND, BN],
        strides := [skk, skn], offsets := [0, i] }⟩)) ∧
  (s.regs .blockPtr [BN, ND] "V_block_ptr" = some
    (⟨fun _ : TileIndex [BN, ND] =>
      { region := V, baseOffset := base, parentShape := [NC, ND], blockShape := [BN, ND],
        strides := [svk, svn], offsets := [i, 0] }⟩)) ∧
  (s.regs .ptr [BM] "m_ptrs" = some
    (Tile.ptrAdd Broadcast.scalarL (Tile.scalar (M.cast, (0 : Nat)))
      (Tile.bop NumericDType.nat.add Broadcast.scalarL (Tile.scalar (s0.pids 1 * ROUND_CTX))
        (Tile.vec (fun r : Fin BM => s0.pids 0 * BM + r.val))))) ∧
  (s.regs .ptr [BM] "l_ptrs" = some
    (Tile.ptrAdd Broadcast.scalarL (Tile.scalar (L.cast, (0 : Nat)))
      (Tile.bop NumericDType.nat.add Broadcast.scalarL (Tile.scalar (s0.pids 1 * ROUND_CTX))
        (Tile.vec (fun r : Fin BM => s0.pids 0 * BM + r.val))))) ∧
  (s.regs .blockPtr [BM, ND] "O_block_ptr" = some
    (⟨fun _ : TileIndex [BM, ND] =>
      { region := Out, baseOffset := base, parentShape := [ROUND_CTX, ND], blockShape := [BM, ND],
        strides := [som, son], offsets := [s0.pids 0 * BM, 0] }⟩)) ∧
  (∀ rg o, s.undef rg o = 0) ∧ (s.mem = s0.mem)

/-- **General no-⊥-carry loop invariant (case 3, `aft3StateBot1G`).** Identical to
`attnInvariantKG` but with the `l_i`/`acc` carrying `aft3StateBot1G` (seed-1) — the
form the case-3 streaming loop maintains (no fully-masked rows). -/

name: attnInvariantG
text:
noncomputable def attnInvariantG
    (Q K V M Out L : RegionName) (s0 : BlockState)
    (base BM ND NC BN sqm sqk skn skk svk svn som son ROUND_CTX : Nat) (hND : 0 < ND) (sc : ℝ)
    (keep : Fin BM → Fin NC → Prop) [∀ i j, Decidable (keep i j)]
    (i : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  let qT := qTile3G s0 Q base BM ND sqm sqk
  let kT := kTile3G s0 K base NC ND skn skk
  let vT := vTile3G s0 V base NC ND svk svn
  s.pids = s0.pids ∧ i % BN = 0 ∧ i ≤ NC ∧
  (s.regs .real [BM] "m_i" = some ⟨fun r : TileIndex [BM] =>
      aft3RunningMaxG qT kT vT (keyScale3G sc NC) keep i r.1 ⟨0, hND⟩⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .real [BM] "l_i" = some ⟨fun r : TileIndex [BM] =>
      ((aft3StateBot1G qT kT vT (keyScale3G sc NC) keep i r.1 ⟨0, hND⟩).2.1 : ℝ)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .real [BM, ND] "acc" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BM, ND] =>
      ((aft3StateBot1G qT kT vT (keyScale3G sc NC) keep i idx.1 idx.2.1).2.2 : ℝ)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .real [BM, ND] "q" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BM, ND] => some (qT idx)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .real [] "qk_scale" = some (Tile.scalar (some sc))) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [] "start_m" = some (Tile.scalar (s0.pids 0))) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [] "off_hz" = some (Tile.scalar (s0.pids 1))) ∧
  (s.regs .blockPtr [ND, BN] "K_block_ptr" = some
    (⟨fun _ : TileIndex [ND, BN] =>
      { region := K, baseOffset := base, parentShape := [ND, NC], blockShape := [ND, BN],
        strides := [skk, skn], offsets := [0, i] }⟩)) ∧
  (s.regs .blockPtr [BN, ND] "V_block_ptr" = some
    (⟨fun _ : TileIndex [BN, ND] =>
      { region := V, baseOffset := base, parentShape := [NC, ND], blockShape := [BN, ND],
        strides := [svk, svn], offsets := [i, 0] }⟩)) ∧
  (s.regs .ptr [BM] "m_ptrs" = some
    (Tile.ptrAdd Broadcast.scalarL (Tile.scalar (M.cast, (0 : Nat)))
      (Tile.bop NumericDType.nat.add Broadcast.scalarL (Tile.scalar (s0.pids 1 * ROUND_CTX))
        (Tile.vec (fun r : Fin BM => s0.pids 0 * BM + r.val))))) ∧
  (s.regs .ptr [BM] "l_ptrs" = some
    (Tile.ptrAdd Broadcast.scalarL (Tile.scalar (L.cast, (0 : Nat)))
      (Tile.bop NumericDType.nat.add Broadcast.scalarL (Tile.scalar (s0.pids 1 * ROUND_CTX))
        (Tile.vec (fun r : Fin BM => s0.pids 0 * BM + r.val))))) ∧
  (s.regs .blockPtr [BM, ND] "O_block_ptr" = some
    (⟨fun _ : TileIndex [BM, ND] =>
      { region := Out, baseOffset := base, parentShape := [ROUND_CTX, ND], blockShape := [BM, ND],
        strides := [som, son], offsets := [s0.pids 0 * BM, 0] }⟩)) ∧
  (∀ rg o, s.undef rg o = 0) ∧ (s.mem = s0.mem)

/-- The base case: `attnInvariantG … 0` (which carries `aft3StateBot1G`) yields
`attnInvariantKG … 0` (which carries `aft3StateBotKG`), since both equal the seed
`(⊥,1,0)` at window 0. -/

name: attentionFwdTriton3KMSpecG
text:
noncomputable def attentionFwdTriton3KMSpecG
    (s : BlockState) (Q K V : RegionName)
    (base BM ND NC sqm sqk skn skk svk svn : Nat) (sc : ℝ)
    (keep : Fin BM → Fin NC → Prop) [∀ i j, Decidable (keep i j)] (i : Fin BM) (hND : 0 < ND) : ℝ :=
  (WithBot.realAdd
      (aft3RunningMaxG (qTile3G s Q base BM ND sqm sqk) (kTile3G s K base NC ND skn skk)
        (vTile3G s V base NC ND svk svn) (keyScale3G sc NC) keep NC i ⟨0, hND⟩)
      (WithBot.realLog2 (((aft3StateBotKG (qTile3G s Q base BM ND sqm sqk) (kTile3G s K base NC ND skn skk)
        (vTile3G s V base NC ND svk svn) (keyScale3G sc NC) keep NC i ⟨0, hND⟩).2.1 : ℝ) : WithBot ℝ))).unbotD 0

/-- General genuine `M`-row spec (case 3): `m_i + log2 l_i` finalize. -/

name: aft3SafeInv
text:
private def aft3SafeInv (K V M Out L : RegionName) (s0 : BlockState)
    (base BM ND NC BN skk skn svk svn som son ROUND_CTX : Nat)
    (c : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  c % BN = 0 ∧ c ≤ NC ∧
  s.regs .nat [] "start_m" = some (Tile.scalar (s0.pids 0)) ∧
  s.regs .nat [] "off_hz" = some (Tile.scalar (s0.pids 1)) ∧
  (∃ qT : Tile .real [BM, ND], s.regs .real [BM, ND] "q" = some qT) ∧
  (∃ sc : ℝ, s.regs .real [] "qk_scale" = some (Tile.scalar (some sc))) ∧
  (∃ mT : Tile .real [BM], s.regs .real [BM] "m_i" = some mT) ∧
  (∃ lT : Tile .real [BM], s.regs .real [BM] "l_i" = some lT) ∧
  (∃ aT : Tile .real [BM, ND], s.regs .real [BM, ND] "acc" = some aT) ∧
  s.regs .blockPtr [ND, BN] "K_block_ptr" = some
    (⟨fun _ : TileIndex [ND, BN] =>
      { region := K, baseOffset := base, parentShape := [ND, NC], blockShape := [ND, BN],
        strides := [skk, skn], offsets := [0, c] }⟩) ∧
  s.regs .blockPtr [BN, ND] "V_block_ptr" = some
    (⟨fun _ : TileIndex [BN, ND] =>
      { region := V, baseOffset := base, parentShape := [NC, ND], blockShape := [BN, ND],
        strides := [svk, svn], offsets := [c, 0] }⟩) ∧
  s.regs .ptr [BM] "m_ptrs" = some
    (Tile.ptrAdd Broadcast.scalarL (Tile.scalar (M.cast, (0 : Nat)))
      (Tile.bop NumericDType.nat.add Broadcast.scalarL (Tile.scalar (s0.pids 1 * ROUND_CTX))
        (Tile.vec (fun r : Fin BM => s0.pids 0 * BM + r.val)))) ∧
  s.regs .ptr [BM] "l_ptrs" = some
    (Tile.ptrAdd Broadcast.scalarL (Tile.scalar (L.cast, (0 : Nat)))
      (Tile.bop NumericDType.nat.add Broadcast.scalarL (Tile.scalar (s0.pids 1 * ROUND_CTX))
        (Tile.vec (fun r : Fin BM => s0.pids 0 * BM + r.val)))) ∧
  s.regs .blockPtr [BM, ND] "O_block_ptr" = some
    (⟨fun _ : TileIndex [BM, ND] =>
      { region := Out, baseOffset := base, parentShape := [ROUND_CTX, ND], blockShape := [BM, ND],
        strides := [som, son], offsets := [s0.pids 0 * BM, 0] }⟩)

set_option maxHeartbeats 4000000 in
set_option maxRecDepth 8000 in
/-- **Weak preLoop**: from an **arbitrary** launch state (no clean-`undef`
hypothesis) the case-3 preLoop steps to a state satisfying `aft3SafeInv … 0`.
Value conclusions of `aft3PreLoop_evalG` are dropped; only the shape half is
kept. -/

name: BlockBounds
text:
def BlockBounds {shape : TileShape} (bounds : RegionBounds) (ptrs : Tile .blockPtr shape)
    (checked : List Nat) : Prop := ∀ i,
  (ptrs.data i).inBounds (TileShape.indexToList shape i) checked = Bool.true →
    (ptrs.data i).address (TileShape.indexToList shape i) < bounds (ptrs.data i).region

name: Windows
text:
structure Windows (BM BD finish : Nat) (p : Parameters) (s : BlockState) (bounds : RegionBounds) : Prop where
  query : ∀ (row : Fin BM) (lane : Fin BD),
    (p.evenM ≠ 0 ∨ s.pids 0 * BM + row.val < p.layout.queryContext) →
    queryAddress BM p s row.val lane.val < bounds p.layout.Q
  keys : ∀ (key : Fin p.layout.kvContext) (lane : Fin BD), keyAddress p s key.val lane.val < bounds p.layout.K
  values : ∀ (key : Fin p.layout.kvContext) (lane : Fin BD), valueAddress p s key.val lane.val < bounds p.layout.V
  center : ∀ i, RealExecution.rowAddress BM p s i < bounds p.layout.M
  denominator : p.init = 0 ∨ finish = 0 → ∀ i, RealExecution.rowAddress BM p s i < bounds p.layout.L
  output : ∀ i, RealExecution.outputAddress BM BD p s i < bounds p.layout.Out

name: Registers
text:
structure Registers {BM BD : Nat} (c : Carry BM BD) (s : BlockState) : Prop where
  center : s.regs .real [BM] "m_i" = some (centerTile c)
  denominator : s.regs .real [BM] "l_i" = some (denominatorTile c)
  numerator : s.regs .real [BM, BD] "acc" = some (finite c.numerator)

name: OutputLayout
text:
structure OutputLayout (BM BD : Nat) (p : Parameters) (s : BlockState) : Prop where
  injective : Function.Injective (outputAddress BM BD p s)
  center_output : p.layout.M ≠ p.layout.Out
  denominator_center : p.layout.L ≠ p.layout.M
  denominator_output : p.layout.L ≠ p.layout.Out

name: Results
text:
structure Results (BM BN BD finish : Nat) (p : Parameters) (initial current : BlockState) : Prop where
  pids : current.pids = initial.pids
  undef : current.undef = initial.undef
  center : ∀ i, current.readMem p.layout.M (rowAddress BM p initial i) =
    RealEpilogue.centerValue finish (finalCarry BM BN BD p initial) i.1
  output : ∀ i, current.readMem p.layout.Out (outputAddress BM BD p initial i) =
    RealEpilogue.outputValue finish (finalCarry BM BN BD p initial) i
  denominator : finish = 0 → ∀ i, current.readMem p.layout.L (rowAddress BM p initial i) =
    (finalCarry BM BN BD p initial).denominator i.1
  finished_L : finish ≠ 0 → ∀ o, current.mem p.layout.L o = initial.mem p.layout.L o
  frame : ∀ r o,
    (r ≠ p.layout.M ∨ ∀ i, o ≠ rowAddress BM p initial i) →
    (finish ≠ 0 ∨ r ≠ p.layout.L ∨ ∀ i, o ≠ rowAddress BM p initial i) →
    (r ≠ p.layout.Out ∨ ∀ i, o ≠ outputAddress BM BD p initial i) →
    current.mem r o = initial.mem r o

name: CoordinateRegisters
text:
structure CoordinateRegisters (c : Coordinates) (s : BlockState) : Prop where
  startM : s.regs .nat [] "start_m" = some (Tile.scalar c.startM)
  headBatch : s.regs .nat [] "off_hz" = some (Tile.scalar c.headBatch)
  batch : s.regs .nat [] "off_z" = some (Tile.scalar c.batch)
  head : s.regs .nat [] "off_h" = some (Tile.scalar c.head)
  kvHead : s.regs .nat [] "off_hkv" = some (Tile.scalar c.kvHead)

name: OffsetRegisters
text:
structure OffsetRegisters (b : Bases) (s : BlockState) : Prop where
  q : s.regs .nat [] "q_offset" = some (Tile.scalar b.q)
  k : s.regs .nat [] "k_offset" = some (Tile.scalar b.k)
  v : s.regs .nat [] "v_offset" = some (Tile.scalar b.v)
  out : s.regs .nat [] "o_offset" = some (Tile.scalar b.out)

name: IO.inputMask
text:
def IO.inputMask {BM BD NK : Nat} (io : IO BM BD NK) :
    (ch : Fin 6) → Nat → Nat → Nat → TileIndex (inputShape BM BD NK ch) → Prop
  | 0 => io.queryMask
  | 1 => fun _ _ _ _ => True
  | 2 => fun _ _ _ _ => True
  | 3 => fun _ _ _ _ => io.readCarry
  | 4 => fun _ _ _ _ => io.readCarry
  | 5 => fun _ _ _ _ => io.readCarry

name: IO.outputMask
text:
def IO.outputMask {BM BD NK : Nat} (io : IO BM BD NK) : Fin 3 → Prop
  | 0 => True
  | 1 => io.writeDenominator
  | 2 => True

/-- The numbered channels are internal adapters for the shared IO core.
All windows are independent of input values, so pinning is non-circular. -/

name: IO.Implements
text:
def IO.Implements {BM BD NK : Nat} (io : IO BM BD NK)
    (f : Nat → Nat → RealInputs.Inputs BM BD NK → Outputs BM BD) : Prop :=
  io.toU.Implements (fun p₀ p₁ vals ch j =>
    (f p₀ p₁ (io.inputs vals)).channel ch ((TileShape.allIndices _).get j))

scoped notation:25 io " ⊨ " f => IO.Implements io f

name: Pins
text:
structure Pins {BM BD NK : Nat} (io : IO BM BD NK) (s : BlockState)
    (xs : RealInputs.Inputs BM BD NK) : Prop where
  query : ∀ r d, io.queryMask (s.pids 0) (s.pids 1) (s.pids 2) (r, d, PUnit.unit) →
    s.readMem io.Q (io.queryWindow (s.pids 0) (s.pids 1) (s.pids 2) (r, d, PUnit.unit)) = xs.query r d
  key : ∀ k d, s.readMem io.K (io.keyWindow (s.pids 0) (s.pids 1) (s.pids 2) (k, d, PUnit.unit)) = xs.key k d
  value : ∀ k d, s.readMem io.V (io.valueWindow (s.pids 0) (s.pids 1) (s.pids 2) (k, d, PUnit.unit)) = xs.value k d
  center : io.readCarry → ∀ r, s.readMem io.M (io.centerWindow (s.pids 0) (s.pids 1) (s.pids 2) (r, PUnit.unit)) = xs.center r
  denominator : io.readCarry → ∀ r,
    s.readMem io.L (io.denominatorWindow (s.pids 0) (s.pids 1) (s.pids 2) (r, PUnit.unit)) = xs.denominator r
  output : io.readCarry → ∀ r d,
    s.readMem io.Out (io.outputWindow (s.pids 0) (s.pids 1) (s.pids 2) (r, d, PUnit.unit)) = xs.output r d

name: Bounds
text:
structure Bounds {BM BD NK : Nat} (io : IO BM BD NK) (s : BlockState) (bounds : RegionBounds) : Prop where
  query : ∀ i, io.queryMask (s.pids 0) (s.pids 1) (s.pids 2) i →
    io.queryWindow (s.pids 0) (s.pids 1) (s.pids 2) i < bounds io.Q
  key : ∀ i, io.keyWindow (s.pids 0) (s.pids 1) (s.pids 2) i < bounds io.K
  value : ∀ i, io.valueWindow (s.pids 0) (s.pids 1) (s.pids 2) i < bounds io.V
  center : ∀ i, io.centerWindow (s.pids 0) (s.pids 1) (s.pids 2) i < bounds io.M
  denominator : io.readCarry ∨ io.writeDenominator → ∀ i,
    io.denominatorWindow (s.pids 0) (s.pids 1) (s.pids 2) i < bounds io.L
  output : ∀ i, io.outputWindow (s.pids 0) (s.pids 1) (s.pids 2) i < bounds io.Out

name: Results
text:
structure Results {BM BD NK : Nat} (io : IO BM BD NK) (initial current : BlockState)
    (ys : Outputs BM BD) : Prop where
  center : ∀ i, current.readMem io.M (io.centerWindow (initial.pids 0) (initial.pids 1) (initial.pids 2) i) = ys.center i.1
  denominator : io.writeDenominator → ∀ i,
    current.readMem io.L (io.denominatorWindow (initial.pids 0) (initial.pids 1) (initial.pids 2) i) = ys.denominator i.1
  output : ∀ i, current.readMem io.Out (io.outputWindow (initial.pids 0) (initial.pids 1) (initial.pids 2) i) = ys.output i
  frame : ∀ r a,
    (r ≠ io.M ∨ ∀ i, a ≠ io.centerWindow (initial.pids 0) (initial.pids 1) (initial.pids 2) i) →
    (¬io.writeDenominator ∨ r ≠ io.L ∨ ∀ i, a ≠ io.denominatorWindow (initial.pids 0) (initial.pids 1) (initial.pids 2) i) →
    (r ≠ io.Out ∨ ∀ i, a ≠ io.outputWindow (initial.pids 0) (initial.pids 1) (initial.pids 2) i) →
    current.mem r a = initial.mem r a

name: Pins
text:
structure Pins (BM BD : Nat) (p : Parameters) (s : BlockState)
    (xs : Inputs BM BD p.layout.kvContext) : Prop where
  query : ∀ row lane, (p.evenM ≠ 0 ∨ s.pids 0 * BM + row.val < p.layout.queryContext) →
    s.readMem p.layout.Q (RealAddressBounds.queryAddress BM p s row.val lane.val) = xs.query row lane
  key : ∀ key lane,
    s.readMem p.layout.K (RealAddressBounds.keyAddress p s key.val lane.val) = xs.key key lane
  value : ∀ key lane,
    s.readMem p.layout.V (RealAddressBounds.valueAddress p s key.val lane.val) = xs.value key lane
  center : p.init = 0 → ∀ row,
    s.readMem p.layout.M (RealExecution.rowAddress BM p s (row, PUnit.unit)) = xs.center row
  denominator : p.init = 0 → ∀ row,
    s.readMem p.layout.L (RealExecution.rowAddress BM p s (row, PUnit.unit)) = xs.denominator row
  output : p.init = 0 → ∀ row lane,
    s.readMem p.layout.Out (RealExecution.outputAddress BM BD p s (row, lane, PUnit.unit)) = xs.output row lane

/-- Every initial state supplies these six views, including in-place carry.
The pinning contract therefore imposes no circular condition on final outputs. -/

name: Registers
text:
structure Registers {BM BN BD : Nat} (p : Parameters BM BN BD) (c : Carry BM BD)
    (i : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop where
  q : s.regs .real [BM, BD] "q" = some (finite p.q)
  scale : s.regs .real [] "qk_scale" = some (Tile.scalar (some p.scale))
  startM : s.regs .nat [] "start_m" = some (Tile.scalar p.startM)
  center : s.regs .real [BM] "m_i" = some (⟨fun j => c.center j.1⟩ : Tile .real [BM])
  denominator : s.regs .real [BM] "l_i" = some (finite (fun j : TileIndex [BM] => c.denominator j.1))
  numerator : s.regs .real [BM, BD] "acc" = some (finite c.numerator)
  key : s.regs .blockPtr [BD, BN] "K_block_ptr" = some (keyPointer p i)
  value : s.regs .blockPtr [BN, BD] "V_block_ptr" = some (valuePointer p i)

name: FullBlocks
text:
def FullBlocks {BM BN BD : Nat} (p : Parameters BM BN BD) : Prop :=
  p.even ≠ 0 → ∀ i < count p, cursor p i + BN ≤ p.context

/-- The Python launch heuristic sets IS_EVEN_N from context % BLOCK_N = 0.
Together with the source's aligned/clipped bounds, this suffices for every
unchecked iteration; callers need not assume a condition on executed values. -/

name: Registers
text:
structure Registers (BM BN BD : Nat) (p : Layout) (c : Coordinates) (b : Bases) (s : BlockState) : Prop where
  query : s.regs .blockPtr [BM, BD] "Q_block_ptr" = some (queryPointer BM BD p c b)
  value : s.regs .blockPtr [BN, BD] "V_block_ptr" = some (valuePointer BN BD p b)
  key : s.regs .blockPtr [BD, BN] "K_block_ptr" = some (keyPointer BN BD p b)
  output : s.regs .blockPtr [BM, BD] "O_block_ptr" = some (outputPointer BM BD p c b)
  rows : s.regs .nat [BM] "offs_m" = some (rowOffsets BM c)
  center : s.regs .ptr [BM] "m_ptrs" = some (rowPointer BM p.roundedContext p.M c)
  denominator : s.regs .ptr [BM] "l_ptrs" = some (rowPointer BM p.roundedContext p.L c)

name: OutputRegisters
text:
structure OutputRegisters (BM BD : Nat) (p : Parameters) (initial current : BlockState) : Prop where
  center : current.regs .ptr [BM] "m_ptrs" = some
    (RealPointers.rowPointer BM p.layout.roundedContext p.layout.M
      (RealHeader.coordinates initial p.heads p.kvHeads))
  denominator : current.regs .ptr [BM] "l_ptrs" = some
    (RealPointers.rowPointer BM p.layout.roundedContext p.layout.L
      (RealHeader.coordinates initial p.heads p.kvHeads))
  output : current.regs .blockPtr [BM, BD] "O_block_ptr" = some
    (RealPointers.outputPointer BM BD p.layout (RealHeader.coordinates initial p.heads p.kvHeads)
      (RealHeader.bases (RealHeader.coordinates initial p.heads p.kvHeads) p.strides))

name: Bounds
text:
structure Bounds (BM BN BD finish : Nat) (p : Parameters) (s : BlockState) (bounds : RegionBounds) : Prop
    extends RealSafetyPrologue.Bounds BM BN BD p s bounds where
  keys : ∀ j, j < RealLoop.count (loopParameters BM BN BD p s) →
    BlockBounds bounds (RealLoop.keyPointer (loopParameters BM BN BD p s) j) (RealAccumulation.checks p.evenN)
  values : ∀ j, j < RealLoop.count (loopParameters BM BN BD p s) →
    BlockBounds bounds (RealLoop.valuePointer (loopParameters BM BN BD p s) j) (RealAccumulation.checks p.evenN)
  writeCenter : ∀ i, RealExecution.rowAddress BM p s i < bounds p.layout.M
  writeDenominator : finish = 0 → ∀ i, RealExecution.rowAddress BM p s i < bounds p.layout.L

name: attnKernelInvariant
text:
noncomputable def attnKernelInvariant
    (s0 : BlockState) (Q K V B0 Out : RegionName) (sm_scale : ℝ)
    (q_offset kv_offset b_offset
      BLOCK_M BLOCK_N HEAD_DIM P_SEQ BIAS_LAST_SIZE stride_b0m stride_kk stride_kn
      stride_vk stride_vn numKVBlocks : Nat)
    (start_m : Nat) (i : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  let nB := numKVBlocks; let c := i / BLOCK_N; let N_CTX := BLOCK_N * numKVBlocks
  let score := fscore s0 Q K B0 sm_scale q_offset kv_offset b_offset
    BLOCK_M BLOCK_N HEAD_DIM N_CTX BIAS_LAST_SIZE stride_b0m start_m
  let V' := vFlat s0 V kv_offset HEAD_DIM N_CTX
  s.pids = s0.pids ∧ i = c * BLOCK_N ∧ c ≤ nB ∧
  (s.regs .real [BLOCK_M] "m_i" = some ⟨fun r : TileIndex [BLOCK_M] => mPg BLOCK_N nB score r.1 c⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .real [BLOCK_M] "l_i" = some ⟨fun r : TileIndex [BLOCK_M] => ((lPgK score r.1 c : ℝ) : WithBot ℝ)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .real [BLOCK_M, HEAD_DIM] "acc" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BLOCK_M, HEAD_DIM] =>
        ((oPg score V' idx.1 idx.2.1 c : ℝ) : WithBot ℝ)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .blockPtr [HEAD_DIM, BLOCK_N] "K_block_ptr" = some
      (⟨fun _ : TileIndex [HEAD_DIM, BLOCK_N] =>
        { region := K, baseOffset := kv_offset,
          parentShape := [HEAD_DIM, N_CTX + P_SEQ], blockShape := [HEAD_DIM, BLOCK_N],
          strides := [stride_kk, stride_kn], offsets := [0, c * BLOCK_N] }⟩)) ∧
  (s.regs .blockPtr [BLOCK_N, HEAD_DIM] "V_block_ptr" = some
      (⟨fun _ : TileIndex [BLOCK_N, HEAD_DIM] =>
        { region := V, baseOffset := kv_offset,
          parentShape := [N_CTX + P_SEQ, HEAD_DIM], blockShape := [BLOCK_N, HEAD_DIM],
          strides := [stride_vk, stride_vn], offsets := [c * BLOCK_N, 0] }⟩)) ∧
  -- loop-invariant (fixed) registers the body reads
  (s.regs .fp16 [BLOCK_M, HEAD_DIM] "q" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BLOCK_M, HEAD_DIM] =>
      FloatDType.real.cast FloatDType.fp16
        (some (sm_scale * 1.44269504 * qRaw s0 Q q_offset BLOCK_M HEAD_DIM start_m idx))⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .real [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_N] "b1" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_N] =>
      some (b1Val s0 B0 b_offset BLOCK_M stride_b0m BIAS_LAST_SIZE start_m idx.1 idx.2.1.val)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [] "b_offset" = some (Tile.scalar b_offset)) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [] "start_m" = some (Tile.scalar start_m)) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [] "q_offset" = some (Tile.scalar q_offset)) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [BLOCK_M] "b_ptr_offsets_m" = some (Tile.vec (fun r : Fin BLOCK_M => r.val))) ∧
  (∀ rg o, s.undef rg o = 0) ∧ (s.mem = s0.mem)

/-! ### preLoop prefix (deterministic prologue → invariant base seeds)

The first ten prologue statements are deterministic (no loads): the four scalar
offsets, the three block pointers, and the `m_i`/`l_i`/`acc` initializers. They
step with the validated recipe (`stepStmts.cons_some (stepStmt_assign_eq_some
…)` per statement, threading register reads through the accumulated `setReg`
chain) using the block-pointer eval lemmas above. The result is the base-case
register seeding for the loop invariant: `m_i = ⊥` (= `mPg … 0`),
`l_i = 0` (the kernel's seed; `lPgK … 0`), `acc = 0` (= `oPg … 0`), and the
`K`/`V` block pointers at their initial `[0,0]` offsets. -/

offsets). -/

name: BytesFrom
text:
def BytesFrom (R : RegionName) (s : BlockState)
    (base srow scol cur stop N BN BD : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ k : Nat, cur + k * BN < stop → ∀ (j : Fin BN) (d : Fin BD),
    cur + k * BN + j.val < N →
      FiniteByte (s.readMemValue .int R
        (base + (cur + k * BN + j.val) * srow + d.val * scol))

text:

name: FiniteByte
text:
def FiniteByte (byte : Int) : Prop :=
  Float8E5Bits.isInt8 byte = Bool.true ∧ (Float8E5Bits.ofInt byte).decodeRat.isSome = Bool.true

/-- Exact decoded input when finite. The default is used only to make the
view total; every active load below requires a valid finite byte. -/

name: AccessesFrom
text:
def AccessesFrom (bounds : RegionBounds) (R : RegionName)
    (base sr sc cur stop N BN BD : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ k : Nat, cur + k * BN < stop → ∀ (j : Fin BN) (d : Fin BD),
    cur + k * BN + j.val < N →
      base + (cur + k * BN + j.val) * sr + d.val * sc < bounds R

name: launch
text:
def launch (causal : Bool) (N SP BM BN T p : Nat) : Prop :=
  if causal then (p + 1) * BN + SP = BN * T ∧ BN * T ≤ N ∧ SP ≤ p * BM
  else N = BN * T

transpose. The output uses its own row and column strides. -/

name: alActive
alInv
text:
noncomputable def alInv (Q K V : RegionName) (s0 : BlockState) (sc : ℝ)
    (sqz sqh sqm sqk skz skh skn skk svz svh svk svn
      N_HEAD H BM BN BD numKV : Nat) (i : Nat) (st : BlockState) : Prop :=
  let qT := alQTileG s0 Q N_HEAD sqz sqh sqm sqk H BM BD
  let kT := alKTileG s0 K N_HEAD skz skh skn skk (BN * numKV) BD
  let vT := alVTileG s0 V N_HEAD svz svh svk svn (BN * numKV) BD
  st.pids = s0.pids ∧ i % BN = 0 ∧ i ≤ BN * numKV ∧
  (st.regs .real [BM] "m_prev" = some ⟨fun r : TileIndex [BM] =>
      mPartial BN qT numKV kT sc (i / BN) r.1⟩) ∧
  (st.regs .real [BM] "l_prev" = some ⟨fun r : TileIndex [BM] =>
      ((lPartial qT numKV kT sc (i / BN) r.1 : ℝ) : WithBot ℝ)⟩) ∧
  (st.regs .real [BM, BD] "acc" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BM, BD] =>
      ((oPartial qT numKV kT vT sc (i / BN) idx
          / lPartial qT numKV kT sc (i / BN) idx.1 : ℝ) : WithBot ℝ)⟩) ∧
  (st.regs .real [BM, BD] "q" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BM, BD] => some (qT idx)⟩) ∧
  (st.regs .nat [BM] "offs_m" = some (Tile.vec (fun r : Fin BM => s0.pids 0 * BM + r.val))) ∧
  (st.regs .nat [BN] "offs_n" = some (Tile.vec (fun j : Fin BN => j.val))) ∧
  (st.regs .nat [] "batch_id" = some (Tile.scalar (s0.pids 1 / N_HEAD))) ∧
  (st.regs .nat [] "off_hz" = some (Tile.scalar (s0.pids 1 % N_HEAD))) ∧
  (st.regs .ptr [BN, BD] "k_ptrs"
    = some (alPtrTile K (alBase s0 N_HEAD skz skh) skn skk i BN BD)) ∧
  (st.regs .ptr [BN, BD] "v_ptrs"
    = some (alPtrTile V (alBase s0 N_HEAD svz svh) svk svn i BN BD)) ∧
  (∀ rg o, st.undef rg o = 0) ∧ (st.mem = s0.mem)

private def scoreSafeInv (Q M : RegionName)
    (qbase mbase sn ozv ohv N_CTX ROUND_CTX BN BD stride_qm stride_qk : Nat)
    (m : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  BN ∣ m ∧ m ≤ ROUND_CTX ∧
  s.regs .nat [] "start_n" = some (Tile.scalar sn) ∧
  s.regs .nat [] "off_z" = some (Tile.scalar ozv) ∧
  s.regs .nat [] "off_h" = some (Tile.scalar ohv) ∧
  (∃ kT : Tile .real [BD, BN], s.regs .real [BD, BN] "k" = some kT) ∧
  (∃ sc : ℝ, s.regs .real [] "qk_scale" = some (Tile.scalar (some sc))) ∧
  (∃ oT : Tile .real [BN], s.regs .real [BN] "o" = some oT) ∧
  s.regs .blockPtr [BN, BD] "Q_block_ptr" = some ⟨fun _ : TileIndex [BN, BD] =>
    { region := Q, baseOffset := qbase, parentShape := [N_CTX, BD],
      blockShape := [BN, BD], strides := [stride_qm, stride_qk], offsets := [m, 0] }⟩ ∧
  s.regs .ptr [BN] "m_ptrs" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BN] =>
    (M.cast, mbase + m + idx.1.val)⟩

name: afcScoreBound
text:
def afcScoreBound
    (qT kT vT : TileIndex [128, 128] → ℝ) (keyScale : Fin 128 → ℝ) (qStart : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ (j : Fin 128) (i d : Fin 128),
    keyScale j * Finset.univ.sum (fun e : Fin 128 => qT (i, e, PUnit.unit) * kT (j, e, PUnit.unit))
      > -1000000.0

name: afcScoreBoundG
text:
def afcScoreBoundG
    (qT : TileIndex [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_DMODEL] → ℝ) (kT vT : TileIndex [SEQ, BLOCK_DMODEL] → ℝ)
    (keyScale : Fin SEQ → ℝ) (qStart : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ (j : Fin SEQ) (i : Fin BLOCK_M), (j.val ≤ qStart + i.val) →
    (0:ℝ) - 1000000.0 ≤
      keyScale j * Finset.univ.sum (fun e : Fin BLOCK_DMODEL => qT (i, e, PUnit.unit) * kT (j, e, PUnit.unit))

/-- General: under `afcScoreBoundG`, running max over a nonempty causal window
is `≥` the `-1e6` sentinel (the first key `j = 0` is causal, so the causal-only
bound applies and the sup over the window dominates it). -/

name: afcInvariantG
text:
noncomputable def afcInvariantG
    (Q K V QScale KScale Out : RegionName) (s0 : BlockState)
    (stride_qz stride_qh H HEAD_DIM N_CTX BLOCK_M BLOCK_N BLOCK_DMODEL HEAD_ACTIVE numKVBlocks : Nat)
    (keyScale : Fin (BLOCK_N * numKVBlocks) → ℝ) (hBD : 0 < BLOCK_DMODEL)
    (i : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  let qStart := qStartAFCG s0 BLOCK_M
  let qT := qTileAFCmG s0 Q stride_qz stride_qh H HEAD_DIM N_CTX BLOCK_M BLOCK_DMODEL HEAD_ACTIVE
  let kT := kTileAFCG s0 K stride_qz stride_qh H HEAD_DIM (BLOCK_N * numKVBlocks) BLOCK_DMODEL
  let vT := vTileAFCmG s0 V stride_qz stride_qh H HEAD_DIM (BLOCK_N * numKVBlocks) BLOCK_DMODEL HEAD_ACTIVE
  s.pids = s0.pids ∧ i % BLOCK_N = 0 ∧ i ≤ N_CTX ∧
  (s.regs .real [BLOCK_M] "m_i" = some ⟨fun r : TileIndex [BLOCK_M] =>
      afcRunningMaxG qT kT vT keyScale qStart i r.1 ⟨0, hBD⟩⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .real [BLOCK_M] "l_i" = some ⟨fun r : TileIndex [BLOCK_M] =>
      ((afcStateBot1G qT kT vT keyScale qStart i r.1 ⟨0, hBD⟩).2.1 : ℝ)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .real [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_DMODEL] "acc" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_DMODEL] =>
      ((afcStateBot1G qT kT vT keyScale qStart i idx.1 idx.2.1).2.2 : ℝ)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [BLOCK_M] "offs_m" = some (Tile.vec (fun r : Fin BLOCK_M => qStart + r.val))) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [BLOCK_N] "offs_n" = some (Tile.vec (fun j : Fin BLOCK_N => j.val))) ∧
  (s.regs .real [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_DMODEL] "q" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_DMODEL] =>
      if qStart + idx.1.val < N_CTX ∧ idx.2.1.val < HEAD_ACTIVE then
        some (qTileAFCG s0 Q stride_qz stride_qh H HEAD_DIM BLOCK_M BLOCK_DMODEL idx) else some (0.0 : ℝ)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .real [] "q_scale" = some (Tile.scalar
      (some (s0.readMem QScale (s0.pids 1 * ((N_CTX + BLOCK_M - 1) / BLOCK_M) + s0.pids 0))))) ∧
  (s.regs .ptr [BLOCK_DMODEL, BLOCK_N] "K_ptrs" = some (kPtrsAFCG s0 K stride_qz stride_qh H HEAD_DIM BLOCK_N BLOCK_DMODEL (i / BLOCK_N))) ∧
  (s.regs .ptr [] "K_scale_ptr" = some (kScalePtrAFCG s0 KScale N_CTX BLOCK_N (i / BLOCK_N))) ∧
  (s.regs .ptr [BLOCK_N, BLOCK_DMODEL] "V_ptrs" = some (vPtrsAFCG s0 V stride_qz stride_qh H HEAD_DIM BLOCK_N BLOCK_DMODEL (i / BLOCK_N))) ∧
  (s.regs .ptr [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_DMODEL] "O_block_ptr" = some (oBlockPtrAFCG s0 Out stride_qz stride_qh H HEAD_DIM BLOCK_M BLOCK_DMODEL)) ∧
  (∀ rg o, s.undef rg o = 0) ∧ (s.mem = s0.mem)

name: afcIOScoreBound
text:
def afcIOScoreBound (p₀ N_CTX BLOCK_M BLOCK_N BLOCK_DMODEL HEAD_ACTIVE T : Nat)
    (xs : Fin T → Fin (BLOCK_M * BLOCK_DMODEL) → ℝ)
    (ys : Fin T → Fin (BLOCK_DMODEL * BLOCK_N) → ℝ)
    (zs : Fin T → Fin (BLOCK_N * BLOCK_DMODEL) → ℝ)
    (ws vs : Fin T → Fin 1 → ℝ) : Prop :=
  afcScoreBoundG
    (afcIOqTm p₀ N_CTX BLOCK_M BLOCK_DMODEL HEAD_ACTIVE T xs)
    (afcIOkTm BLOCK_N BLOCK_DMODEL HEAD_ACTIVE T ys)
    (afcIOvTm BLOCK_N BLOCK_DMODEL HEAD_ACTIVE T zs)
    (afcIOkeyScale BLOCK_N T ws vs)
    (p₀ * BLOCK_M)

tiles/scales of the exact stack coincide with the stream-built ones (the `K`
tile only on the head-active lanes the spec actually consumes). -/

name: afcIOSafeInv
text:
private def afcIOSafeInv (K KScale V Out : RegionName) (s0 : BlockState)
    (stride_qz stride_qh H HEAD_DIM N_CTX BLOCK_M BLOCK_N BLOCK_DMODEL : Nat)
    (c : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  c % BLOCK_N = 0 ∧ c ≤ N_CTX ∧
  s.regs .nat [BLOCK_M] "offs_m" = some (Tile.vec (fun r : Fin BLOCK_M => s0.pids 0 * BLOCK_M + r.val)) ∧
  s.regs .nat [BLOCK_N] "offs_n" = some (Tile.vec (fun j : Fin BLOCK_N => j.val)) ∧
  (∃ mT : Tile .real [BLOCK_M], s.regs .real [BLOCK_M] "m_i" = some mT) ∧
  (∃ lT : Tile .real [BLOCK_M], s.regs .real [BLOCK_M] "l_i" = some lT) ∧
  (∃ aT : Tile .real [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_DMODEL], s.regs .real [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_DMODEL] "acc" = some aT) ∧
  (∃ qT : Tile .real [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_DMODEL], s.regs .real [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_DMODEL] "q" = some qT) ∧
  (∃ qscT : Tile .real [], s.regs .real [] "q_scale" = some qscT) ∧
  s.regs .ptr [BLOCK_DMODEL, BLOCK_N] "K_ptrs"
    = some (kPtrsAFCG s0 K stride_qz stride_qh H HEAD_DIM BLOCK_N BLOCK_DMODEL (c / BLOCK_N)) ∧
  s.regs .ptr [] "K_scale_ptr" = some (kScalePtrAFCG s0 KScale N_CTX BLOCK_N (c / BLOCK_N)) ∧
  s.regs .ptr [BLOCK_N, BLOCK_DMODEL] "V_ptrs"
    = some (vPtrsAFCG s0 V stride_qz stride_qh H HEAD_DIM BLOCK_N BLOCK_DMODEL (c / BLOCK_N)) ∧
  s.regs .ptr [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_DMODEL] "O_block_ptr"
    = some (oBlockPtrAFCG s0 Out stride_qz stride_qh H HEAD_DIM BLOCK_M BLOCK_DMODEL)

name: Windows
text:
structure Windows (c : Config) (Out : RegionName) (BM BN BD stage : Nat)
    (bounds : RegionBounds) : Prop where
  query : ∀ (row : Fin BM) (d : Fin BD), c.startM*BM+row.val < c.context → d.val < c.activeHead →
    c.base+(c.startM*BM+row.val)*c.strideM+d.val*c.strideD < bounds c.Q
  key : ∀ v ∈ RealFormula.allVisits c.startM BM BN stage, ∀ (j : Fin BN) (d : Fin BD),
    v.start+j.val < c.context → d.val < c.activeHead →
    c.base+d.val+j.val*c.strideKN+c.headDim*v.start < bounds c.K
  value : ∀ v ∈ RealFormula.allVisits c.startM BM BN stage, ∀ (j : Fin BN) (d : Fin BD),
    v.start+j.val < c.context → d.val < c.activeHead →
    c.base+j.val*c.strideM+d.val*c.strideD+c.headDim*v.start < bounds c.V
  queryScale : c.queryScaleBase+c.startM < bounds c.QS
  keyScale : ∀ v ∈ RealFormula.allVisits c.startM BM BN stage,
    c.keyScaleBase+v.start/BN < bounds c.KS
  output : ∀ i, RealEpilogue.active c BM BD i = Bool.true →
    RealEpilogue.address c BM BD i < bounds Out

structure Results {BM BN BD : Nat} (io : IO BM BN BD) (s t : BlockState)
    (ys : TileIndex [BM,BD] → ℝ) : Prop where
  output : ∀ i, RealEpilogue.active (io.at s) BM BD i = Bool.true →
    t.readMem io.out (RealEpilogue.address (io.at s) BM BD i) = ys i
  frame : ∀ r offset, (r ≠ io.out ∨ ∀ i, RealEpilogue.active (io.at s) BM BD i = Bool.true →
    offset ≠ RealEpilogue.address (io.at s) BM BD i) → t.mem r offset = s.mem r offset

/-- Execute the actual projected kernel on disjoint physical allocations.
The premises name finite active address bounds, input values, the zero-undef
convention and nonoverlapping active output cells. None refers to a computed
output or a successful intermediate execution. -/

name: IO.Implements
text:
def IO.Implements {BM BN BD : Nat} (io : IO BM BN BD)
    (f : Nat → Nat → RealFormula.Inputs BM BN BD → TileIndex [BM,BD] → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (A : FlatAlloc), A.Disjoint →
    (∀ r, r ∉ A.regions → A.extent r = 0) →
  ∀ (s : BlockState) (xs : RealFormula.Inputs BM BN BD),
    A.regions = io.regions s →
    s.undef = (fun _ _ => 0) →
    RealAccessSafety.Windows (io.at s) io.out BM BN BD io.stage A.extent →
    RealInputPins.Pins s (io.at s) io.stage xs →
    InjectiveOutput (io.at s) BM BD →
    ∃ t, exec (A.flattenKernel io.kernel.toAlgKernel) (A.flattenState s) = some t ∧
      (∀ i, RealEpilogue.active (io.at s) BM BD i = Bool.true →
        t.readMem A.flat (A.addr io.out (RealEpilogue.address (io.at s) BM BD i)) =
          f (s.pids 0) (s.pids 1) xs i) ∧
      (∀ r offset, (r ≠ A.flat ∨ ∀ i, RealEpilogue.active (io.at s) BM BD i = Bool.true →
        offset ≠ A.addr io.out (RealEpilogue.address (io.at s) BM BD i)) →
        t.mem r offset = (A.flattenState s).mem r offset)

scoped notation:25 io " ⊨ " f => IO.Implements io f

/-- All semantic obligations are checked against the same source kernel.
The bridge is the library's FlatAlloc.exec_flatten theorem, with its usual
bounded-access, supported-syntax and zero-undef hypotheses discharged here. -/

name: Agree
text:
structure Agree {BM BN BD : Nat} (xs ys : Inputs BM BN BD)
    (startM N HA stage : Nat) : Prop where
  query : ∀ row d, startM*BM+row.val < N → d.val < HA → xs.query row d = ys.query row d
  key : ∀ v ∈ allVisits startM BM BN stage, ∀ j d,
    v.start+j.val < N → d.val < HA → xs.key v.start j d = ys.key v.start j d
  value : ∀ v ∈ allVisits startM BM BN stage, ∀ j d,
    v.start+j.val < N → d.val < HA → xs.value v.start j d = ys.value v.start j d
  queryScale : xs.queryScale = ys.queryScale
  keyScale : ∀ v ∈ allVisits startM BM BN stage,
    xs.keyScale (v.start/BN) = ys.keyScale (v.start/BN)

name: Pins
text:
structure Pins {BM BN BD : Nat} (s : BlockState) (c : Config) (stage : Nat)
    (xs : Inputs BM BN BD) : Prop where
  query : ∀ row d, c.startM*BM+row.val < c.context → d.val < c.activeHead →
    s.readMem c.Q (c.base+(c.startM*BM+row.val)*c.strideM+d.val*c.strideD) = xs.query row d
  key : ∀ v ∈ allVisits c.startM BM BN stage, ∀ j d,
    v.start+j.val < c.context → d.val < c.activeHead →
    s.readMem c.K (c.base+d.val+j.val*c.strideKN+c.headDim*v.start) = xs.key v.start j d
  value : ∀ v ∈ allVisits c.startM BM BN stage, ∀ j d,
    v.start+j.val < c.context → d.val < c.activeHead →
    s.readMem c.V (c.base+j.val*c.strideM+d.val*c.strideD+c.headDim*v.start) = xs.value v.start j d
  queryScale : s.readMem c.QS (c.queryScaleBase+c.startM) = xs.queryScale
  keyScale : ∀ v ∈ allVisits c.startM BM BN stage,
    s.readMem c.KS (c.keyScaleBase+v.start/BN) = xs.keyScale (v.start/BN)

name: active
text:
def active
    (s : BlockState) (N_CTX HEAD_ACTIVE BLOCK_M : Nat)
    (idx : TileIndex [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_DMODEL]) : Prop :=
  mIndex s BLOCK_M idx.1 < N_CTX ∧ kIndex idx < HEAD_ACTIVE

name: aftgScoreBoundG
text:
def aftgScoreBoundG
    (qT : TileIndex [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_DMODEL] → ℝ) (kT vT : TileIndex [SEQ, BLOCK_DMODEL] → ℝ)
    (keyScale : Fin SEQ → ℝ) (qStart : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ (j : Fin SEQ) (i : Fin BLOCK_M), j.val ≤ qStart + i.val →
    (0:ℝ) - 1000000.0
      ≤ keyScale j * Finset.univ.sum (fun e : Fin BLOCK_DMODEL => qT (i, e, PUnit.unit) * kT (j, e, PUnit.unit))

/-- General: under the **causal-only, non-strict** `aftgScoreBoundG`, the running
max over a nonempty causal window is `≥` the `-1e6` sentinel. Key `0` is always
causal-kept (`0 ≤ qStart + i`), so its kept score `≥ -1e6` (the weaker bound) is a
member of the window's `foldr ⊔ ⊥`, hence a lower bound on the running max. -/

name: aftgInvariantG
text:
noncomputable def aftgInvariantG
    (Q K V QScale KScale Out : RegionName) (s0 : BlockState)
    (stride_qz stride_qh H HEAD_DIM N_CTX BLOCK_M BLOCK_N BLOCK_DMODEL HEAD_ACTIVE numKVBlocks : Nat)
    (keyScale : Fin (BLOCK_N * numKVBlocks) → ℝ) (hBD : 0 < BLOCK_DMODEL)
    (i : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  let qStart := qStartAFT2G s0 BLOCK_M
  let qT := qTileAFT2mG s0 Q stride_qz stride_qh H HEAD_DIM N_CTX BLOCK_M BLOCK_DMODEL HEAD_ACTIVE
  let kT := kTileAFT2G s0 K stride_qz stride_qh H HEAD_DIM (BLOCK_N * numKVBlocks) BLOCK_DMODEL
  let vT := vTileAFT2mG s0 V stride_qz stride_qh H HEAD_DIM (BLOCK_N * numKVBlocks) BLOCK_DMODEL HEAD_ACTIVE
  s.pids = s0.pids ∧ i % BLOCK_N = 0 ∧ i ≤ N_CTX ∧
  (s.regs .real [BLOCK_M] "m_i" = some ⟨fun r : TileIndex [BLOCK_M] =>
      aftgRunningMaxG qT kT vT keyScale qStart i r.1 ⟨0, hBD⟩⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .real [BLOCK_M] "l_i" = some ⟨fun r : TileIndex [BLOCK_M] =>
      ((aftgStateBot1G qT kT vT keyScale qStart i r.1 ⟨0, hBD⟩).2.1 : ℝ)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .real [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_DMODEL] "acc" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_DMODEL] =>
      ((aftgStateBot1G qT kT vT keyScale qStart i idx.1 idx.2.1).2.2 : ℝ)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [BLOCK_M] "offs_m" = some (Tile.vec (fun r : Fin BLOCK_M => qStart + r.val))) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [BLOCK_N] "offs_n" = some (Tile.vec (fun j : Fin BLOCK_N => j.val))) ∧
  (s.regs .real [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_DMODEL] "q" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_DMODEL] =>
      if qStart + idx.1.val < N_CTX ∧ idx.2.1.val < HEAD_ACTIVE then
        some (qTileAFT2G s0 Q stride_qz stride_qh H HEAD_DIM BLOCK_M BLOCK_DMODEL idx) else some (0.0 : ℝ)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .real [] "q_scale" = some (Tile.scalar
      (some (s0.readMem QScale (s0.pids 1 * ((N_CTX + BLOCK_M - 1) / BLOCK_M) + s0.pids 0))))) ∧
  (s.regs .ptr [BLOCK_DMODEL, BLOCK_N] "K_ptrs" = some (kPtrsAFT2G s0 K stride_qz stride_qh H HEAD_DIM BLOCK_N BLOCK_DMODEL (i / BLOCK_N))) ∧
  (s.regs .ptr [] "K_scale_ptr" = some (kScalePtrAFT2G s0 KScale N_CTX BLOCK_N (i / BLOCK_N))) ∧
  (s.regs .ptr [BLOCK_N, BLOCK_DMODEL] "V_ptrs" = some (vPtrsAFT2G s0 V stride_qz stride_qh H HEAD_DIM BLOCK_N BLOCK_DMODEL (i / BLOCK_N))) ∧
  (s.regs .ptr [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_DMODEL] "O_block_ptr" = some (oBlockPtrAFT2G s0 Out stride_qz stride_qh H HEAD_DIM BLOCK_M BLOCK_DMODEL)) ∧
  (∀ rg o, s.undef rg o = 0) ∧ (s.mem = s0.mem)

set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
set_option maxRecDepth 8000 in

name: aftgIOScoreBound
text:
def aftgIOScoreBound (p₀ N_CTX BLOCK_M BLOCK_N BLOCK_DMODEL HEAD_ACTIVE T : Nat)
    (xs : Fin T → Fin (BLOCK_M * BLOCK_DMODEL) → ℝ)
    (ys : Fin T → Fin (BLOCK_DMODEL * BLOCK_N) → ℝ)
    (zs : Fin T → Fin (BLOCK_N * BLOCK_DMODEL) → ℝ)
    (ws vs : Fin T → Fin 1 → ℝ) : Prop :=
  aftgScoreBoundG
    (aftgIOqTm p₀ N_CTX BLOCK_M BLOCK_DMODEL HEAD_ACTIVE T xs)
    (aftgIOkTm BLOCK_N BLOCK_DMODEL HEAD_ACTIVE T ys)
    (aftgIOvTm BLOCK_N BLOCK_DMODEL HEAD_ACTIVE T zs)
    (aftgIOkeyScale BLOCK_N T ws vs)
    (p₀ * BLOCK_M)

/-! ### Stream-pin tile bridges: under the skin's input pins the kernel-side
tiles/scales of the exact stack coincide with the stream-built ones (the `K`
tile only on the head-active lanes the spec actually consumes). -/

name: aftgIOSafeInv
text:
private def aftgIOSafeInv (K KScale V Out : RegionName) (s0 : BlockState)
    (stride_qz stride_qh H HEAD_DIM N_CTX BLOCK_M BLOCK_N BLOCK_DMODEL : Nat)
    (c : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  c % BLOCK_N = 0 ∧ c ≤ N_CTX ∧
  s.regs .nat [BLOCK_M] "offs_m" = some (Tile.vec (fun r : Fin BLOCK_M => s0.pids 0 * BLOCK_M + r.val)) ∧
  s.regs .nat [BLOCK_N] "offs_n" = some (Tile.vec (fun j : Fin BLOCK_N => j.val)) ∧
  (∃ mT : Tile .real [BLOCK_M], s.regs .real [BLOCK_M] "m_i" = some mT) ∧
  (∃ lT : Tile .real [BLOCK_M], s.regs .real [BLOCK_M] "l_i" = some lT) ∧
  (∃ aT : Tile .real [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_DMODEL], s.regs .real [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_DMODEL] "acc" = some aT) ∧
  (∃ qT : Tile .real [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_DMODEL], s.regs .real [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_DMODEL] "q" = some qT) ∧
  (∃ qscT : Tile .real [], s.regs .real [] "q_scale" = some qscT) ∧
  s.regs .ptr [BLOCK_DMODEL, BLOCK_N] "K_ptrs"
    = some (kPtrsAFT2G s0 K stride_qz stride_qh H HEAD_DIM BLOCK_N BLOCK_DMODEL (c / BLOCK_N)) ∧
  s.regs .ptr [] "K_scale_ptr" = some (kScalePtrAFT2G s0 KScale N_CTX BLOCK_N (c / BLOCK_N)) ∧
  s.regs .ptr [BLOCK_N, BLOCK_DMODEL] "V_ptrs"
    = some (vPtrsAFT2G s0 V stride_qz stride_qh H HEAD_DIM BLOCK_N BLOCK_DMODEL (c / BLOCK_N)) ∧
  s.regs .ptr [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_DMODEL] "O_block_ptr"
    = some (oBlockPtrAFT2G s0 Out stride_qz stride_qh H HEAD_DIM BLOCK_M BLOCK_DMODEL)

name: vecmatInvariant
text:
noncomputable def vecmatInvariant
    (A B output : RegionName) (s0 : BlockState)
    (dim_n dim_k BLOCK_M BLOCK_N BLOCK_K : Nat)
    (c : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  s.pids = s0.pids ∧
  (s.regs .nat [] "m_index" = some (Tile.scalar (s0.pids 0))) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [] "n_index" = some (Tile.scalar (s0.pids 1))) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_N] "output_tile" = some
      ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_N] =>
        (s0.pids 0 * BLOCK_M + idx.1.val) * dim_n + (s0.pids 1 * BLOCK_N + idx.2.1.val)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .real [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_N] "vecmat" = some
      ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_N] =>
        some (gemvPartial s0 A B dim_n dim_k BLOCK_M BLOCK_N BLOCK_K idx.1 idx.2.1 c)⟩) ∧
  (∀ rg o, s.undef rg o = 0) ∧ (s.mem = s0.mem)

def DomainHolds {α : Type} (D : Domain α) (f : Fragment) (s : State α) : Prop :=

name: Models
wbInv
text:
noncomputable def wbInv
    (input_ptr lora_ptr out_ptr : RegionName)
    (li K split_n_length xm_stride xk_stride l0_stride lora_k_stride
      lora_n_stride cm_stride cn_stride slice_offset BLOCK_N BLOCK_K : Nat)
    (s0 sorig : BlockState) (i : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  s.pids = s0.pids ∧ (BLOCK_N ∣ i) ∧
  s.regs .nat [BLOCK_K] "offset_k" = some (Tile.vec (fun j : Fin BLOCK_K => j.val)) ∧
  s.regs .nat [BLOCK_N] "offset_n" = some (Tile.vec (fun i : Fin BLOCK_N => i.val)) ∧
  s.regs .real [BLOCK_K] "tiled_a"
      = some ⟨fun j : TileIndex [BLOCK_K] => some (if j.1.val < K then aElem s0 input_ptr xm_stride xk_stride j.1.val else 0)⟩ ∧
  s.regs .ptr [] "b_ptr" = some (Tile.scalar (lora_ptr, lbaseOf s0 li split_n_length l0_stride lora_k_stride)) ∧
  s.regs .ptr [] "c_ptr" = some (Tile.scalar (out_ptr, cbaseOf s0 split_n_length cm_stride cn_stride slice_offset)) ∧
  s.readMem input_ptr = s0.readMem input_ptr ∧ s.readMem lora_ptr = s0.readMem lora_ptr ∧
  (∀ g : Fin split_n_length, s.readMem out_ptr (cOff s0 split_n_length cm_stride cn_stride slice_offset g.val)
    = if g.val < i then
        bgmvFullSpec s0 input_ptr lora_ptr li K split_n_length xm_stride xk_stride l0_stride lora_k_stride lora_n_stride BLOCK_K g.val
      else sorig.readMem out_ptr (cOff s0 split_n_length cm_stride cn_stride slice_offset g.val))

name: ScalarAdditionCommutes
text:
def ScalarAdditionCommutes {α : Type} (M : Algebra α) (D : Domain α)
    (p : Option ComputeDType) (dtype : FloatDType) : Prop :=
  ∀ a b, D .finite a → D .finite b →
    (engine M).binary p dtype .add a b = (engine M).binary p dtype .add b a

/-- Existing admitted rules already supply the fp32 scalar law in either
source context. They say nothing here about native half/bfloat16 addition. -/

name: Site.Holds
text:
def Site.Holds {α : Type} [Inhabited α] (M : Algebra α) (D : Domain α)
    (s : State α) : Site → Prop
  | .add before precision dtype _ left right =>
    ∀ t, run (engine M) before s = some t →
      ∀ a b, FP.Structural.evalOp (engine M) precision left t = some a →
        FP.Structural.evalOp (engine M) precision right t = some b →
        (∀ i, D .finite (toFloat dtype (a i))) ∧
        (∀ i, D .finite (toFloat dtype (b i)))
  | .range before index start stop stride body inner =>
    ∀ t, run (engine M) before s = some t →
      ∀ a b d, FP.Structural.evalOp (engine M) none start t = some a →
        FP.Structural.evalOp (engine M) none stop t = some b →
        FP.Structural.evalOp (engine M) none stride t = some d →
        ∀ cur u, RangeReachable (engine M) index (b PUnit.unit) (d PUnit.unit)
          body (a PUnit.unit) t cur u → d PUnit.unit ≠ 0 → cur < b PUnit.unit →
          inner.Holds M D (u.setReg index .nat [] (fun _ => cur))
  | .branch before condition selected inner =>
    ∀ t, run (engine M) before s = some t →
      ∀ value, FP.Structural.evalOp (engine M) none condition t = some value →
        value PUnit.unit = selected → inner.Holds M D t

name: NativeAdditionCommutes
text:
def NativeAdditionCommutes {α : Type} (M : Algebra α) (D : Domain α)
    (kernel : ComputeKernel) : Prop :=
  ∀ site ∈ requirementsFor kernel,
    ScalarAdditionCommutes M D site.profile.1 site.profile.2

name: IO.InputActive
text:
def IO.InputActive {p : Parameters} (io : IO p) (k : Fin p.BK) : Prop :=
  io.even = Bool.true ∨ k.val < p.K

name: IO.Bounds
text:
structure IO.Bounds {p : Parameters} (io : IO p) (bounds : RegionBounds)
    (split batch : Nat) (slot : Int) : Prop where
  metadata : io.readIndex batch < bounds (Region.cast p.indices)
  vector : slot ≠ -1 → ∀ k, io.InputActive k → io.readInput batch k < bounds p.input
  weights : slot ≠ -1 → ∀ g k, io.readWeight split slot g k < bounds p.weights
  output : slot ≠ -1 → ∀ g, io.write split batch g < bounds p.output

name: IO.Pins
text:
structure IO.Pins {p : Parameters} (io : IO p) (s : BlockState) (slot : Int) (xs : Inputs p) : Prop where
  metadata : s.readMemValue .int (Region.cast p.indices) (io.readIndex (s.pids 1)) = slot
  vector : slot ≠ -1 → ∀ k, io.InputActive k → s.readMem p.input (io.readInput (s.pids 1) k) = xs.vector k
  weights : slot ≠ -1 → ∀ g k, s.readMem p.weights (io.readWeight (s.pids 0) slot g k) = xs.weights g k
  initialOutput : slot ≠ -1 → io.add = Bool.true → ∀ g,
    s.readMem p.output (io.write (s.pids 0) (s.pids 1) g) = xs.initialOutput g

/-- Successful flat execution, active output values and the full-cell frame.
Initial output is a read input. No premise constrains a computed output or
requires an intermediate program execution. The allocation list has four
regions: vector, weights, output, signed metadata; output is not duplicated. -/

name: IO.Implements
text:
def IO.Implements {p : Parameters} (io : IO p) (f : Inputs p → Fin p.length → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ A : FlatAlloc, A.Disjoint →
    A.regions = [p.input, p.weights, p.output, Region.cast p.indices] →
    (∀ r, r ∉ A.regions → A.extent r = 0) →
  ∀ (s : BlockState) (slot : Int) (xs : Inputs p),
    (slot = -1 ∨ 0 ≤ slot) →
    s.undef = (fun _ _ => 0) →
    io.Bounds A.extent (s.pids 0) (s.pids 1) slot → io.Pins s slot xs →
    ∃ final, exec (A.flattenKernel io.kernel.toAlgKernel) (A.flattenState s) = some final ∧
      (∀ g, slot ≠ -1 → final.readMem A.flat (A.addr p.output (io.write (s.pids 0) (s.pids 1) g)) = f xs g) ∧
      (∀ r o, (r ≠ A.flat ∨ ∀ g, slot ≠ -1 → o ≠ A.addr p.output (io.write (s.pids 0) (s.pids 1) g)) →
        final.mem r o = (A.flattenState s).mem r o)

scoped notation:25 io " ⊨ " f => IO.Implements io f

name: Misses
text:
def Misses (p : Geometry) (r : RegionName) (o : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ g, g < p.length → ¬(p.output = r ∧ p.outputAddress g = o)

name: Registers
text:
structure Registers (p : Geometry) (a : Fin p.BK → ℝ) (s : BlockState) : Prop where
  split : s.regs .nat [] "split_n_length" = some (Tile.scalar p.length)
  offsetN : s.regs .nat [p.BN] "offset_n" = some (Tile.vec (fun i => i.val))
  offsetK : s.regs .nat [p.BK] "offset_k" = some (Tile.vec (fun k => k.val))
  weightPtr : s.regs .ptr [] "b_ptr" = some (Tile.scalar (p.weights,p.weightBase))
  outputPtr : s.regs .ptr [] "c_ptr" = some (Tile.scalar (p.output,p.outputBase))
  input : s.regs .real [p.BK] "tiled_a" = some ⟨fun i => some (a i.1)⟩

name: Invariant
text:
structure Invariant (p : Geometry) (a : Fin p.BK → ℝ) (initial : BlockState)
    (add : Bool) (n : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop where
  multiple : p.BN ∣ n
  registers : p.Registers a s
  weights : s.readMem p.weights = initial.readMem p.weights
  output : ∀ g, g < p.length → s.readMem p.output (p.outputAddress g) =
    if g < n then p.expected a initial add g else initial.readMem p.output (p.outputAddress g)
  frame : ∀ r o, p.Misses r o → s.mem r o = initial.mem r o

name: ActiveBounds
text:
structure ActiveBounds (bounds : RegionBounds) (p : Parameters) (s : BlockState)
    (slot : Nat) (even : Bool) : Prop where
  input : ∀ k : Fin p.BK, even = Bool.true ∨ k.val < p.K →
    s.pids 1 * p.inputBatchStride + k.val * p.inputStride < bounds p.input
  weights : ∀ g, g < p.length → ∀ k : Fin p.BK, k.val < p.K →
    (p.geometry s slot).weightBase + g*p.rowStride + k.val*p.colStride < bounds p.weights
  output : ∀ g, g < p.length → (p.geometry s slot).outputAddress g < bounds p.output

name: shrinkInv
text:
noncomputable def shrinkInv
    (input_ptr lora_ptr : RegionName) (lora_indices : Region .nat)
    (N K xm_stride l0_stride lora_k_stride lora_n_stride
      BLOCK_N BLOCK_K SPLIT_K : Nat) (s0 : BlockState)
    (i : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  let c := i / (BLOCK_K * SPLIT_K)
  s.pids = s0.pids ∧ i = c * (BLOCK_K * SPLIT_K) ∧
  i < K + BLOCK_K * SPLIT_K ∧
  s.regs .nat [] "cur_batch" = some (Tile.scalar (s0.pids 1)) ∧
  s.regs .nat [BLOCK_N] "offset_n"
    = some (Tile.vec (fun j : Fin BLOCK_N => j.val)) ∧
  s.regs .nat [BLOCK_K] "offset_k"
    = some (Tile.vec (fun e : Fin BLOCK_K => e.val + s0.pids 0 * BLOCK_K)) ∧
  s.regs .ptr [] "a_ptr"
    = some (Tile.scalar ((input_ptr, s0.pids 1 * xm_stride) : RegionName × Nat)) ∧
  s.regs .ptr [] "b_ptr"
    = some (Tile.scalar
        ((lora_ptr, l0_stride * loraIdx s0 lora_indices) : RegionName × Nat)) ∧
  s.regs .real [BLOCK_N] "accumulator"
    = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BLOCK_N] =>
        some (if idx.1.val < N then
          accPartial s0 input_ptr lora_ptr lora_indices K xm_stride l0_stride
            lora_k_stride lora_n_stride BLOCK_K SPLIT_K c idx.1.val
        else 0)⟩ ∧
  s.mem = s0.mem

name: RankActive
IO.Bounds
text:
structure IO.Bounds {p : Parameters} (io : IO p) (bounds : RegionBounds)
    (split batch : Nat) (slot : Int) : Prop where
  metadata : io.readIndex batch < bounds (Region.cast p.indices)
  vector : slot ≠ -1 → ∀ k, RankActive p split k → io.readInput batch k < bounds p.input
  weights : slot ≠ -1 → ∀ n k, RankActive p split k → io.readWeight slot n k < bounds p.weights
  output : slot ≠ -1 → ∀ n, io.write batch n < bounds p.output

name: IO.Pins
text:
structure IO.Pins {p : Parameters} (io : IO p) (s : BlockState) (slot : Int) (xs : Inputs p) : Prop where
  metadata : s.readMemValue .int (Region.cast p.indices) (io.readIndex (s.pids 1)) = slot
  vector : slot ≠ -1 → ∀ k, RankActive p (s.pids 0) k →
    s.readMem p.input (io.readInput (s.pids 1) k) = xs.vector k
  weights : slot ≠ -1 → ∀ n k, RankActive p (s.pids 0) k →
    s.readMem p.weights (io.readWeight slot n k) = xs.weights n k
  initialOutput : slot ≠ -1 → p.splits ≠ 1 → ∀ n,
    s.readMem p.output (io.write (s.pids 1) n) = xs.initialOutput n

/-- Successful flat execution, active output values and full-cell frame.
Output is a single allocation, even when it supplies the initial atomic value.
The independent formula may depend on the program's split ID. -/

name: IO.Implements
text:
def IO.Implements {p : Parameters} (io : IO p) (f : Nat → Inputs p → Fin p.N → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ A : FlatAlloc, A.Disjoint →
    A.regions = [p.input, p.weights, p.output, Region.cast p.indices] →
    (∀ r, r ∉ A.regions → A.extent r = 0) →
  ∀ (s : BlockState) (slot : Int) (xs : Inputs p),
    (slot = -1 ∨ 0 ≤ slot) → s.undef = (fun _ _ => 0) →
    io.Bounds A.extent (s.pids 0) (s.pids 1) slot → io.Pins s slot xs →
    ∃ final, exec (A.flattenKernel io.kernel.toAlgKernel) (A.flattenState s) = some final ∧
      (∀ n, slot ≠ -1 → final.readMem A.flat
        (A.addr p.output (io.write (s.pids 1) n)) = f (s.pids 0) xs n) ∧
      (∀ r o, (r ≠ A.flat ∨ ∀ n, slot ≠ -1 → o ≠ A.addr p.output (io.write (s.pids 1) n)) →
        final.mem r o = (A.flattenState s).mem r o)

name: Misses
text:
def Misses (p : Parameters) (initial : BlockState) (r : RegionName) (o : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ n : Fin p.BN, n.val < p.N → ¬(p.output = r ∧ RealTail.offset p (initial.pids 1) n.val = o)

name: ActiveBounds
text:
structure ActiveBounds (bounds : RegionBounds) (p : Parameters) (s : BlockState)
    (slot : Nat) : Prop where
  input : ∀ (c : Fin (RealLoop.numKIters p.K (p.BK * p.splits))) (e : Fin p.BK),
    RealLoop.kIdx s p.BK p.splits c.val e.val < p.K →
    s.pids 1 * p.inputBatchStride + RealLoop.kIdx s p.BK p.splits c.val e.val < bounds p.input
  weights : ∀ (c : Fin (RealLoop.numKIters p.K (p.BK * p.splits))) (n : Fin p.BN) (e : Fin p.BK),
    n.val < p.N → RealLoop.kIdx s p.BK p.splits c.val e.val < p.K →
    p.slotStride * slot + n.val * p.rowStride +
      RealLoop.kIdx s p.BK p.splits c.val e.val * p.colStride < bounds p.weights
  output : ∀ n : Fin p.BN, n.val < p.N → RealTail.offset p (s.pids 1) n.val < bounds p.output

name: requirements
text:
def requirements (p : Parameters) (pid₀ pid₁ : Nat) (xs : Inputs) : Prop :=
  let sched := csrSchedule p pid₀ pid₁
  let slot := fun visit : Nat => ((sched.layout * p.columnStride : Nat) : Int) + CSRMath.first sched xs + (visit : Int)
  (∀ visit, visit < CSRMath.count sched xs → 0 ≤ slot visit) ∧
  (∀ visit, visit < CSRMath.count sched xs → 0 ≤ xs.columnIndex (slot visit))

/-- Q/K/V pins cover their mathematical context; metadata pins cover the two
row endpoints and visited column slots. Allocation bounds use active physical
lanes, including padding for evenM/evenN. Width is BD or exactly 2*BD.
Output channels share one row-masked window, with no scratch allocation. -/

name: active
text:
def active
    (s : BlockState) (total_seq_len BLOCK_M : Nat)
    (idx : TileIndex [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_D]) : Prop :=
  mIndex s BLOCK_M idx.1 < total_seq_len

name: bsaInvariant
text:
noncomputable def bsaInvariant
    (Out Q K V : RegionName) (R C : Region .nat)
    (qStart numKVBlocks : Nat) (gpos : Fin (16 * numKVBlocks) → Nat)
    (Qg : TileIndex [16, 32] → ℝ)
    (Kg : TileIndex [16 * numKVBlocks, 32] → ℝ)
    (Vg Vg2 : TileIndex [16 * numKVBlocks, 16] → ℝ) (scale : ℝ)
    (s0 : BlockState) (c : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  s.pids = s0.pids
  ∧ s.mem = s0.mem
  ∧ (∀ rg o, s.undef rg o = 0)
  ∧ s.regs .nat [] "q_seq_len" = some (Tile.scalar 16)
  ∧ s.regs .nat [] "start_m" = some (Tile.scalar (s0.pids 0))
  ∧ s.regs .nat [] "off_bh" = some (Tile.scalar (s0.pids 1))
  ∧ s.regs .nat [] "off_h" = some (Tile.scalar (s0.pids 1 % 4))
  ∧ s.regs .nat [] "off_b" = some (Tile.scalar (s0.pids 1 / 4))
  ∧ s.regs .nat [] "head_groups" = some (Tile.scalar 2)
  ∧ s.regs .nat [] "off_h_kv" = some (Tile.scalar (s0.pids 1 % 4 / 2))
  ∧ s.regs .nat [16] "offs_m" =
      some (Tile.vec (fun i : Fin 16 => s0.pids 0 * 16 + i.val))
  ∧ s.regs .nat [16] "offs_n" = some (Tile.vec (fun j : Fin 16 => j.val))
  ∧ s.regs .nat [16] "offs_d" = some (Tile.vec (fun e : Fin 16 => e.val))
  ∧ s.regs .nat [] "layout_h" = some (Tile.scalar (s0.pids 1 % 4 % 1))
  ∧ s.regs .real [16] "m_i" =
      some (Tile.vec (fun i : Fin 16 =>
        bsaMPartial 16 qStart numKVBlocks gpos Qg Kg scale c i))
  ∧ s.regs .real [16] "l_i" =
      some (Tile.vec (fun i : Fin 16 =>
        (some (bsaLPartial 16 qStart numKVBlocks gpos Qg Kg scale c i) : WithBot ℝ)))
  ∧ s.regs .real [16, 16] "acc" =
      some (⟨fun idx : TileIndex [16, 16] =>
        (some (bsaOPartial 16 qStart numKVBlocks gpos Qg Kg Vg scale c idx /
          bsaLPartial 16 qStart numKVBlocks gpos Qg Kg scale c idx.1) : WithBot ℝ)⟩
          : Tile .real [16, 16])
  ∧ s.regs .real [16, 16] "acc2" =
      some (⟨fun idx : TileIndex [16, 16] =>
        (some (bsaOPartial 16 qStart numKVBlocks gpos Qg Kg Vg2 scale c idx /
          bsaLPartial 16 qStart numKVBlocks gpos Qg Kg scale c idx.1) : WithBot ℝ)⟩
          : Tile .real [16, 16])
  ∧ s.regs .real [16, 16] "q" =
      some (⟨fun idx : TileIndex [16, 16] =>
        s0.readMemValue .real Q ((s0.pids 1 / 4 * 2048 + s0.pids 1 % 4 * 512) +
          ((s0.pids 0 * 16 + idx.1.val) * 32 + idx.2.1.val))⟩ : Tile .real [16, 16])
  ∧ s.regs .real [16, 16] "q2" =
      some (⟨fun idx : TileIndex [16, 16] =>
        s0.readMemValue .real Q ((s0.pids 1 / 4 * 2048 + s0.pids 1 % 4 * 512) +
          ((s0.pids 0 * 16 + idx.1.val) * 32 + idx.2.1.val) + 16)⟩ : Tile .real [16, 16])
  ∧ s.regs .ptr [16, 16] "k_ptrs" =
      some (⟨fun idx : TileIndex [16, 16] =>
        (K, (s0.pids 1 / 4 * 1024 + s0.pids 1 % 4 / 2 * 512) +
          (idx.2.1.val * 32 + idx.1.val))⟩ : Tile .ptr [16, 16])
  ∧ s.regs .ptr [16, 16] "v_ptrs" =
      some (⟨fun idx : TileIndex [16, 16] =>
        (V, (s0.pids 1 / 4 * 1024 + s0.pids 1 % 4 / 2 * 512) +
          (idx.1.val * 32 + idx.2.1.val))⟩ : Tile .ptr [16, 16])

set_option maxHeartbeats 4000000 in
set_option maxRecDepth 8000 in
/-- **Pre-loop execution.** The 29 deterministic pre-loop statements step a clean
input state (`undef = 0`) to a state satisfying `bsaInvariant … 0` — the loop-entry
base case (`m_i = ⊥`, `l_i = 0`, `acc = acc2 = 0`, via the `bsaMPartial`/
`bsaLPartial`/`bsaOPartial` zero recurrences). The streaming data is arbitrary;
at `c = 0` the accumulators are data-independent. -/

name: bsaInvariantG
text:
noncomputable def bsaInvariantG
    (Out Q K V : RegionName) (R C : Region .nat)
    (BLOCK_M BLOCK_D BLOCK_N num_heads num_kv_heads num_layout total_seq_len : Nat)
    (sqb sqh sqm skb skh skn svb svh svn : Nat)
    (qStart numKVBlocks : Nat) (gpos : Fin (BLOCK_N * numKVBlocks) → Nat)
    (Qg : TileIndex [BLOCK_M, 2 * BLOCK_D] → ℝ)
    (Kg : TileIndex [BLOCK_N * numKVBlocks, 2 * BLOCK_D] → ℝ)
    (Vg Vg2 : TileIndex [BLOCK_N * numKVBlocks, BLOCK_D] → ℝ) (scale : ℝ)
    (s0 : BlockState) (c : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  s.pids = s0.pids
  ∧ s.mem = s0.mem
  ∧ (∀ rg o, s.undef rg o = 0)
  ∧ s.regs .nat [] "q_seq_len" = some (Tile.scalar total_seq_len)
  ∧ s.regs .nat [] "start_m" = some (Tile.scalar (s0.pids 0))
  ∧ s.regs .nat [] "off_bh" = some (Tile.scalar (s0.pids 1))
  ∧ s.regs .nat [] "off_h" = some (Tile.scalar (s0.pids 1 % num_heads))
  ∧ s.regs .nat [] "off_b" = some (Tile.scalar (s0.pids 1 / num_heads))
  ∧ s.regs .nat [] "head_groups" = some (Tile.scalar (num_heads / num_kv_heads))
  ∧ s.regs .nat [] "off_h_kv" =
      some (Tile.scalar (s0.pids 1 % num_heads / (num_heads / num_kv_heads)))
  ∧ s.regs .nat [BLOCK_M] "offs_m" =
      some (Tile.vec (fun i : Fin BLOCK_M => s0.pids 0 * BLOCK_M + i.val))
  ∧ s.regs .nat [BLOCK_N] "offs_n" = some (Tile.vec (fun j : Fin BLOCK_N => j.val))
  ∧ s.regs .nat [BLOCK_D] "offs_d" = some (Tile.vec (fun e : Fin BLOCK_D => e.val))
  ∧ s.regs .nat [] "layout_h" = some (Tile.scalar (s0.pids 1 % num_heads % num_layout))
  ∧ s.regs .real [BLOCK_M] "m_i" =
      some (Tile.vec (fun i : Fin BLOCK_M =>
        bsaMPartial BLOCK_N qStart numKVBlocks gpos Qg Kg scale c i))
  ∧ s.regs .real [BLOCK_M] "l_i" =
      some (Tile.vec (fun i : Fin BLOCK_M =>
        (some (bsaLPartial BLOCK_N qStart numKVBlocks gpos Qg Kg scale c i) : WithBot ℝ)))
  ∧ s.regs .real [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_D] "acc" =
      some (⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_D] =>
        (some (bsaOPartial BLOCK_N qStart numKVBlocks gpos Qg Kg Vg scale c idx /
          bsaLPartial BLOCK_N qStart numKVBlocks gpos Qg Kg scale c idx.1) : WithBot ℝ)⟩
          : Tile .real [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_D])
  ∧ s.regs .real [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_D] "acc2" =
      some (⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_D] =>
        (some (bsaOPartial BLOCK_N qStart numKVBlocks gpos Qg Kg Vg2 scale c idx /
          bsaLPartial BLOCK_N qStart numKVBlocks gpos Qg Kg scale c idx.1) : WithBot ℝ)⟩
          : Tile .real [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_D])
  ∧ s.regs .real [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_D] "q" =
      some (⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_D] =>
        s0.readMemValue .real Q ((s0.pids 1 / num_heads * sqb + s0.pids 1 % num_heads * sqh) +
          ((s0.pids 0 * BLOCK_M + idx.1.val) * sqm + idx.2.1.val))⟩ : Tile .real [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_D])
  ∧ s.regs .real [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_D] "q2" =
      some (⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_D] =>
        s0.readMemValue .real Q ((s0.pids 1 / num_heads * sqb + s0.pids 1 % num_heads * sqh) +
          ((s0.pids 0 * BLOCK_M + idx.1.val) * sqm + idx.2.1.val) + BLOCK_D)⟩
          : Tile .real [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_D])
  ∧ s.regs .ptr [BLOCK_D, BLOCK_N] "k_ptrs" =
      some (⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BLOCK_D, BLOCK_N] =>
        (K, (s0.pids 1 / num_heads * skb +
            s0.pids 1 % num_heads / (num_heads / num_kv_heads) * skh) +
          (idx.2.1.val * skn + idx.1.val))⟩ : Tile .ptr [BLOCK_D, BLOCK_N])
  ∧ s.regs .ptr [BLOCK_N, BLOCK_D] "v_ptrs" =
      some (⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BLOCK_N, BLOCK_D] =>
        (V, (s0.pids 1 / num_heads * svb +
            s0.pids 1 % num_heads / (num_heads / num_kv_heads) * svh) +
          (idx.1.val * svn + idx.2.1.val))⟩ : Tile .ptr [BLOCK_N, BLOCK_D])

set_option maxHeartbeats 4000000 in
set_option maxRecDepth 8000 in
/-- **General pre-loop execution.** Mirrors `bsaPreLoop_eval` at symbolic dims:
the 29 deterministic pre-loop statements step a clean input state to a state
satisfying `bsaInvariantG … 0`, with the `start_l`/`end_l` register values exposed.
-/

name: Outputs
text:
structure Outputs {BM BN BD : Nat} (s : BlockState) (x : Inputs BM BN BD)
    (ptrs : Tile .ptr [BN, BD]) (start : Int) (stride context blocks : Nat) (even : Bool)
    (t : BlockState) : Prop where
  maximum : t.regs .real [BM] "m_i" = some (extendedRow x.nextMax)
  normalizer : t.regs .real [BM] "l_i" = some (row x.nextNormalizer)
  accumulator : t.regs .real [BM, BD] "acc" = some (matrix
    (update x.scaledProbability x.scaledAccumulator
      (RealValueLoad.loaded s ptrs start stride context even Bool.false)))
  secondAccumulator : 2 ≤ blocks → t.regs .real [BM, BD] "acc2" = some (matrix
    (update x.scaledProbability x.scaledSecond
      (RealValueLoad.loaded s ptrs start stride context even Bool.true)))

name: validCSR
Results
text:
structure Results (A : FlatAlloc) (s t : BlockState) (BM BN BD : Nat)
    (p : RealProgram.Parameters) (xs : CSRMath.Inputs) : Prop where
  first : ∀ (r : Fin BM) (d : Fin BD), RealSetup.rows s BM r < p.context →
    t.mem A.flat (A.addr p.Out (RealWindows.output s BM p r d.val)) =
      MemCell.real (CSRMath.attention (schedule s p) xs BN BD p.blocks (RealSetup.rows s BM r) d.val p.scale)
  second : 2 ≤ p.blocks → ∀ (r : Fin BM) (d : Fin BD), RealSetup.rows s BM r < p.context →
    t.mem A.flat (A.addr p.Out (RealWindows.output s BM p r (BD + d.val))) =
      MemCell.real (CSRMath.attention (schedule s p) xs BN BD p.blocks (RealSetup.rows s BM r) (BD + d.val) p.scale)
  frame : ∀ region address,
    (∀ (r : Fin BM) (d : Fin BD), RealSetup.rows s BM r < p.context →
      ¬(A.flat = region ∧ A.addr p.Out (RealWindows.output s BM p r d.val) = address)) →
    (2 ≤ p.blocks → ∀ (r : Fin BM) (d : Fin BD), RealSetup.rows s BM r < p.context →
      ¬(A.flat = region ∧ A.addr p.Out (RealWindows.output s BM p r (BD + d.val)) = address)) →
    t.mem region address = (A.flattenState s).mem region address

name: IO.Pins
text:
structure IO.Pins {BM : Nat} (io : IO BM) (s : BlockState) (xs : Inputs) : Prop where
  rows : ∀ next, s.readMemValue .int (Region.cast io.rows) (io.rowSlot (s.pids 0) (s.pids 1) next) =
    xs.rowIndex (io.rowSlot (s.pids 0) (s.pids 1) next)
  columns : ∀ visit, visit < io.count (s.pids 0) (s.pids 1) xs →
    s.readMemValue .int (Region.cast io.columns) (io.columnSlot (s.pids 0) (s.pids 1) xs visit).toNat =
      xs.columnIndex (io.columnSlot (s.pids 0) (s.pids 1) xs visit)
  query : ∀ r d, r < io.context → d < io.width →
    s.readMem io.Q (io.queryWindow (s.pids 1) r d) = xs.query r d
  key : ∀ r d, 0 ≤ r → r < (io.context : Int) → d < io.width →
    s.readMem io.K (io.keyWindow (s.pids 1) r d) = xs.key r d
  value : ∀ r d, 0 ≤ r → r < (io.context : Int) → d < io.width →
    s.readMem io.V (io.valueWindow (s.pids 1) r d) = xs.value r d

/-- Allocation covers visited metadata and active physical loads, including
padding in unchecked branches. Stores always keep the query-row mask. -/

name: IO.Bounds
text:
structure IO.Bounds {BM : Nat} (io : IO BM) (BN : Nat) (bounds : RegionBounds)
    (pid₀ pid₁ : Nat) (xs : Inputs) : Prop where
  rows : ∀ next, io.rowSlot pid₀ pid₁ next < bounds (Region.cast io.rows)
  columns : ∀ visit, visit < io.count pid₀ pid₁ xs → (io.columnSlot pid₀ pid₁ xs visit).toNat < bounds (Region.cast io.columns)
  query : ∀ (r : Fin BM) d, d < io.width → (io.evenM = Bool.true ∨ pid₀ * BM + r.val < io.context) →
    io.queryWindow pid₁ (pid₀ * BM + r.val) d < bounds io.Q
  key : ∀ visit, visit < io.count pid₀ pid₁ xs → ∀ (j : Fin BN) d, d < io.width →
    (io.evenN = Bool.true ∨ io.selectedKey BN pid₀ pid₁ xs visit j < (io.context : Int)) →
    io.keyWindow pid₁ (io.selectedKey BN pid₀ pid₁ xs visit j) d < bounds io.K
  value : ∀ visit, visit < io.count pid₀ pid₁ xs → ∀ (j : Fin BN) d, d < io.width →
    (io.evenN = Bool.true ∨ io.selectedKey BN pid₀ pid₁ xs visit j < (io.context : Int)) →
    io.valueWindow pid₁ (io.selectedKey BN pid₀ pid₁ xs visit j) d < bounds io.V
  output : ∀ r d, d < io.width → pid₀ * BM + r.val < io.context →
    io.outputWindow pid₀ pid₁ r d < bounds io.output

/-- One program's real execution from independent arrays and a valid CSR
schedule. The same displayed windows govern allocation, values and frame. -/

name: IO.Implements
text:
def IO.Implements {BM : Nat} (io : IO BM) (BN : Nat)
    (f : Nat → Nat → Inputs → Fin BM → Nat → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ A : FlatAlloc, A.Disjoint → (∀ r, r ∉ A.regions → A.extent r = 0) →
  ∀ (s : BlockState) (xs : Inputs),
    io.domain (s.pids 0) (s.pids 1) xs → s.undef = (fun _ _ => 0) →
    io.Bounds BN A.extent (s.pids 0) (s.pids 1) xs → io.Pins s xs →
    ∃ final, exec (A.flattenKernel io.kernel.toAlgKernel) (A.flattenState s) = some final ∧
      (∀ r d, d < io.width → s.pids 0 * BM + r.val < io.context →
        final.mem A.flat (A.addr io.output (io.outputWindow (s.pids 0) (s.pids 1) r d)) =
          MemCell.real (f (s.pids 0) (s.pids 1) xs r d)) ∧
      (∀ region address,
        (∀ r d, d < io.width → s.pids 0 * BM + r.val < io.context →
          ¬(A.flat = region ∧ A.addr io.output (io.outputWindow (s.pids 0) (s.pids 1) r d) = address)) →
        final.mem region address = (A.flattenState s).mem region address)

name: Memory
text:
structure Memory (s : BlockState) (BD : Nat) (p : RealProgram.Parameters) (xs : CSRMath.Inputs) : Prop where
  rows : ∀ next, s.readMemValue .int (Region.cast p.rows) (rowAddress s p next) =
    xs.rowIndex (rowAddress s p next)
  columns : ∀ visit, visit < CSRMath.count (schedule s p) xs →
    s.readMemValue .int (Region.cast p.cols) (columnSlot s p xs visit).toNat =
      xs.columnIndex (columnSlot s p xs visit)
  query : ∀ r d, r < p.context → d < width BD p →
    s.readMem p.Q (RealSetup.qBase s p + r * p.qRow + d) = xs.query r d
  key : ∀ r d, 0 ≤ r → r < (p.context : Int) → d < width BD p →
    s.readMem p.K (RealSetup.kBase s p + r.toNat * p.kRow + d) = xs.key r d
  value : ∀ r d, 0 ≤ r → r < (p.context : Int) → d < width BD p →
    s.readMem p.V (RealSetup.vBase s p + r.toNat * p.vRow + d) = xs.value r d
