name: Bounds
text:
structure Bounds (bounds : RegionBounds) (s : BlockState) (BM BN BD : Nat)
    (p : RealProgram.Parameters) (xs : CSRMath.Inputs) : Prop where
  rows : ∀ next, RealInputs.rowAddress s p next < bounds (Region.cast p.rows)
  columns : ∀ visit, visit < CSRMath.count (schedule s p) xs →
    (RealInputs.columnSlot s p xs visit).toNat < bounds (Region.cast p.cols)
  query : ∀ r d, d < RealInputs.width BD p → (p.evenM = Bool.true ∨ s.pids 0 * BM + r.val < p.context) →
    query s BM p r d < bounds p.Q
  key : ∀ visit, visit < CSRMath.count (schedule s p) xs → ∀ j d, d < RealInputs.width BD p →
    (p.evenN = Bool.true ∨ CSRMath.selectedKey (schedule s p) xs BN visit j < (p.context : Int)) →
    key s BN p xs visit j d < bounds p.K
  value : ∀ visit, visit < CSRMath.count (schedule s p) xs → ∀ j d, d < RealInputs.width BD p →
    (p.evenN = Bool.true ∨ CSRMath.selectedKey (schedule s p) xs BN visit j < (p.context : Int)) →
    value s BN p xs visit j d < bounds p.V
  output : ∀ r d, d < RealInputs.width BD p → s.pids 0 * BM + r.val < p.context →
    output s BM p r d < bounds p.Out

name: bbwdInvariant
text:
noncomputable def bbwdInvariant
    (Dout A : RegionName) (s0 : BlockState)
    (PB PC PH PM PN chunk_size BM BN SDB SDC SDH SDN SDM SAB SAS SAH SAK BLOCK_CS numCSBlocks : Nat)
    (c : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  s.pids = s0.pids ∧ c ≤ numCSBlocks ∧
  (s.regs .real [BM, BN] "acc" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BM, BN] =>
      some (accPartial s0 Dout A PB PC PH PM PN BM BN chunk_size SDB SDC SDH SDN SDM SAB SAS SAH SAK BLOCK_CS idx.1 idx.2.1 c)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [] "pid_b" = some (Tile.scalar PB)) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [] "pid_c" = some (Tile.scalar PC)) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [] "pid_h" = some (Tile.scalar PH)) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [] "pid_m" = some (Tile.scalar PM)) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [] "pid_n" = some (Tile.scalar PN)) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [BM] "offs_m" = some (Tile.vec (fun i : Fin BM => PM * BM + i.val))) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [BN] "offs_n" = some (Tile.vec (fun j : Fin BN => PN * BN + j.val))) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [BLOCK_CS] "offs_cs" = some (Tile.vec (fun e : Fin BLOCK_CS => e.val))) ∧
  (s.regs .ptr [BM, BLOCK_CS] "dout_ptrs" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BM, BLOCK_CS] =>
      (Dout.cast, doutOff PB PC PH SDB SDC SDH + (PM * BM + idx.1.val) * SDN + idx.2.1.val * SDM + c * BLOCK_CS * SDM)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .ptr [BLOCK_CS, BN] "a_ptrs" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BLOCK_CS, BN] =>
      (A.cast, batchOff PB PC PH chunk_size SAB SAS SAH + idx.1.val * SAS + (PN * BN + idx.2.1.val) * SAK + c * BLOCK_CS * SAS)⟩) ∧
  (∀ rg o, s.undef rg o = 0) ∧ (s.mem = s0.mem)

set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000 in
/-- **preLoop** (statements 0–14): from a clean input state (`undef = 0`), the
prologue steps to a state satisfying `bbwdInvariant … 0` — the base case
(`acc = 0`, pointers seeded with the batch offset). -/

name: bbwdStoreActive
text:
private def bbwdStoreActive (PM PN BM BN CSL K : Nat) (idx : TileIndex [BM, BN]) : Prop :=
  rowIndex PM BM idx.1 < CSL ∧ colIndex PN BN idx.2.1 < K

name: bbwdWriteOk
text:
def bbwdWriteOk (PM PN BM BN CSL K : Nat) (j : Nat) : Prop :=
  PM * BM + j / BN < CSL ∧ PN * BN + j % BN < K

name: bbwdMInv
text:
private noncomputable def bbwdMInv (Dout A : RegionName) (s0 : BlockState)
    (PB PC PH PM PN chunk_size BM BN SDB SDC SDH SDN SDM SAB SAS SAH SAK
      BLOCK_CS numCSBlocks K : Nat) (c : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  s.pids = s0.pids ∧ c ≤ numCSBlocks ∧
  (s.regs .real [BM, BN] "acc" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BM, BN] =>
      some (bbwdMaskedPartial s0 Dout A PB PC PH PM PN BM BN chunk_size SDB SDC SDH SDN SDM
        SAB SAS SAH SAK BLOCK_CS K idx.1 idx.2.1 c)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [] "pid_b" = some (Tile.scalar PB)) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [] "pid_c" = some (Tile.scalar PC)) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [] "pid_h" = some (Tile.scalar PH)) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [] "pid_m" = some (Tile.scalar PM)) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [] "pid_n" = some (Tile.scalar PN)) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [BM] "offs_m" = some (Tile.vec (fun i : Fin BM => PM * BM + i.val))) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [BN] "offs_n" = some (Tile.vec (fun j : Fin BN => PN * BN + j.val))) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [BLOCK_CS] "offs_cs" = some (Tile.vec (fun e : Fin BLOCK_CS => e.val))) ∧
  (s.regs .ptr [BM, BLOCK_CS] "dout_ptrs" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BM, BLOCK_CS] =>
      (Dout.cast, doutOff PB PC PH SDB SDC SDH + (PM * BM + idx.1.val) * SDN
        + idx.2.1.val * SDM + c * BLOCK_CS * SDM)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .ptr [BLOCK_CS, BN] "a_ptrs" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BLOCK_CS, BN] =>
      (A.cast, batchOff PB PC PH chunk_size SAB SAS SAH + idx.1.val * SAS
        + (PN * BN + idx.2.1.val) * SAK + c * BLOCK_CS * SAS)⟩) ∧
  (∀ rg o, s.undef rg o = 0) ∧ (s.mem = s0.mem)

/-! ### The terminal masked store on the `R` side

`bbwd_postLoop` runs the six post-loop statements under the exact stepper, but
only for the all-live tile; the skin additionally needs (a) the `readMemAs .real`
readback at the `MemCell` layer, (b) the full outside-the-window frame, and (c)
the store's own mask kept as the active set. Since the store is `.real`-typed the
`R` run **is** the exact run (`bbwdIO_writeMemTypedR_real_eq`); the scatter is
re-derived here through the `writeMemAsR` readback / frame family. -/

/-- The terminal store's mask tile, evaluated: lane `(i, n)` is
`(offs_m i < CSL) && (offs_n n < K)`. The general (not all-true) sibling of
`dbmask_alltrue`. -/

name: bbwdSafeInv
text:
private def bbwdSafeInv (Dout A : RegionName)
    (PB PC PH PM PN chunk_size BM BN SDB SDC SDH SDN SDM SAB SAS SAH SAK BCS numCSBlocks : Nat)
    (c : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  c ≤ numCSBlocks ∧
  (s.regs .nat [] "pid_b" = some (Tile.scalar PB)) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [] "pid_c" = some (Tile.scalar PC)) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [] "pid_h" = some (Tile.scalar PH)) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [] "pid_m" = some (Tile.scalar PM)) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [] "pid_n" = some (Tile.scalar PN)) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [BM] "offs_m" = some (Tile.vec (fun i : Fin BM => PM * BM + i.val))) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [BN] "offs_n" = some (Tile.vec (fun j : Fin BN => PN * BN + j.val))) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [BCS] "offs_cs" = some (Tile.vec (fun e : Fin BCS => e.val))) ∧
  (∃ zT : Tile .real [BM, BN], s.regs .real [BM, BN] "acc" = some zT) ∧
  (s.regs .ptr [BM, BCS] "dout_ptrs" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BM, BCS] =>
      (Dout.cast, doutOff PB PC PH SDB SDC SDH + (PM * BM + idx.1.val) * SDN
        + idx.2.1.val * SDM + c * BCS * SDM)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .ptr [BCS, BN] "a_ptrs" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BCS, BN] =>
      (A.cast, batchOff PB PC PH chunk_size SAB SAS SAH + idx.1.val * SAS
        + (PN * BN + idx.2.1.val) * SAK + c * BCS * SAS)⟩)

set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000 in
/-- Weak `preLoop`: from an **arbitrary** state the 15-statement prologue steps
to a state satisfying `bbwdSafeInv … 0` (no clean-`undef` hypothesis; the value
half of `bbwd_preLoop` is dropped). -/

name: IO.inputMask
text:
def IO.inputMask {BM BN chunk : Nat} (io : IO BM BN chunk) :
    (ch : Fin 3) → Nat → Nat → Nat → TileIndex (inputShape BM BN chunk ch) → Prop
  | 0 => io.doutMask
  | 1 => io.aMask
  | 2 => fun p₀ p₁ p₂ i => io.hasResidual ∧ io.outputMask p₀ p₁ p₂ i

name: IO.Implements
text:
def IO.Implements {BM BN chunk : Nat} (io : IO BM BN chunk)
    (f : Nat → Nat → Nat → RealInputs.Inputs BM BN chunk → TileIndex [BM, BN] → ℝ) : Prop :=
  io.toU.Implements3D (fun p₀ p₁ p₂ vals _ j => f p₀ p₁ p₂ (io.inputs vals) ((TileShape.allIndices _).get j))

name: Pins
text:
structure Pins {BM BN chunk : Nat} (io : IO BM BN chunk) (s : BlockState)
    (xs : RealInputs.Inputs BM BN chunk) : Prop where
  dout : ∀ i k, io.doutMask (s.pids 0) (s.pids 1) (s.pids 2) (i,k,PUnit.unit) →
    s.readMem io.Dout (io.doutWindow (s.pids 0) (s.pids 1) (s.pids 2) (i,k,PUnit.unit)) = xs.dout i k
  a : ∀ k j, io.aMask (s.pids 0) (s.pids 1) (s.pids 2) (k,j,PUnit.unit) →
    s.readMem io.A (io.aWindow (s.pids 0) (s.pids 1) (s.pids 2) (k,j,PUnit.unit)) = xs.a k j
  residual : io.hasResidual → ∀ i j, io.outputMask (s.pids 0) (s.pids 1) (s.pids 2) (i,j,PUnit.unit) →
    s.readMem io.Res (io.residualWindow (s.pids 0) (s.pids 1) (s.pids 2) (i,j,PUnit.unit)) = xs.residual i j

name: Bounds
text:
structure Bounds {BM BN chunk : Nat} (io : IO BM BN chunk) (s : BlockState) (bounds : RegionBounds) : Prop where
  dout : ∀ i, io.doutMask (s.pids 0) (s.pids 1) (s.pids 2) i →
    io.doutWindow (s.pids 0) (s.pids 1) (s.pids 2) i < bounds io.Dout
  a : ∀ i, io.aMask (s.pids 0) (s.pids 1) (s.pids 2) i →
    io.aWindow (s.pids 0) (s.pids 1) (s.pids 2) i < bounds io.A
  residual : io.hasResidual → ∀ i, io.outputMask (s.pids 0) (s.pids 1) (s.pids 2) i →
    io.residualWindow (s.pids 0) (s.pids 1) (s.pids 2) i < bounds io.Res
  output : ∀ i, io.outputMask (s.pids 0) (s.pids 1) (s.pids 2) i →
    io.outputWindow (s.pids 0) (s.pids 1) (s.pids 2) i < bounds io.Db

name: Results
text:
structure Results {BM BN chunk : Nat} (io : IO BM BN chunk) (initial current : BlockState)
    (ys : TileIndex [BM, BN] → ℝ) : Prop where
  output : ∀ i, io.outputMask (initial.pids 0) (initial.pids 1) (initial.pids 2) i →
    current.readMem io.Db (io.outputWindow (initial.pids 0) (initial.pids 1) (initial.pids 2) i) = ys i
  frame : ∀ r a, (∀ i, io.outputMask (initial.pids 0) (initial.pids 1) (initial.pids 2) i →
    r ≠ io.Db ∨ a ≠ io.outputWindow (initial.pids 0) (initial.pids 1) (initial.pids 2) i) →
    current.mem r a = initial.mem r a

name: Holds
text:
structure Holds (s₀ : BlockState) (BM BN BCS : Nat) (p : RealProgram.Parameters)
    (c : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop where
  count : c ≤ RealMath.blocks (RealSetup.limit s₀ p) BCS
  mem : s.mem = s₀.mem
  undef : s.undef = s₀.undef
  pids : s.pids = s₀.pids
  numPids : s.numPids = s₀.numPids
  fixed : ∀ dtype shape name, name ∉ writes → s.regs dtype shape name =
    (RealSetup.result s₀ BM BN BCS p).regs dtype shape name
  dout : s.regs .ptr [BM, BCS] "dout_ptrs" = some (dPointers s₀ BM BN BCS p c)
  a : s.regs .ptr [BCS, BN] "a_ptrs" = some (aPointers s₀ BN BCS p c)
  acc : s.regs .real [BM, BN] "acc" = some (Tile.mat fun i j => some (carry s₀ BM BN BCS p c i j))

name: Bounds
text:
structure Bounds (s : BlockState) (BM BN : Nat) (p : RealProgram.Parameters) (bounds : RegionBounds) : Prop where
  dout : ∀ (i : Fin BM) (k : Nat), RealSetup.rows s BM BN p i < p.chunk → k < RealSetup.limit s p →
    RealSetup.dBase s p + (RealSetup.rows s BM BN p i * p.dColumn + k * p.dRow) < bounds p.Dout
  a : ∀ (k : Nat) (j : Fin BN), k < RealSetup.limit s p → RealSetup.columns s BN p j < p.K →
    RealSetup.aBase s p + (k * p.aRow + RealSetup.columns s BN p j * p.aColumn) < bounds p.A

name: active
Bounds
text:
structure Bounds (s : BlockState) (BM BN : Nat) (p : RealProgram.Parameters) (bounds : RegionBounds) : Prop
    extends RealLoopSafety.Bounds s BM BN p bounds where
  residual : p.hasResidual → ∀ i, RealMemory.active s BM BN p i →
    RealMemory.address s BM BN p p.rBatch p.rRow p.rHead p.rColumn i < bounds p.Res
  output : ∀ i, RealMemory.active s BM BN p i →
    RealMemory.address s BM BN p p.oBatch p.oRow p.oHead p.oColumn i < bounds p.Db

OutputDistinct
text:
def OutputDistinct (BM BN : Nat) (p : RealProgram.Parameters) : Prop :=
  ∀ pid₀ pid₁ pid₂ a b,
    row BM BN p pid₀ a.1 < length p pid₂ ∧ column BN p pid₀ a.2.1 < p.K →
    row BM BN p pid₀ b.1 < length p pid₂ ∧ column BN p pid₀ b.2.1 < p.K →
    offset BM BN p p.oBatch p.oRow p.oHead p.oColumn pid₀ pid₁ pid₂ a =
      offset BM BN p p.oBatch p.oRow p.oHead p.oColumn pid₀ pid₁ pid₂ b → a = b

name: bmmInvariant
text:
noncomputable def bmmInvariant
    (A B : RegionName) (s0 : BlockState)
    (PB PC PH PM PN chunk_size BM BN SAB SAS SAH SAK SBB SBS SBH SBK BLOCK_K numKBlocks : Nat)
    (c : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  s.pids = s0.pids ∧ c ≤ numKBlocks ∧
  (s.regs .real [BM, BN] "acc" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BM, BN] =>
      some (accPartial s0 A B PB PC PH PM PN BM BN chunk_size SAB SAS SAH SAK SBB SBS SBH SBK BLOCK_K idx.1 idx.2.1 c)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [] "pid_b" = some (Tile.scalar PB)) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [] "pid_c" = some (Tile.scalar PC)) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [] "pid_h" = some (Tile.scalar PH)) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [] "pid_m" = some (Tile.scalar PM)) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [] "pid_n" = some (Tile.scalar PN)) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [BM] "offs_m" = some (Tile.vec (fun i : Fin BM => PM * BM + i.val))) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [BN] "offs_n" = some (Tile.vec (fun j : Fin BN => PN * BN + j.val))) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [BLOCK_K] "offs_k" = some (Tile.vec (fun e : Fin BLOCK_K => e.val))) ∧
  (s.regs .ptr [BM, BLOCK_K] "a_ptrs" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BM, BLOCK_K] =>
      (A.cast, batchOff PB PC PH chunk_size SAB SAS SAH + (PM * BM + idx.1.val) * SAS + idx.2.1.val * SAK + c * BLOCK_K * SAK)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .ptr [BLOCK_K, BN] "b_ptrs" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BLOCK_K, BN] =>
      (B.cast, batchOff PB PC PH chunk_size SBB SBS SBH + idx.1.val * SBK + (PN * BN + idx.2.1.val) * SBS + c * BLOCK_K * SBK)⟩) ∧
  (∀ rg o, s.undef rg o = 0) ∧ (s.mem = s0.mem)

set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000 in
/-- **preLoop** (statements 0–14): from a clean input state (`undef = 0`), the
prologue steps to a state satisfying `bmmInvariant … 0` — the base case
(`acc = 0`, pointers seeded with the batch offset). -/

name: BmmSafeCtx
text:
private structure BmmSafeCtx (A B : RegionName)
    (PB PC PH PM PN chunk_size BM BN SAB SAS SAH SAK SBB SBS SBH SBK BK : Nat)
    (c : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop where
  regPidB : s.regs .nat [] "pid_b" = some (Tile.scalar PB)
  regPidC : s.regs .nat [] "pid_c" = some (Tile.scalar PC)
  regPidH : s.regs .nat [] "pid_h" = some (Tile.scalar PH)
  regPidM : s.regs .nat [] "pid_m" = some (Tile.scalar PM)
  regPidN : s.regs .nat [] "pid_n" = some (Tile.scalar PN)
  regOffsM : s.regs .nat [BM] "offs_m" = some (Tile.vec (fun i : Fin BM => PM * BM + i.val))
  regOffsN : s.regs .nat [BN] "offs_n" = some (Tile.vec (fun j : Fin BN => PN * BN + j.val))
  regOffsK : s.regs .nat [BK] "offs_k" = some (Tile.vec (fun e : Fin BK => e.val))
  regAPtrs : s.regs .ptr [BM, BK] "a_ptrs" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BM, BK] =>
    (A.cast, batchOff PB PC PH chunk_size SAB SAS SAH + (PM * BM + idx.1.val) * SAS
      + idx.2.1.val * SAK + c * BK * SAK)⟩
  regBPtrs : s.regs .ptr [BK, BN] "b_ptrs" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BK, BN] =>
    (B.cast, batchOff PB PC PH chunk_size SBB SBS SBH + idx.1.val * SBK
      + (PN * BN + idx.2.1.val) * SBS + c * BK * SBK)⟩
  regAcc : ∃ t : Tile .real [BM, BN], s.regs .real [BM, BN] "acc" = some t

set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000 in
/-- **Weak preLoop**: from an *arbitrary* state the 15 prologue statements step
successfully to a `BmmSafeCtx` state at K-block `0`. The value half of
`bmm_preLoop` (clean `undef`, `mem = s.mem`, `acc = 0`) is dropped. -/

text:
def bmmInv (s0 : BlockState) (A B O : RegionName)
    (M N K TILE_M TILE_N TILE_K GROUP_M : Nat) (c : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  s.pids = s0.pids ∧ s.mem = s0.mem ∧ (∀ rg o, s.undef rg o = 0) ∧
  c ≤ bmmNI K TILE_K ∧
  s.regs .nat [] "num_iters" = some (Tile.scalar (bmmNI K TILE_K)) ∧
  s.regs .bool [TILE_M] "mask_m"
    = some ⟨fun i => decide (bmmRowG s0 TILE_M GROUP_M i.1.val < M)⟩ ∧
  s.regs .bool [TILE_N] "mask_n"
    = some ⟨fun j => decide (bmmColG s0 TILE_N GROUP_M j.1.val < N)⟩ ∧
  s.regs .nat [TILE_K] "offs_k"
    = some (Tile.vec fun r => c * TILE_K + r.val) ∧
  s.regs .ptr [TILE_M, TILE_K] "a_ptrs"
    = some ⟨fun idx => (A, s0.pids 2 * M * K
        + bmmRowG s0 TILE_M GROUP_M idx.1.val * K
        + (c * TILE_K + idx.2.1.val))⟩ ∧
  s.regs .ptr [TILE_K, TILE_N] "b_ptrs"
    = some ⟨fun idx => (B, s0.pids 2 * K * N
        + (c * TILE_K + idx.1.val) * N
        + bmmColG s0 TILE_N GROUP_M idx.2.1.val)⟩ ∧
  s.regs .ptr [TILE_M, TILE_N] "o_ptrs"
    = some ⟨fun idx => (O, bmmOOffset s0 M N TILE_M TILE_N GROUP_M idx)⟩ ∧
  s.regs .real [TILE_M, TILE_N] "o"
    = some ⟨fun idx => some (bmmAcc s0 A B M N K TILE_K c
        (bmmRowG s0 TILE_M GROUP_M idx.1.val)
        (bmmColG s0 TILE_N GROUP_M idx.2.1.val))⟩

name: IO.Bounds
text:
structure IO.Bounds {p : Layout} (io : IO p) (bounds : RegionBounds)
    (N pid : Nat) (xs : Inputs p.H N) : Prop where
  metadata : ∀ i : Fin p.B, token p pid i < N → io.readMetadata (token p pid i) < bounds p.metadata.cast
  cos : ∀ i : TileIndex [p.B,p.H], ∀ ha : token p pid i.1 < N,
    io.read (xs.rows ⟨token p pid i.1, ha⟩).toNat i.2.1 < bounds p.cos
  sin : ∀ i : TileIndex [p.B,p.H], ∀ ha : token p pid i.1 < N,
    io.read (xs.rows ⟨token p pid i.1, ha⟩).toNat i.2.1 < bounds p.sin
  cosOut : ∀ i : TileIndex [p.B,p.H], token p pid i.1 < N →
    io.write (token p pid i.1) i.2.1 < bounds p.cosOut
  sinOut : ∀ i : TileIndex [p.B,p.H], token p pid i.1 < N →
    io.write (token p pid i.1) i.2.1 < bounds p.sinOut

name: IO.Pins
text:
structure IO.Pins {p : Layout} (io : IO p) (s : BlockState) (N : Nat) (xs : Inputs p.H N) : Prop where
  metadata : ∀ i : Fin p.B, ∀ ha : token p (s.pids 0) i < N,
    s.readMemValue .int p.metadata.cast (io.readMetadata (token p (s.pids 0) i)) =
      xs.rows ⟨token p (s.pids 0) i, ha⟩
  cos : ∀ i : TileIndex [p.B,p.H], ∀ ha : token p (s.pids 0) i.1 < N,
    s.readMem p.cos (io.read (xs.rows ⟨token p (s.pids 0) i.1, ha⟩).toNat i.2.1) =
      (expected xs ⟨token p (s.pids 0) i.1, ha⟩ i.2.1).1
  sin : ∀ i : TileIndex [p.B,p.H], ∀ ha : token p (s.pids 0) i.1 < N,
    s.readMem p.sin (io.read (xs.rows ⟨token p (s.pids 0) i.1, ha⟩).toNat i.2.1) =
      (expected xs ⟨token p (s.pids 0) i.1, ha⟩ i.2.1).2

/-- Successful flat execution, both active output tiles and preservation of
all other typed cells. Metadata loads remain active even if H = 0. The current
flat bridge requires zero unspecified values; no output equation is assumed. -/

name: IO.Implements
text:
def IO.Implements {p : Layout} (io : IO p) (N : Nat)
    (f : Inputs p.H N → Fin N → Fin p.H → ℝ × ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ A : FlatAlloc, A.Disjoint →
    A.regions = [p.cos, p.sin, p.metadata.cast, p.cosOut, p.sinOut] →
    (∀ r, r ∉ A.regions → A.extent r = 0) →
  ∀ (s : BlockState) (xs : Inputs p.H N),
    (∀ i : Fin p.B, ∀ ha : token p (s.pids 0) i < N, 0 ≤ xs.rows ⟨token p (s.pids 0) i, ha⟩) →
    s.undef = (fun _ _ => 0) → io.Bounds A.extent N (s.pids 0) xs → io.Pins s N xs →
    ∃ final, exec (A.flattenKernel io.kernel.toAlgKernel) (A.flattenState s) = some final ∧
      (∀ i : TileIndex [p.B,p.H], ∀ ha : token p (s.pids 0) i.1 < N,
        final.readMem A.flat (A.addr p.cosOut (io.write (token p (s.pids 0) i.1) i.2.1)) =
          (f xs ⟨token p (s.pids 0) i.1, ha⟩ i.2.1).1 ∧
        final.readMem A.flat (A.addr p.sinOut (io.write (token p (s.pids 0) i.1) i.2.1)) =
          (f xs ⟨token p (s.pids 0) i.1, ha⟩ i.2.1).2) ∧
      (∀ r o, (r ≠ A.flat ∨ ∀ i : TileIndex [p.B,p.H], token p (s.pids 0) i.1 < N →
        o ≠ A.addr p.cosOut (io.write (token p (s.pids 0) i.1) i.2.1) ∧
        o ≠ A.addr p.sinOut (io.write (token p (s.pids 0) i.1) i.2.1)) →
        final.mem r o = (A.flattenState s).mem r o)

name: IO.Bounds
text:
structure IO.Bounds {p : Layout} {N : Nat} (io : IO p N) (bounds : RegionBounds)
    (total token selected : Nat) : Prop where
  metadata : ∀ i, io.readMetadata i < bounds p.metadata.cast
  cos : ∀ i, token < total → io.read selected i < bounds p.cos
  sin : ∀ i, token < total → io.read selected i < bounds p.sin
  cosOut : ∀ i, token < total → io.write token i < bounds p.cosOut
  sinOut : ∀ i, token < total → io.write token i < bounds p.sinOut

name: IO.Pins
text:
structure IO.Pins {p : Layout} {N : Nat} (io : IO p N) (s : BlockState)
    (total token : Nat) (hN : 0 < N) (xs : Inputs p.H N) : Prop where
  metadata : ∀ j, s.readMemValue .int p.metadata.cast (io.readMetadata j) = xs.ends j
  cos : ∀ i, token < total → s.readMem p.cos (io.read (row hN token xs) i) = (expected hN token xs i).1
  sin : ∀ i, token < total → s.readMem p.sin (io.read (row hN token xs) i) = (expected hN token xs i).2

/-- One complete launch program in flat memory. Metadata is unmasked; both
stores share the token predicate. The full-cell frame includes inactive lanes
and unrelated allocations. `undef = 0` is the current flat-bridge premise;
the typed FP execution theorem itself permits arbitrary unspecified values. -/

name: IO.Implements
text:
def IO.Implements {p : Layout} {N : Nat} (io : IO p N) (total : Nat) (hN : 0 < N)
    (f : Nat → Inputs p.H N → Fin p.H → ℝ × ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ A : FlatAlloc, A.Disjoint →
    A.regions = [p.cos, p.sin, p.metadata.cast, p.cosOut, p.sinOut] →
    (∀ r, r ∉ A.regions → A.extent r = 0) →
  ∀ (s : BlockState) (xs : Inputs p.H N),
    s.undef = (fun _ _ => 0) →
    io.Bounds A.extent total (s.pids 0 * p.B + s.pids 1) (row hN (s.pids 0 * p.B + s.pids 1) xs) →
    io.Pins s total (s.pids 0 * p.B + s.pids 1) hN xs →
    ∃ final, exec (A.flattenKernel io.kernel.toAlgKernel) (A.flattenState s) = some final ∧
      (∀ i, s.pids 0 * p.B + s.pids 1 < total →
        final.readMem A.flat (A.addr p.cosOut (io.write (s.pids 0 * p.B + s.pids 1) i)) =
          (f (s.pids 0 * p.B + s.pids 1) xs i).1 ∧
        final.readMem A.flat (A.addr p.sinOut (io.write (s.pids 0 * p.B + s.pids 1) i)) =
          (f (s.pids 0 * p.B + s.pids 1) xs i).2) ∧
      (∀ r o, (r ≠ A.flat ∨ ∀ i, s.pids 0 * p.B + s.pids 1 < total →
        o ≠ A.addr p.cosOut (io.write (s.pids 0 * p.B + s.pids 1) i) ∧
        o ≠ A.addr p.sinOut (io.write (s.pids 0 * p.B + s.pids 1) i)) →
        final.mem r o = (A.flattenState s).mem r o)

    (metadata : Region .int) (cosOut sinOut : RegionName)
    (rowStride hiddenStride total H N B : Nat) (s : BlockState) (hN : 0 < N) : Prop where
  metadataBound : ∀ i : Fin N, i.val < bounds metadata.cast
  cos : ∀ i : Fin H, s.pids 0 * B + s.pids 1 < total →
    prefillRead metadata rowStride hiddenStride N B s hN i.val < bounds cos

  sinOut : ∀ i : Fin H, s.pids 0 * B + s.pids 1 < total →

def IO.Implements {p : Layout} (io : IO p) (f : Launch → Inputs → Outputs p) : Prop :=
  ∀ A : FlatAlloc, A.Disjoint → (∀ r, r ∉ A.regions → A.extent r = 0) →

        final.readMem A.flat (A.addr io.dg (io.dgWindow (RealLoop.launch s) i)) =

name: surfaceInv
text:
def surfaceInv (s : BlockState) (S O : RegionName) (T BT : Nat) :
    Nat → BlockState → Prop :=
  fun c sc =>
    sc.pids = s.pids ∧
    (∀ a, sc.readMem S a = s.readMem S a) ∧
    sc.regs .nat [] "i_bh" = some (Tile.scalar (s.pids 0)) ∧
    sc.regs .real [] "b_z" = some (Tile.scalar (some (surfaceCarry s S T BT c))) ∧
    (∀ flat, flat < c * BT → flat < T →
      sc.readMem O (s.pids 0 * T + flat) = surfaceClosed s S T flat) ∧
    sc.undef = s.undef

chunk `c` (with `i_t := c`) preserves `surfaceInv`, advancing it to `c+1`. -/

      head * p.headStride + u * p.timeStride + (feature * p.BS + j.val) * p.channelStride →

structure Outputs (p : Layout) (l : Launch) (r : Regions) (a : Inputs) (a₀ : Nat → ℝ)
    (useSeed storeFinal : Bool) (v : BlockState) : Prop where
  history : ∀ (c : Nat) (e : Fin p.BK) (j : Fin p.BV), c < p.NT →
    RealStateStore.active p l e.val j.val →
    v.readMem r.history (RealOuterStep.historyAddress p l c e.val j.val) =
      RealWindow.expected p l a (RealInit.seed p l a₀) useSeed c e.val (valueIndex p l j.val)
  corrected : ∀ (t : Nat) (j : Fin p.BV), activeValue p l t j.val →
    v.readMem r.corrected (valueAddress p l t j.val) =
      RealMath.corrected (RealValues.arrays p l a (RealInit.seed p l a₀)) p.K
        (RealWindow.expected p l a (RealInit.seed p l a₀) useSeed (t / p.BT)) t (valueIndex p l j.val)
  final : storeFinal = Bool.true → ∀ (e : Fin p.BK) (j : Fin p.BV), RealStateStore.active p l e.val j.val →
    v.readMem r.final (RealStateStore.address p l (RealInit.base p l) p.V e.val j.val) =
      RealWindow.expected p l a (RealInit.seed p l a₀) useSeed p.NT e.val (valueIndex p l j.val)

    RealStateStore.active p l e.val j.val →
    v.readMem A.flat (A.addr r.history (RealOuterStep.historyAddress p l c e.val j.val)) =
      RealWindow.expected p l a (RealInit.seed p l a₀) useSeed c e.val (valueIndex p l j.val)
  corrected : ∀ (t : Nat) (j : Fin p.BV), activeValue p l t j.val →
    v.readMem A.flat (A.addr r.corrected (valueAddress p l t j.val)) =
      RealMath.corrected (RealValues.arrays p l a (RealInit.seed p l a₀)) p.K
        (RealWindow.expected p l a (RealInit.seed p l a₀) useSeed (t / p.BT)) t (valueIndex p l j.val)
  final : storeFinal = Bool.true → ∀ (e : Fin p.BK) (j : Fin p.BV), RealStateStore.active p l e.val j.val →
    v.readMem A.flat (A.addr r.final (RealStateStore.address p l (RealInit.base p l) p.V e.val j.val)) =
      RealWindow.expected p l a (RealInit.seed p l a₀) useSeed p.NT e.val (valueIndex p l j.val)

name: IO.Implements
text:
def IO.Implements {p : Layout} (io : IO p)
    (f : Launch → Inputs → (Nat → ℝ) → Outputs p) : Prop :=
  ∀ A : FlatAlloc, A.Disjoint → (∀ r, r ∉ A.regions → A.extent r = 0) →
  ∀ s : BlockState, s.undef = (fun _ _ => 0) → io.valid s → io.bounds s A.extent →
    ∃ v, exec (A.flattenKernel io.kernel.toAlgKernel) (A.flattenState s) = some v ∧
      (∀ c e j, c < p.NT → io.stateMask (RealInit.launch s) e j →
        v.readMem A.flat (A.addr io.history (io.historyWindow (RealInit.launch s) c e j)) =
          (f (RealInit.launch s) (io.read s) (io.seed s)).history c e j) ∧
      (∀ t j, io.valueMask (RealInit.launch s) t j →
        v.readMem A.flat (A.addr io.corrected (io.valueWindow (RealInit.launch s) t j)) =
          (f (RealInit.launch s) (io.read s) (io.seed s)).corrected t j) ∧
      (io.storeFinal = Bool.true → ∀ e j, io.stateMask (RealInit.launch s) e j →
        v.readMem A.flat (A.addr io.final (io.finalWindow (RealInit.launch s) e j)) =
          (f (RealInit.launch s) (io.read s) (io.seed s)).final e j) ∧
      BlockState.WriteWithin (io.writes A (RealInit.launch s)) (A.flattenState s) v

  value : u.regs .nat [] "i_v" = some (Tile.scalar l.value)
  head : u.regs .nat [] "i_bh" = some (Tile.scalar l.head)
  state : ∃ f : StateValue p, u.regs .real [p.BK,p.BV] "b_h" = some (stateTile p f) ∧
    RealValues.Represents p l f (RealWindow.expected p l a seed useSeed c)
  inputKey : ∀ off, u.readMem r.key off = a.key off
  inputDelta : ∀ off, u.readMem r.delta off = a.delta off
  inputValue : ∀ off, u.readMem r.value off = a.value off

    RealStateStore.active p l e.val j.val →
    u.readMem r.history (RealOuterStep.historyAddress p l q e.val j.val) =
      RealWindow.expected p l a seed useSeed q e.val (valueIndex p l j.val)
  corrected : ∀ (q t : Nat) (j : Fin p.BV), q < c → activeValue p l t j.val →
    q * p.BT ≤ t → t < (q + 1) * p.BT →
    u.readMem r.corrected (valueAddress p l t j.val) =
      RealMath.corrected (RealValues.arrays p l a seed) p.K
        (RealWindow.expected p l a seed useSeed q) t (valueIndex p l j.val)

  target : u.regs .ptr [p.BK,p.BV] "DI" = some (backwardPointer p l DI (p.N-2) k)

  gate : u.regs .ptr [] "D" = some (backwardGate p l D k)
  carry : u.regs .real [p.BK,p.BV] "Dacc" = some (tile p (RealMath.reverse a p.N (p.N-k)))
  inputSource : ∀ (t : Nat) (e : Fin p.BK) (j : Fin p.BV), t < p.N-1 →
    u.readMem S (address p l t e.val j.val) = a.source t e j
  inputIncoming : ∀ (t : Nat) (e : Fin p.BK) (j : Fin p.BV), t < p.N →

    u.readMem DI (address p l t e.val j.val) = RealMath.reverse a p.N (t+1) e j
  outputDG : ∀ t, p.N-1-k ≤ t → t < p.N-1 →
    u.readMem DG (gradientAddress p l t) = RealMath.gateGradient a p.N t
  frame : BlockState.WriteWithin (footprint p l DI DG) initial u

name: ForwardIO.Implements
text:
def ForwardIO.Implements {p : Layout} (io : ForwardIO p) (f : ForwardInputs p → Nat → Values p) : Prop :=
  ∀ A : FlatAlloc, A.Disjoint → (∀ r, r ∉ A.regions → A.extent r = 0) →
  ∀ s : BlockState, io.bounds s A.extent →
    ∃ v, exec (A.flattenKernel io.kernel.toAlgKernel) (A.flattenState s) = some v ∧
      (∀ t e j, t < p.N → v.readMem A.flat (A.addr io.output (io.write (launch s) t e j)) =
        f (io.read s) t e j) ∧
      BlockState.WriteWithin (io.writes A (launch s)) (A.flattenState s) v

name: BackwardIO.Implements
text:
def BackwardIO.Implements {p : Layout} (io : BackwardIO p) (f : BackwardInputs p → BackwardOutputs p) : Prop :=
  ∀ A : FlatAlloc, A.Disjoint → (∀ r, r ∉ A.regions → A.extent r = 0) →
  ∀ s : BlockState, io.bounds s A.extent →
    ∃ v, exec (A.flattenKernel io.kernel.toAlgKernel) (A.flattenState s) = some v ∧
      (∀ t e j, t < p.N-1 → v.readMem A.flat (A.addr io.inputGradient (io.writeInput (launch s) t e j)) =
        (f (io.read s)).inputGradient t e j) ∧
      (∀ t, t < p.N-1 → v.readMem A.flat (A.addr io.gateGradient (io.writeGate (launch s) t)) =
        (f (io.read s)).gateGradient t) ∧
      (∀ e j, v.readMem A.flat (A.addr io.seedGradient (io.writeSeed (launch s) e j)) =
        (f (io.read s)).seedGradient e j) ∧
      BlockState.WriteWithin (io.writes A (launch s)) (A.flattenState s) v

name: IO.Implements
text:
def IO.Implements {p : Layout} (io : IO p) (f : Launch → Inputs → Outputs p) : Prop :=
  ∀ A : FlatAlloc, A.Disjoint → (∀ r, r ∉ A.regions → A.extent r = 0) →
  ∀ s : BlockState, s.undef = (fun _ _ => 0) → io.valid s → io.bounds s A.extent →
    ∃ v, exec (A.flattenKernel io.kernel.toAlgKernel) (A.flattenState s) = some v ∧
      (∀ c e j, c < p.NT → io.stateMask (launch s) e j →
        v.readMem A.flat (A.addr io.history (io.historyWindow (launch s) c e j)) =
          (f (launch s) (io.read s)).history c e j) ∧
      (io.storeFinal = Bool.true → ∀ e j, io.stateMask (launch s) e j →
        v.readMem A.flat (A.addr io.final (io.finalWindow (launch s) e j)) =
          (f (launch s) (io.read s)).final e j) ∧
      BlockState.WriteWithin (io.writes A (launch s)) (A.flattenState s) v

name: IO.Implements
text:
def IO.Implements {G I X : Type} (io : IO G I X) (f : G → I → X → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ A : FlatAlloc, A.Disjoint → (∀ r, r ∉ A.regions → A.extent r = 0) →
  ∀ s : BlockState, s.undef = (fun _ _ => 0) → io.valid s → io.bounds s A.extent →
    ∃ t, exec (A.flattenKernel io.kernel.toAlgKernel) (A.flattenState s) = some t ∧
      (∀ i, io.mask (io.grid s) i →
        t.readMem A.flat (A.addr io.out (io.write (io.grid s) i)) = f (io.grid s) (io.read s) i) ∧
      BlockState.WriteWithin (io.writes A (io.grid s)) (A.flattenState s) t

name: cgfInv
text:
noncomputable def cgfInv (s0 : BlockState) (q g h : RegionName)
    (s_k_h s_k_t s_h_h s_h_t : Nat) (scale : ℝ) (T K V BT BK BV : Nat)
    (i : Nat) (t : BlockState) : Prop :=
  i ≤ numKB K BK
  ∧ t.mem = s0.mem
  ∧ t.pids = s0.pids
  ∧ t.regs .nat [] "i_v" = some (Tile.scalar (s0.pids 0))
  ∧ t.regs .nat [] "i_t" = some (Tile.scalar (s0.pids 1))
  ∧ t.regs .nat [] "i_bh" = some (Tile.scalar (s0.pids 2))
  ∧ t.regs .bool [BT, BT] "m_s" = some (cgfMsTile BT)
  ∧ t.regs .real [BT, BV] "b_o"
      = some (cgfAccTile s0 q g h s_k_h s_k_t s_h_h s_h_t scale T K V BT BK BV i)
  ∧ t.undef = (fun _ _ => 0)

/-- The loop combinator writes `i_k` before each iteration; `cgfInv` constrains no
register of that name, so it survives the write. -/

  advance : 0 ≤ a.start l.batch
  start : l.batch < extent r.start
  sequence : l.batch < extent r.sequence
  query : ∀ (i : Fin p.BM) (d : Fin p.D), (queryRow p l i.val : Int) < Formula.sequence p l a →
    inside (queryAddress p l a i.val d.val) (extent r.query)
  key : ∀ c, c < count p l a → ∀ (j : Fin p.BN) (d : Fin p.D),
    ((c*p.BN+j.val : Nat) : Int) < Formula.sequence p l a →
    inside (keyAddress p l a (c*p.BN+j.val) d.val) (extent r.key)
  value : ∀ c, c < count p l a → ∀ (j : Fin p.BN) (d : Fin p.D),
    ((c*p.BN+j.val : Nat) : Int) < Formula.sequence p l a →
    inside (valueAddress p l a (c*p.BN+j.val) d.val) (extent r.value)
  output : ∀ (i : Fin p.BM) (d : Fin p.D), (queryRow p l i.val : Int) < Formula.sequence p l a →
    inside (outputAddress p l a i.val d.val) (extent r.out)

name: activeLane
text:
def activeLane (p : Layout) (r : Regions) (u : BlockState) (i : TileIndex [p.BM,p.D]) : Prop :=
  (queryRow p (launch u) i.1.val : Int) < sequence p (launch u) (inputs u r)

name: Writes
text:
def Writes (p : Layout) (r : Regions) (u : BlockState) (R : RegionName) (off : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ i, activeLane p r u i ∧ r.out = R ∧ offset p r u i = off

/-- Complete successful execution, active formula readback, and preservation of
all other tagged memory cells. Injectivity is only required for active writes. -/

name: Static
text:
structure Static (p : Layout) (r : Regions) (initial state : BlockState) : Prop where
  memory : state.mem = initial.mem
  pids : state.pids = initial.pids
  batch : state.regs .nat [] "cur_batch" = some (Tile.scalar (initial.pids 0))
  head : state.regs .nat [] "cur_head" = some (Tile.scalar (initial.pids 1))
  start : state.regs .int [] "cur_batch_in_all_start_index" =
    some (Tile.scalar ((inputs initial r).start (initial.pids 0)))
  sequence : state.regs .int [] "cur_batch_seq_len" =
    some (Tile.scalar (Formula.sequence p (launch initial) (inputs initial r)))
  rows : state.regs .nat [p.BM] "offs_m" =
    some (Tile.vec (fun i => queryRow p (launch initial) i.val))
  lanes : state.regs .nat [p.BN] "offs_n" = some (Tile.vec (fun j => j.val))
  channels : state.regs .nat [p.D] "offs_d" = some (Tile.vec (fun d => d.val))
  query : state.regs .real [p.BM,p.D] "q" =
    some (Tile.mat (dtype := .real) (fun i d => some (Formula.query p (launch initial) (inputs initial r) i.val d.val)))
  key_ptrs : state.regs .ptr [p.D,p.BN] "k_ptrs" =
    some (Tile.mat (fun d j => (Region.cast r.key,
      j.val*p.kRow+(initial.pids 1)*p.kHead+d.val*p.kDim)))
  value_ptrs : state.regs .ptr [p.BN,p.D] "v_ptrs" =
    some (Tile.mat (fun j d => (Region.cast r.value,
      j.val*p.vRow+(initial.pids 1)*p.vHead+d.val*p.vDim)))

name: Dynamic
text:
structure Dynamic (p : Layout) (r : Regions) (initial : BlockState) (scale : ℝ) (c : Nat)
    (state : BlockState) : Prop where
  centers : ∃ m : Fin p.BM → WithBot ℝ,
    state.regs .real [p.BM] "m_i" = some (Tile.vec m) ∧
    (∀ i, m i = ⊥ → c = 0) ∧
    state.regs .real [p.BM] "l_i" = some (denominatorTile p r initial scale c m)
  accumulator : state.regs .real [p.BM,p.D] "acc" = some (accumulatorTile p r initial scale c)

name: active
text:
def active (p : Layout) (l : Launch) (a : Inputs) (i : Lane p) : Prop :=
  (queryRow p l i.1.val : Int) < Formula.sequence p l a

name: valid
text:
def valid (p : Layout) (l : Launch) (a : Inputs) : Prop :=
  ∀ i j, active p l a i → active p l a j → write p l a i = write p l a j → i = j

name: IO.Implements
text:
def IO.Implements {p : Layout} (io : IO p) (f : Launch → Inputs → Lane p → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ A : FlatAlloc, A.Disjoint → (∀ r, r ∉ A.regions → A.extent r = 0) →
  ∀ s : BlockState, io.valid (launch s) (io.read s) → io.bounds (launch s) (io.read s) A.extent →
    ∃ v, exec (A.flattenKernel io.kernel.toAlgKernel) (A.flattenState s) = some v ∧
      (∀ i, io.mask (launch s) (io.read s) i →
        v.readMem A.flat (A.addr io.out (io.write (launch s) (io.read s) i)) = f (launch s) (io.read s) i) ∧
      BlockState.WriteWithin (io.writes A (launch s) (io.read s)) (A.flattenState s) v

name: Implements
text:
def Implements (io : StreamGroupedEmitMasked3DKernelIO)
    (f : Nat → Nat → Nat → (Fin io.nIn → Fin io.T → Fin io.B → ℝ) →
      Fin io.nOut → Fin io.T → Fin io.B → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ A : FlatAlloc,
    A.Disjoint →
    A.regions = io.bufs →
    (∀ r, r ∉ A.regions → A.extent r = 0) →
  ∀ pid₀ pid₁ pid₂ : Nat,
  ∀ (xs : Fin io.nIn → Fin io.T → Fin io.B → ℝ) (s₀ : BlockState),
    s₀.pids 0 = pid₀ →
    s₀.pids 1 = pid₁ →
    s₀.pids 2 = pid₂ →
    s₀.undef = (fun _ _ => 0) →
    (∀ (i : Fin io.nIn) (t : Fin io.T) (j : Fin io.B),
      io.readMask i pid₀ pid₁ pid₂ t j →
      io.read i pid₀ pid₁ pid₂ t j < A.extent (io.inp i)) →
    (∀ (o : Fin io.nOut) (t : Fin io.T) (j : Fin io.B),
      io.writeMask o pid₀ pid₁ pid₂ t j →
      io.write o pid₀ pid₁ pid₂ t j < A.extent (io.out o)) →
    (∀ (i : Fin io.nIn) (t : Fin io.T) (j : Fin io.B),
      io.readMask i pid₀ pid₁ pid₂ t j →
      s₀.readMem (io.inp i) (io.read i pid₀ pid₁ pid₂ t j) = xs i t j) →
    ∃ s',
      exec (A.flattenKernel io.kernel.toAlgKernel) (A.flattenState s₀)
        = some s'
      ∧ (∀ (o : Fin io.nOut) (t : Fin io.T) (j : Fin io.B),
          io.writeMask o pid₀ pid₁ pid₂ t j →
          s'.readMem A.flat
              (A.addr (io.out o) (io.write o pid₀ pid₁ pid₂ t j))
            = f pid₀ pid₁ pid₂ xs o t j)
      ∧ (∀ r' o',
          (r' ≠ A.flat ∨
            (∀ (o : Fin io.nOut) (t : Fin io.T) (j : Fin io.B),
              io.writeMask o pid₀ pid₁ pid₂ t j →
              o' ≠ A.addr (io.out o) (io.write o pid₀ pid₁ pid₂ t j))) →
          s'.mem r' o' = (A.flattenState s₀).mem r' o')

def Implements (io : StreamEmitMasked3DKernelIO₁)
    (f : Nat → Nat → Nat → (Fin io.T → Fin io.B1 → ℝ) →
      Fin io.T → Fin io.C → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ A : FlatAlloc,
    A.Disjoint →
    A.regions = [io.inp1, io.out] →
    (∀ r, r ∉ A.regions → A.extent r = 0) →
  ∀ pid₀ pid₁ pid₂ : Nat,
  ∀ (xs : Fin io.T → Fin io.B1 → ℝ)
    (s₀ : BlockState),
    s₀.pids 0 = pid₀ →
    s₀.pids 1 = pid₁ →
    s₀.pids 2 = pid₂ →
    s₀.undef = (fun _ _ => 0) →
    (∀ (t : Fin io.T) (j : Fin io.B1), io.mask1 pid₀ pid₁ pid₂ t j →
      io.read1 pid₀ pid₁ pid₂ t j < A.extent io.inp1) →
    (∀ (t : Fin io.T) (j : Fin io.C), io.writeMask pid₀ pid₁ pid₂ t j →
      io.write pid₀ pid₁ pid₂ t j < A.extent io.out) →
    (∀ (t : Fin io.T) (j : Fin io.B1), io.mask1 pid₀ pid₁ pid₂ t j →
      s₀.readMem io.inp1 (io.read1 pid₀ pid₁ pid₂ t j) = xs t j) →
    ∃ s',
      exec (A.flattenKernel io.kernel.toAlgKernel) (A.flattenState s₀)
        = some s'
      ∧ (∀ (t : Fin io.T) (j : Fin io.C), io.writeMask pid₀ pid₁ pid₂ t j →
          s'.readMem A.flat
              (A.addr io.out (io.write pid₀ pid₁ pid₂ t j))
            = f pid₀ pid₁ pid₂ xs t j)
      ∧ (∀ r' o',

              o' ≠ A.addr io.out (io.write pid₀ pid₁ pid₂ t j))) →
          s'.mem r' o' = (A.flattenState s₀).mem r' o')

/-- Reuse the streamed IO transport proof at identity rounding and real storage.
The resulting contract contains exact execution and real output readback. -/

name: active
text:
def active (s : BlockState) (DK BK : Nat) (i : Fin BK) : Prop :=
  elemIndex s BK i < DK

name: fwdInv
text:
noncomputable def fwdInv
    (G GO : RegionName) (s : BlockState) (s_qk_h DK BT BK : Nat) :
    Nat → BlockState → Prop :=
  fun m sc =>
    sc.pids = s.pids ∧
    (∀ a, sc.readMem G a = s.readMem G a) ∧
    sc.regs .real [BK] "cum_decay" = some (fwdCumTile s G s_qk_h DK BT BK m) ∧
    sc.regs .ptr [BK] "p_g" = some (fwdPgTile s G s_qk_h DK BT BK m) ∧
    sc.regs .ptr [BK] "p_go" = some (fwdPgoTile s GO s_qk_h DK BT BK m) ∧
    sc.regs .bool [BK] "mask" = some (fwdMaskTile s DK BK) ∧
    (∀ j, m ≤ j → ∀ i : Fin BK,
      sc.readMem GO (offset s s_qk_h DK j BT BK i) =
        s.readMem GO (offset s s_qk_h DK j BT BK i)) ∧
    (∀ j, j < m → ∀ i : Fin BK,
      sc.readMem GO (offset s s_qk_h DK j BT BK i) =
        if active s DK BK i then
          fwdPartial s G s_qk_h DK BT BK (j + 1) i
        else s.readMem GO (offset s s_qk_h DK j BT BK i))

name: prepInv
text:
noncomputable def prepInv
    (Q K G QG KG : RegionName) (s : BlockState) (s_qk_h DK BT BK : Nat) (scale : ℝ) :
    Nat → BlockState → Prop :=
  fun m sc =>
    sc.pids = s.pids ∧
    (∀ a, sc.readMem Q a = s.readMem Q a) ∧
    (∀ a, sc.readMem K a = s.readMem K a) ∧
    (∀ a, sc.readMem G a = s.readMem G a) ∧
    sc.regs .ptr [BK] "p_q" = some (prepPtrTile s Q s_qk_h DK BT BK m) ∧
    sc.regs .ptr [BK] "p_g" = some (prepPtrTile s G s_qk_h DK BT BK m) ∧
    sc.regs .ptr [BK] "p_k" = some (prepPtrTile s K s_qk_h DK BT BK m) ∧
    sc.regs .ptr [BK] "p_qg" = some (prepPtrTile s QG s_qk_h DK BT BK m) ∧
    sc.regs .ptr [BK] "p_kg" = some (prepPtrTile s KG s_qk_h DK BT BK m) ∧
    sc.regs .bool [BK] "mask" = some (fwdMaskTile s DK BK) ∧
    sc.regs .real [BK] "last_decay" = some (prepLastDecayTile s G s_qk_h DK BT BK) ∧
    (∀ j, m ≤ j → ∀ i : Fin BK,
      sc.readMem QG (offset s s_qk_h DK j BT BK i) =
        s.readMem QG (offset s s_qk_h DK j BT BK i)) ∧
    (∀ j, m ≤ j → ∀ i : Fin BK,
      sc.readMem KG (offset s s_qk_h DK j BT BK i) =
        s.readMem KG (offset s s_qk_h DK j BT BK i)) ∧
    (∀ j, j < m → ∀ i : Fin BK, ∀ (hj : j < BT),
      sc.readMem QG (offset s s_qk_h DK j BT BK i) =
        if active s DK BK i then
          prepareQgClosed s Q G s_qk_h DK BT BK ⟨j, hj⟩ i scale
        else s.readMem QG (offset s s_qk_h DK j BT BK i)) ∧
    (∀ j, j < m → ∀ i : Fin BK, ∀ (hj : j < BT),
      sc.readMem KG (offset s s_qk_h DK j BT BK i) =
        if active s DK BK i then
          prepareKgClosed s K G s_qk_h DK BT BK ⟨j, hj⟩ i
        else s.readMem KG (offset s s_qk_h DK j BT BK i))

name: BwdPrologueShapeG
text:
structure BwdPrologueShapeG (s s0 : BlockState)
    (DQInner DQInter DKInner DKInter Q K G DG : RegionName)
    (s_qk_h DK BT BK : Nat) : Prop where
  pid : s0.pids = s.pids
  mem : s0.mem = s.mem
  mask : s0.regs .bool [BK] "mask" = some (bwdMaskTileG s DK BK)
  cum : s0.regs .real [BK] "cum_grad_dg" = some (⟨fun _ => some 0⟩ : Tile .real [BK])
  lastg : s0.regs .real [BK] "last_g" = some (⟨fun _ => some 0⟩ : Tile .real [BK])
  pg : s0.regs .ptr [BK] "p_g" = some (bwdPtrTileG s G s_qk_h DK BT BK (BT - 1))
  pk : s0.regs .ptr [BK] "p_k" = some (bwdPtrTileG s K s_qk_h DK BT BK (BT - 1))
  pq : s0.regs .ptr [BK] "p_q" = some (bwdPtrTileG s Q s_qk_h DK BT BK (BT - 1))
  pdqi : s0.regs .ptr [BK] "p_dq_inner" = some (bwdPtrTileG s DQInner s_qk_h DK BT BK (BT - 1))

name: bwdInvG
text:
noncomputable def bwdInvG
    (DQInner DQInter DKInner DKInter Q K G DG : RegionName)
    (s : BlockState) (s_qk_h DK BT BK : Nat) :
    Nat → BlockState → Prop :=
  fun m sc =>
    sc.pids = s.pids ∧
    (∀ a, sc.readMem G a = s.readMem G a) ∧
    (∀ a, sc.readMem Q a = s.readMem Q a) ∧
    (∀ a, sc.readMem K a = s.readMem K a) ∧
    (∀ a, sc.readMem DQInner a = s.readMem DQInner a) ∧
    (∀ a, sc.readMem DKInner a = s.readMem DKInner a) ∧
    sc.regs .bool [BK] "mask" = some (bwdMaskTileG s DK BK) ∧
    sc.regs .real [BK] "cum_grad_dg" = some
      (bwdGatedG s DK BK (bwdCumPartialG s DQInner DQInter DKInner DKInter Q K G
        s_qk_h DK BT BK m)) ∧
    sc.regs .real [BK] "last_g" = some
      (bwdGatedG s DK BK (bwdLastgG s G s_qk_h DK BT BK m)) ∧
    sc.regs .ptr [BK] "p_g" = some (bwdPtrDecTileG s G s_qk_h DK BT BK m) ∧
    sc.regs .ptr [BK] "p_k" = some (bwdPtrDecTileG s K s_qk_h DK BT BK m) ∧
    sc.regs .ptr [BK] "p_q" = some (bwdPtrDecTileG s Q s_qk_h DK BT BK m) ∧
    sc.regs .ptr [BK] "p_dq_inner" = some (bwdPtrDecTileG s DQInner s_qk_h DK BT BK m) ∧
    sc.regs .ptr [BK] "p_dk_inner" = some (bwdPtrDecTileG s DKInner s_qk_h DK BT BK m) ∧
    sc.regs .ptr [BK] "p_dq_inter" = some (bwdPtrDecTileG s DQInter s_qk_h DK BT BK m) ∧
    sc.regs .ptr [BK] "p_dk_inter" = some (bwdPtrDecTileG s DKInter s_qk_h DK BT BK m) ∧
    sc.regs .ptr [BK] "p_dg" = some (bwdPtrDecTileG s DG s_qk_h DK BT BK m) ∧

    (∀ r, r < BT - m → ∀ i : Fin BK,
      sc.readMem DQInter (offset s s_qk_h DK r BT BK i)
        = s.readMem DQInter (offset s s_qk_h DK r BT BK i)) ∧
    (∀ r, r < BT - m → ∀ i : Fin BK,
      sc.readMem DKInter (offset s s_qk_h DK r BT BK i)
        = s.readMem DKInter (offset s s_qk_h DK r BT BK i)) ∧
    (∀ r, r < BT - m → ∀ i : Fin BK,
      sc.readMem DG (offset s s_qk_h DK r BT BK i)
        = s.readMem DG (offset s s_qk_h DK r BT BK i)) ∧
    
    (∀ r, BT - m ≤ r → r < BT → ∀ i : Fin BK,
      sc.readMem DQInter (offset s s_qk_h DK r BT BK i)
        = if active s DK BK i then
            bwdDqOutG s DQInner DQInter G s_qk_h DK BT BK r i
          else s.readMem DQInter (offset s s_qk_h DK r BT BK i)) ∧
    (∀ r, BT - m ≤ r → r < BT → ∀ i : Fin BK,
      sc.readMem DKInter (offset s s_qk_h DK r BT BK i)
        = if active s DK BK i then
            bwdDkOutG s DKInner DKInter G s_qk_h DK BT BK r
              (fun i' => s.readMem G (offset s s_qk_h DK (BT - 1) BT BK i')) i
          else s.readMem DKInter (offset s s_qk_h DK r BT BK i)) ∧
    (∀ r, BT - m ≤ r → r < BT → ∀ i : Fin BK,
      sc.readMem DG (offset s s_qk_h DK r BT BK i)
        = if active s DK BK i then
            bwdCumPartialG s DQInner DQInter DKInner DKInter Q K G s_qk_h DK BT BK (BT - r) i
          else s.readMem DG (offset s s_qk_h DK r BT BK i))

name: ImplementsInt
text:
def ImplementsInt (io : Masked2DKernelIO₂)
    (f : Nat → Nat → (Fin io.B → Int) → (Fin io.B → ℝ) → Fin io.B → ℝ) :
    Prop :=
  ∀ A : FlatAlloc,
    A.Disjoint →
    A.regions = [io.in1, io.in2, io.out] ++ io.scratch.map Prod.fst →
    (∀ r, r ∉ A.regions → A.extent r = 0) →
  ∀ pid₀ pid₁ : Nat,
    (∀ j : Fin io.B, io.mask pid₀ pid₁ j →
      io.read1 pid₀ pid₁ j < A.extent io.in1) →
    (∀ j : Fin io.B, io.read2Mask pid₀ pid₁ j →
      io.read2 pid₀ pid₁ j < A.extent io.in2) →
    (∀ j : Fin io.B, io.writeMask pid₀ pid₁ j →
      io.write pid₀ pid₁ j < A.extent io.out) →
    (∀ p ∈ io.scratch, ∀ j : Fin io.B, io.writeMask pid₀ pid₁ j →
      p.2 pid₀ pid₁ j < A.extent p.1) →
  ∀ (xs : Fin io.B → Int) (ys : Fin io.B → ℝ) (s₀ : BlockState),
    s₀.pids 0 = pid₀ →
    s₀.pids 1 = pid₁ →
    s₀.undef = (fun _ _ => 0) →
    (∀ j : Fin io.B, io.mask pid₀ pid₁ j →
      s₀.readMemValue .int io.in1 (io.read1 pid₀ pid₁ j) = xs j) →
    (∀ j : Fin io.B, io.read2Mask pid₀ pid₁ j →
      s₀.readMem io.in2 (io.read2 pid₀ pid₁ j) = ys j) →
    ∃ s',
      exec (A.flattenKernel io.kernel.toAlgKernel) (A.flattenState s₀)
        = some s'
      ∧ (∀ j : Fin io.B, io.writeMask pid₀ pid₁ j →
          s'.readMem A.flat (A.addr io.out (io.write pid₀ pid₁ j))
            = f pid₀ pid₁ xs ys j)
      ∧ (∀ r' o',
          (r' ≠ A.flat ∨
            ((∀ j : Fin io.B, io.writeMask pid₀ pid₁ j →
                o' ≠ A.addr io.out (io.write pid₀ pid₁ j)) ∧
             (∀ p ∈ io.scratch, ∀ j : Fin io.B, io.writeMask pid₀ pid₁ j →
                o' ≠ A.addr p.1 (p.2 pid₀ pid₁ j)))) →
          s'.mem r' o' = (A.flattenState s₀).mem r' o')

    (xs : Inputs p.BLOCK_DMODEL_NOPE p.BLOCK_DMODEL_ROPE) : Prop where
  metadata : s.readMemValue .int p.Dest_loc.cast (io.readMetadata (s.pids 0)) = xs.row
  nope : ∀ j, s.readMem p.KV_nope (io.readNope (s.pids 0) j) = xs.nope j

/-- Per-program successful finite flat IO, both unmasked output tiles and all
other tagged cells. Destination rows must be nonnegative: the signed source
index is not clipped into a valid row. Every padding lane needs real storage.
All source and metadata reads precede stores, so input/output aliasing is
allowed; the two output regions must be distinct in the correctness theorem. -/

name: IO.Implements
text:
def IO.Implements {p : Layout} (io : IO p)
    (f : Inputs p.BLOCK_DMODEL_NOPE p.BLOCK_DMODEL_ROPE →
      (Fin p.BLOCK_DMODEL_NOPE → ℝ) × (Fin p.BLOCK_DMODEL_ROPE → ℝ)) : Prop :=
  ∀ A : FlatAlloc, A.Disjoint →
    A.regions = [p.KV_nope,p.KV_rope,p.Dest_loc.cast,p.O_nope,p.O_rope] →
    (∀ r, r ∉ A.regions → A.extent r = 0) →
  ∀ (s : BlockState) (xs : Inputs p.BLOCK_DMODEL_NOPE p.BLOCK_DMODEL_ROPE),
    0 ≤ xs.row → s.undef = (fun _ _ => 0) →
    io.Bounds A.extent (s.pids 0) xs → io.Pins s xs →
    ∃ final, exec (A.flattenKernel io.kernel.toAlgKernel) (A.flattenState s) = some final ∧
      (∀ j, final.readMem A.flat (A.addr p.O_nope (io.writeNope xs.row j)) = (f xs).1 j) ∧
      (∀ j, final.readMem A.flat (A.addr p.O_rope (io.writeRope xs.row j)) = (f xs).2 j) ∧
      (∀ r o, (r ≠ A.flat ∨
        (∀ j, o ≠ A.addr p.O_nope (io.writeNope xs.row j)) ∧
        (∀ j, o ≠ A.addr p.O_rope (io.writeRope xs.row j))) →
        final.mem r o = (A.flattenState s).mem r o)

name: contract
text:
def contract (kernel : ComputeKernel) (p : Layout) (length : Nat) : Prop :=
  (0<length → Separation p) →
  ∀ A : FlatAlloc, A.Disjoint → (∀ r, r ∉ A.regions → A.extent r=0) →
  ∀ u : BlockState, u.undef=(fun _ _ => 0) → Bounds p u length A.extent →
    kernel.toAlgKernel.TraceSafe A.extent u ∧
    ∃ v, exec (A.flattenKernel kernel.toAlgKernel) (A.flattenState u)=some v ∧
      (∀ t, t<length → ∀ j, mask p u j=Bool.true →
        complexOutput A v p.gx (offset p u t j)=Reference.inputGradient length
          (starRingEnd ℂ (transition p u j)) (fun q => gradOutput p u q j) t) ∧
      (∀ j, mask p u j=Bool.true → complexOutput A v p.gs (columns p u j)=
        Reference.reverseCarry length (starRingEnd ℂ (transition p u j)) (fun q => gradOutput p u q j) length) ∧
      (∀ j, mask p u j=Bool.true → complexOutput A v p.gl (columns p u j)=
        Reference.transitionGradient length (starRingEnd ℂ (transition p u j)) (starRingEnd ℂ (initial p u j))
          (fun q => starRingEnd ℂ (output p u q j)) (fun q => gradOutput p u q j) length) ∧
      (∀ r o, Outside p A u length r o → v.mem r o=(A.flattenState u).mem r o)

name: Implements
text:
def Implements (io : StreamEmitMasked2DKernelIO₃)
    (f : Nat → Nat → (Fin io.T → Fin io.B1 → ℝ) →
      (Fin io.T → Fin io.B2 → ℝ) → (Fin io.T → Fin io.B3 → ℝ) →
      Fin io.T → Fin io.C → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ A : FlatAlloc,
    A.Disjoint →
    A.regions = [io.inp1, io.inp2, io.inp3, io.out] →
    (∀ r, r ∉ A.regions → A.extent r = 0) →
  ∀ pid₀ pid₁ : Nat,
  ∀ (xs : Fin io.T → Fin io.B1 → ℝ) (ys : Fin io.T → Fin io.B2 → ℝ)
    (zs : Fin io.T → Fin io.B3 → ℝ) (s₀ : BlockState),
    s₀.pids 0 = pid₀ →
    s₀.pids 1 = pid₁ →
    s₀.undef = (fun _ _ => 0) →
    (∀ (t : Fin io.T) (j : Fin io.B1), io.mask1 pid₀ pid₁ t j →
      io.read1 pid₀ pid₁ t j < A.extent io.inp1) →
    (∀ (t : Fin io.T) (j : Fin io.B2), io.mask2 pid₀ pid₁ t j →
      io.read2 pid₀ pid₁ t j < A.extent io.inp2) →
    (∀ (t : Fin io.T) (j : Fin io.B3), io.mask3 pid₀ pid₁ t j →
      io.read3 pid₀ pid₁ t j < A.extent io.inp3) →
    (∀ (t : Fin io.T) (j : Fin io.C), io.writeMask pid₀ pid₁ t j →
      io.write pid₀ pid₁ t j < A.extent io.out) →
    (∀ (t : Fin io.T) (j : Fin io.B1), io.mask1 pid₀ pid₁ t j →
      s₀.readMem io.inp1 (io.read1 pid₀ pid₁ t j) = xs t j) →
    (∀ (t : Fin io.T) (j : Fin io.B2), io.mask2 pid₀ pid₁ t j →
      s₀.readMem io.inp2 (io.read2 pid₀ pid₁ t j) = ys t j) →
    (∀ (t : Fin io.T) (j : Fin io.B3), io.mask3 pid₀ pid₁ t j →
      s₀.readMem io.inp3 (io.read3 pid₀ pid₁ t j) = zs t j) →
    ∃ s',
      exec (A.flattenKernel io.kernel.toAlgKernel) (A.flattenState s₀)
        = some s'
      ∧ (∀ (t : Fin io.T) (j : Fin io.C), io.writeMask pid₀ pid₁ t j →
          s'.readMem A.flat
              (A.addr io.out (io.write pid₀ pid₁ t j))
            = f pid₀ pid₁ xs ys zs t j)
      ∧ (∀ r' o',
          (r' ≠ A.flat ∨
            (∀ (t : Fin io.T) (j : Fin io.C), io.writeMask pid₀ pid₁ t j →
              o' ≠ A.addr io.out (io.write pid₀ pid₁ t j))) →
          s'.mem r' o' = (A.flattenState s₀).mem r' o')

      grad_y_ptr length batch_size dim BLOCK_SIZE k st ∧
    st.regs .real [BLOCK_SIZE] "Lambda" =

def diag_ssm_forward_kernel_alg_post

    (length batch_size dim BLOCK_SIZE : Nat)
    (s s' : BlockState) : Prop :=
  ∀ idx : TileIndex [length, BLOCK_SIZE],
    diagSsmForwardActive s batch_size dim BLOCK_SIZE idx →
    s'.readMem y_ptr
        (diagSsmForwardOutOffset s batch_size dim BLOCK_SIZE idx) =
      diagSsmForwardSpecAt s s_ptr x_ptr lambda_ptr batch_size dim BLOCK_SIZE idx

name: diag_ssm_forward_kernel_correct_target
text:
def diag_ssm_forward_kernel_correct_target
    (s_ptr x_ptr lambda_ptr y_ptr : RegionName)
    (length batch_size dim BLOCK_SIZE : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  ComputeCorrect.Realizes_without_Rounding
    (kernel := diag_ssm_forward_kernel s_ptr x_ptr lambda_ptr y_ptr
      length batch_size dim BLOCK_SIZE)
    (initialState := s)
    (write := ComputeCorrect.WriteMap.writeIf
      (fun idx : TileIndex [length, BLOCK_SIZE] =>
        diagSsmForwardActive s batch_size dim BLOCK_SIZE idx)
      (fun idx : TileIndex [length, BLOCK_SIZE] =>
        (y_ptr, diagSsmForwardOutOffset s batch_size dim BLOCK_SIZE idx)))
    (expected := fun idx : TileIndex [length, BLOCK_SIZE] =>
      diagSsmForwardSpecAt s s_ptr x_ptr lambda_ptr batch_size dim BLOCK_SIZE idx)

name: diag_ssm_backward_kernel_correct_target
text:
def diag_ssm_backward_kernel_correct_target
    (s_ptr lambda_ptr y_ptr grad_s_ptr grad_x_ptr grad_lambda_ptr grad_y_ptr :
      RegionName)
    (length batch_size dim BLOCK_SIZE : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  ComputeCorrect.Realizes_without_Rounding
    (kernel := diag_ssm_backward_kernel s_ptr lambda_ptr y_ptr grad_s_ptr
      grad_x_ptr grad_lambda_ptr grad_y_ptr length batch_size dim BLOCK_SIZE)
    (initialState := s)
    (write := diagSsmBackwardWriteMap (length := length) s grad_s_ptr
      grad_x_ptr grad_lambda_ptr batch_size dim BLOCK_SIZE)
    (expected := diagSsmBackwardExpected (length := length) s s_ptr
      lambda_ptr y_ptr grad_y_ptr batch_size dim BLOCK_SIZE)

name: window
text:
def window (A : FlatAlloc) (u : BlockState) (batch dim block : Nat)
    (region : RegionName) (o : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ j : Fin block, u.pids 0 * block + j.val < batch * dim ∧
    o = A.addr region (u.pids 0 * block + j.val)

name: written
text:
def written (A : FlatAlloc) (u : BlockState) (batch dim block : Nat)
    (gs gl r : RegionName) (o : Nat) : Prop :=
  r = A.flat ∧ (window A u batch dim block gs o ∨ window A u batch dim block gl o)

/-- At T=0, reverse recurrence reads the transition tile, writes zero to
the two terminal gradients, and leaves every other tagged cell unchanged.
No separation between gradient outputs is needed for these zero writes. -/

name: window
text:
def window (A : FlatAlloc) (u : BlockState) (batch dim block : Nat)
    (region : RegionName) (component o : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ j : Fin block, u.pids 0*block+j.val < batch*dim ∧
    o = A.addr region ((u.pids 0*block+j.val)*2+component)

name: written
text:
def written (A : FlatAlloc) (u : BlockState) (batch dim block : Nat)
    (gs gl r : RegionName) (o : Nat) : Prop :=
  r = A.flat ∧ (window A u batch dim block gs 0 o ∨ window A u batch dim block gs 1 o ∨
    window A u batch dim block gl 0 o ∨ window A u batch dim block gl 1 o)

/-- The empty complex reverse recurrence writes both components of both
terminal gradients as zero. Input/output aliasing does not change this
conclusion, since every read precedes these constant writes. -/

name: Implements
text:
def Implements (kernel : ComputeKernel)
    (bounds : RegionBounds → BlockState → Prop)
    (writes : FlatAlloc → BlockState → RegionName → Nat → Prop) : Prop :=
  ∀ (A : FlatAlloc), A.Disjoint →
    (∀ r, r ∉ A.regions → A.extent r = 0) →
  ∀ u : BlockState, bounds A.extent u →
    kernel.toAlgKernel.TraceSafe A.extent u ∧
    ∃ v, exec (A.flattenKernel kernel.toAlgKernel) (A.flattenState u) = some v ∧
      (∀ r o, writes A u r o → v.mem r o = MemCell.real 0) ∧
      (∀ r o, ¬ writes A u r o → v.mem r o = (A.flattenState u).mem r o)

name: forwardBounds
text:
def forwardBounds (bounds : RegionBounds) (u : BlockState)
    (s l : RegionName) (batch dim block : Nat) : Prop :=
  (∀ j : Fin block, u.pids 0*block+j.val < batch*dim →
    u.pids 0*block+j.val < bounds s) ∧
  (∀ j : Fin block, u.pids 0*block+j.val < batch*dim →
    (u.pids 0*block+j.val)%dim < bounds l)

name: complexForwardBounds
text:
def complexForwardBounds (bounds : RegionBounds) (u : BlockState)
    (s l : RegionName) (batch dim block : Nat) : Prop :=
  (∀ j : Fin block, u.pids 0*block+j.val < batch*dim →
    (u.pids 0*block+j.val)*2+1 < bounds s) ∧
  (∀ j : Fin block, u.pids 0*block+j.val < batch*dim →
    ((u.pids 0*block+j.val)%dim)*2+1 < bounds l)

name: backwardBounds
text:
def backwardBounds (bounds : RegionBounds) (u : BlockState)
    (l gs gl : RegionName) (batch dim block : Nat) : Prop :=
  (∀ j : Fin block, u.pids 0*block+j.val < batch*dim →
    (u.pids 0*block+j.val)%dim < bounds l) ∧
  (∀ j : Fin block, u.pids 0*block+j.val < batch*dim →
    u.pids 0*block+j.val < bounds gs) ∧
  (∀ j : Fin block, u.pids 0*block+j.val < batch*dim →
    u.pids 0*block+j.val < bounds gl)

name: complexBackwardBounds
text:
def complexBackwardBounds (bounds : RegionBounds) (u : BlockState)
    (l gs gl : RegionName) (batch dim block : Nat) : Prop :=
  (∀ j : Fin block, u.pids 0*block+j.val < batch*dim →
    ((u.pids 0*block+j.val)%dim)*2+1 < bounds l) ∧
  (∀ j : Fin block, u.pids 0*block+j.val < batch*dim →
    (u.pids 0*block+j.val)*2+1 < bounds gs) ∧
  (∀ j : Fin block, u.pids 0*block+j.val < batch*dim →
    (u.pids 0*block+j.val)*2+1 < bounds gl)

    ∃ v, exec (A.flattenKernel kernel.toAlgKernel) (A.flattenState u)=some v ∧

text:
structure ForwardBounds (X Y Z : RegionName) (L : Region .int) (V R B : Nat)
    (u : BlockState) (bounds : RegionBounds) : Prop where
  label : u.pids 0 < bounds (Region.cast L)
  labelTyped : ∃ lab : Int, u.mem (Region.cast L) (u.pids 0)=MemCell.of .int lab
  labelValid : let lab := u.readMemValue .int (Region.cast L) (u.pids 0)
    lab = -100 ∨ (0≤lab ∧ lab < (V : Int))
  loss : u.pids 0 < bounds Y
  lse : u.pids 0 < bounds Z
  gather : u.readMemValue .int (Region.cast L) (u.pids 0) ≠ -100 →
    u.pids 0*R+(u.readMemValue .int (Region.cast L) (u.pids 0)).toNat < bounds X
  logits : ∀ j : Fin B, j.val<V → u.pids 0*R+j.val < bounds X

forward_correct_target
text:
def forward_correct_target (kernel : Kernel) (cap scale : Bool) (X Y Z : RegionName) (L : Region .int)
    (V R B : Nat) (SC SL : ℝ) : Prop :=
  (cap=Bool.true → 0<SC) → (scale=Bool.true → 0<SL) →
  ∀ A : FlatAlloc, A.Disjoint → (∀ r, r ∉ A.regions → A.extent r=0) →
  ∀ u : BlockState, u.undef=(fun _ _ => 0) → ForwardBounds X Y Z L V R B u A.extent →
  0<V → V≤B → Y≠Z →
    ∃ v, exec (A.flattenKernel kernel) (A.flattenState u)=some v ∧
      v.readMem A.flat (A.addr Z (u.pids 0)) = lse cap scale SC SL V 0
        (fun j : Fin B => u.readMem X (u.pids 0*R+j.val)) ∧
      v.readMem A.flat (A.addr Y (u.pids 0)) = loss cap scale SC SL V
        (u.readMemValue .int (Region.cast L) (u.pids 0))
        (fun j : Fin B => u.readMem X (u.pids 0*R+j.val))
        (u.readMem X (u.pids 0*R+(u.readMemValue .int (Region.cast L) (u.pids 0)).toNat)) ∧
      (∀ r o, forwardOutside A u Y Z r o → v.mem r o=(A.flattenState u).mem r o)

text:
structure ChunkedBounds (X Y Z : RegionName) (L : Region .int) (V C R B : Nat)
    (u : BlockState) (bounds : RegionBounds) : Prop where
  label : u.pids 0 < bounds (Region.cast L)
  labelTyped : ∃ lab : Int, u.mem (Region.cast L) (u.pids 0)=MemCell.of .int lab
  labelValid : let lab := u.readMemValue .int (Region.cast L) (u.pids 0)
    lab = -100 ∨ (0≤lab ∧ lab < (V : Int))
  loss : u.pids 1=0 → u.pids 0 < bounds Y
  lse : u.pids 1=0 → u.pids 0*C < bounds Z
  gather : u.pids 1=0 → u.readMemValue .int (Region.cast L) (u.pids 0) ≠ -100 →
    u.pids 0*R+(u.readMemValue .int (Region.cast L) (u.pids 0)).toNat < bounds X
  logits : ∀ j : Fin B, u.pids 1*B+j.val<V → u.pids 0*R+(u.pids 1*B+j.val) < bounds X

chunkedOutputs

def chunkedOutputs (A : FlatAlloc) (u v : BlockState) (cap scale : Bool)
    (X Y Z : RegionName) (L : Region .int) (V C R B : Nat) (SC SL : ℝ) : Prop :=
  if u.pids 1=0 then
    v.readMem A.flat (A.addr Z (u.pids 0*C)) = lse cap scale SC SL V 0
      (fun j : Fin B => u.readMem X (u.pids 0*R+j.val)) ∧
    v.readMem A.flat (A.addr Y (u.pids 0)) = partialLoss cap scale SC SL
      (u.readMemValue .int (Region.cast L) (u.pids 0))
      (u.readMem X (u.pids 0*R+(u.readMemValue .int (Region.cast L) (u.pids 0)).toNat)) ∧
    (∀ r o, chunkedOutside A u Y Z C r o → v.mem r o=(A.flattenState u).mem r o)
  else v.mem=(A.flattenState u).mem

name: chunked_correct_target

    (YR XR WR RR N B : Nat) (eps : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ A : FlatAlloc,A.Disjoint → (∀ q,q∉A.regions → A.extent q=0) →
  ∀ u : BlockState,u.undef=(fun _ _ => 0) → Bounds isGemma Y X W r YR XR WR RR N B u A.extent →
  0<N → N≤B → Y≠r →
  0<RealMath.meanSquare N (fun j : Fin B => u.readMem X (u.pids 0*XR+j.val))+eps →
    ∃ v,exec (A.flattenKernel kernel) (A.flattenState u)=some v ∧
      (∀ j : Fin B,j.val<N → v.readMem A.flat (A.addr Y (u.pids 0*YR+j.val))=
        RealMath.output isGemma N eps (fun k : Fin B => u.readMem X (u.pids 0*XR+k.val))
          (fun k : Fin B => u.readMem W (weightOffset isGemma WR k.val)) j) ∧
      v.readMem A.flat (A.addr r (u.pids 0*RR))=
        RealMath.invStd N eps (fun j : Fin B => u.readMem X (u.pids 0*XR+j.val)) ∧
      (∀ q o,Outside A u Y r YR RR N B q o → v.mem q o=(A.flattenState u).mem q o)

name: Bounds
text:
structure Bounds (u : BlockState) (Q C S : RegionName) (QR CR SR seq H heads B : Nat) (bounds : RegionBounds) : Prop where
  cosine : ∀ j : Fin B,j.val<H/2 → coefficientAddress u.pid CR seq j.val<bounds C
  sine : ∀ j : Fin B,j.val<H/2 → coefficientAddress u.pid SR seq j.val<bounds S
  first : ∀ k,start (u.pids 1)≤k → k<stop (u.pids 1) heads →
    ∀ j : Fin B,j.val<H/2 → first u.pid QR H k j.val<bounds Q
  second : ∀ k,start (u.pids 1)≤k → k<stop (u.pids 1) heads →
    ∀ j : Fin B,j.val<H/2 → second u.pid QR H k j.val<bounds Q

name: Outside
text:
def Outside (A : FlatAlloc) (u : BlockState) (Q : RegionName) (QR H heads B : Nat) (r : RegionName) (o : Nat) : Prop :=
  r≠A.flat ∨ ∀ k,start (u.pids 1)≤k → k<stop (u.pids 1) heads →
    ∀ j : Fin B,j.val<H/2 →
      o≠A.addr Q (first u.pid QR H k j.val) ∧ o≠A.addr Q (second u.pid QR H k j.val)

name: correct_target
text:
def correct_target (kernel : Kernel) (Q C S : RegionName) (QR CR SR seq H heads B : Nat) (backwards : Bool) : Prop :=
  ∀ A : FlatAlloc,A.Disjoint → (∀ r,r∉A.regions → A.extent r=0) →
  ∀ u : BlockState,u.undef=(fun _ _ => 0) → Bounds u Q C S QR CR SR seq H heads B A.extent →
  0<seq → H/2≤B →
    ∃ v,exec (A.flattenKernel kernel) (A.flattenState u)=some v ∧
      (∀ k,start (u.pids 1)≤k → k<stop (u.pids 1) heads →
        ∀ j : Fin B,j.val<H/2 →
        v.readMem A.flat (A.addr Q (first u.pid QR H k j.val))=
          firstValue backwards
            (u.readMem Q (first u.pid QR H k j.val))
            (u.readMem Q (second u.pid QR H k j.val))
            (u.readMem C (coefficientAddress u.pid CR seq j.val))
            (u.readMem S (coefficientAddress u.pid SR seq j.val)) ∧
        v.readMem A.flat (A.addr Q (second u.pid QR H k j.val))=
          secondValue backwards
            (u.readMem Q (first u.pid QR H k j.val))
            (u.readMem Q (second u.pid QR H k j.val))
            (u.readMem C (coefficientAddress u.pid CR seq j.val))
            (u.readMem S (coefficientAddress u.pid SR seq j.val))) ∧
      (∀ r o,Outside A u Q QR H heads B r o → v.mem r o=(A.flattenState u).mem r o)

def Outside (A : FlatAlloc) (u : BlockState) (Q : RegionName) (QR H heads B : Nat) (r : RegionName) (o : Nat) : Prop :=

def Implements (kernel : Kernel) (Q C S : RegionName) (QR CR SR seq H heads B : Nat) (backwards : Bool) : Prop :=
  ∀ A : FlatAlloc,A.Disjoint → (∀ r,r∉A.regions → A.extent r=0) →
  ∀ u : BlockState,u.undef=(fun _ _ => 0) → Safety.Bounds u Q C S QR CR SR seq H heads B A.extent →
  0<seq → H/2≤B →
    ∃ v,exec (A.flattenKernel kernel) (A.flattenState u)=some v ∧
      (∀ k,Reference.start (u.pids 1)≤k → k<Reference.stop (u.pids 1) heads →
        ∀ j : Fin B,j.val<H/2 →
        v.readMem A.flat (A.addr Q (Reference.first u.pid QR H k j.val))=
          Reference.firstValue backwards
            (u.readMem Q (Reference.first u.pid QR H k j.val))
            (u.readMem Q (Reference.second u.pid QR H k j.val))
            (u.readMem C (Reference.coefficientAddress u.pid CR seq j.val))
            (u.readMem S (Reference.coefficientAddress u.pid SR seq j.val)) ∧
        v.readMem A.flat (A.addr Q (Reference.second u.pid QR H k j.val))=
          Reference.secondValue backwards
            (u.readMem Q (Reference.first u.pid QR H k j.val))
            (u.readMem Q (Reference.second u.pid QR H k j.val))
            (u.readMem C (Reference.coefficientAddress u.pid CR seq j.val))
            (u.readMem S (Reference.coefficientAddress u.pid SR seq j.val))) ∧
      (∀ r o,Outside A u Q QR H heads B r o → v.mem r o=(A.flattenState u).mem r o)

Holds
text:
structure Holds (s u : BlockState) (Q : RegionName) (row QR H B firstHead cur : Nat)
    (cs ss : Fin B → ℝ) : Prop where
  context : Context u row H B cs ss
  pids : u.pids=s.pids
  values : ∀ t,firstHead≤t → t<cur → ∀ j : Fin B,j.val<H/2 →
    u.readMem Q (Reference.first row QR H t j.val)=
      s.readMem Q (Reference.first row QR H t j.val)*cs j-s.readMem Q (Reference.second row QR H t j.val)*ss j ∧
    u.readMem Q (Reference.second row QR H t j.val)=
      s.readMem Q (Reference.second row QR H t j.val)*cs j+s.readMem Q (Reference.first row QR H t j.val)*ss j
  frame : ∀ r o,(r≠Q ∨ ¬Written row QR H B firstHead cur o) → u.mem r o=s.mem r o

name: RegionIO
text:
def RegionIO (kernel : Kernel) (p : Layout) (s : BlockState)
    (Q K V L O : RegionName) : Prop :=
  ∃ t, exec kernel s = some t ∧
    t.mem = (referenceState p s Q K V L O).mem ∧
    ∀ r o, ¬writeWindow p L O (s.pids 0) (s.pids 1) r o → t.mem r o = s.mem r o

/-- The historical full-source flat result, retaining its region-state
witness and region frame. `FlatIO` additionally exposes actual source safety
and the complete flat-memory frame. -/

name: RegionFlatIO
text:
def RegionFlatIO (kernel : Kernel) (A : FlatAlloc) (p : Layout) (s : BlockState)
    (Q K V L O : RegionName) : Prop :=
  ∃ t, exec (A.flattenKernel kernel) (A.flattenState s) = some (A.flattenState t) ∧
    t.mem = (referenceState p s Q K V L O).mem ∧
    ∀ r o, ¬writeWindow p L O (s.pids 0) (s.pids 1) r o → t.mem r o = s.mem r o

/-- Complete source-real IO for both attention outputs: actual trace safety,
successful finite-flat execution, an independent initial-memory formula and
the raw-cell frame, including unallocated addresses and unrelated dtypes. -/

name: FlatIO
text:
def FlatIO (kernel : Kernel) (A : FlatAlloc) (p : Layout) (s : BlockState)
    (Q K V L O : RegionName) : Prop :=
  kernel.TraceSafe A.extent s ∧
  ∃ t, exec (A.flattenKernel kernel) (A.flattenState s) = some t ∧
    t.mem = (A.flattenState (referenceState p s Q K V L O)).mem ∧
    ∀ r o, (r ≠ A.flat ∨ ∀ region offset,
      writeWindow p L O (s.pids 0) (s.pids 1) region offset → o ≠ A.addr region offset) →
      t.mem r o = (A.flattenState s).mem r o

name: readWindow
text:
def readWindow (p : Layout) (Q K V : RegionName) (pid₀ pid₁ : Nat)
    (region : RegionName) (offset : Nat) : Prop :=
  (region=Q ∧ ∃ i : Fin p.BLOCK_M, ∃ e : Fin p.DIM, offset=qOffset p pid₀ pid₁ i.val e.val) ∨
  (region=K ∧ ∃ k : Fin (keyCount p pid₀), ∃ e : Fin p.DIM, offset=kOffset p pid₁ k.val e.val) ∨
  (region=V ∧ ∃ k : Fin (keyCount p pid₀), ∃ d : Fin p.DIM, offset=vOffset p pid₁ k.val d.val)

name: writeWindow
text:
def writeWindow (p : Layout) (L O : RegionName) (pid₀ pid₁ : Nat)
    (region : RegionName) (offset : Nat) : Prop :=
  (region=L ∧ ∃ i : Fin p.BLOCK_M, offset=lOffset p pid₀ pid₁ i.val) ∨
  (region=O ∧ ∃ i : Fin p.BLOCK_M, ∃ d : Fin p.DIM, offset=oOffset p pid₀ pid₁ i.val d.val)

/-- The mathematical row as a list of score/value pairs, used only to connect
the independent sums to the generic online-softmax algebra. -/

name: attnInvariant
text:
noncomputable def attnInvariant
    (Q K V : RegionName) (s0 : BlockState) (sm_scale : ℝ)
    (stride_q_head SEQLEN BLOCK_M DIM BLOCK_N hiTotal : Nat) (causal : Bool)
    (hDIM : 0 < DIM)
    (i : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  let base := flashBaseOffset s0 stride_q_head
  let qStart := s0.pids 0 * BLOCK_M
  let qT := qTile s0 Q stride_q_head DIM BLOCK_M
  let kT := kTile s0 K stride_q_head DIM SEQLEN
  let vT := vTile s0 V stride_q_head DIM SEQLEN
  let scale := sm_scale * log2e
  s.pids = s0.pids ∧ i % BLOCK_N = 0 ∧ i ≤ hiTotal ∧
  (s.regs .real [BLOCK_M] "max" = some ⟨fun r : TileIndex [BLOCK_M] =>
      flashRunningMax qT kT vT scale causal qStart i r.1 ⟨0, hDIM⟩⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .real [BLOCK_M] "denom" = some ⟨fun r : TileIndex [BLOCK_M] =>
      ((flashStateBot qT kT vT scale causal qStart i r.1 ⟨0, hDIM⟩).2.1 : ℝ)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .real [BLOCK_M, DIM] "out_buffer" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BLOCK_M, DIM] =>
      ((flashStateBot qT kT vT scale causal qStart i idx.1 idx.2.1).2.2 : ℝ)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .fp16 [BLOCK_M, DIM] "q" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BLOCK_M, DIM] =>
      FloatDType.real.cast FloatDType.fp16
        (some (scale * qT idx))⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [BLOCK_M] "off_m" = some (Tile.vec (fun r : Fin BLOCK_M => qStart + r.val))) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [BLOCK_N] "off_n" = some (Tile.vec (fun j : Fin BLOCK_N => j.val))) ∧
  (s.regs .blockPtr [DIM, BLOCK_N] "K_block_ptr" = some
    (⟨fun _ : TileIndex [DIM, BLOCK_N] =>
      { region := K, baseOffset := base, parentShape := [DIM, SEQLEN],
        blockShape := [DIM, BLOCK_N], strides := [1, DIM], offsets := [0, i] }⟩)) ∧
  (s.regs .blockPtr [BLOCK_N, DIM] "V_block_ptr" = some
    (⟨fun _ : TileIndex [BLOCK_N, DIM] =>
      { region := V, baseOffset := base, parentShape := [SEQLEN, DIM],
        blockShape := [BLOCK_N, DIM], strides := [DIM, 1], offsets := [i, 0] }⟩)) ∧
  (s.regs .blockPtr [BLOCK_M, DIM] "Q_block_ptr" = some
    (⟨fun _ : TileIndex [BLOCK_M, DIM] =>
      { region := Q, baseOffset := base, parentShape := [SEQLEN, DIM],
        blockShape := [BLOCK_M, DIM], strides := [DIM, 1], offsets := [qStart, 0] }⟩)) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [] "start_m" = some (Tile.scalar (s0.pids 0))) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [] "off_bs_head" = some (Tile.scalar (s0.pids 1))) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [] "qkv_base_offset" = some (Tile.scalar (s0.pids 1 * stride_q_head))) ∧
  (∀ rg o, s.undef rg o = 0) ∧ (s.mem = s0.mem)

/-- filterMap-sum over `Fin n` with a guard collapses into the masked `Finset.sum`. -/

name: flashIOSafeInv
text:
private def flashIOSafeInv (K V : RegionName) (s0 : BlockState)
    (base SEQLEN BLOCK_M DIM BLOCK_N : Nat) (c : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  c % BLOCK_N = 0 ∧
  s.regs .nat [] "start_m" = some (Tile.scalar (s0.pids 0)) ∧
  s.regs .nat [] "off_bs_head" = some (Tile.scalar (s0.pids 1)) ∧
  s.regs .nat [] "qkv_base_offset" = some (Tile.scalar base) ∧
  s.regs .nat [BLOCK_M] "off_m"
    = some (Tile.vec (fun r : Fin BLOCK_M => s0.pids 0 * BLOCK_M + r.val)) ∧
  s.regs .blockPtr [DIM, BLOCK_N] "K_block_ptr" = some
    (⟨fun _ : TileIndex [DIM, BLOCK_N] =>
      { region := K, baseOffset := base, parentShape := [DIM, SEQLEN],
        blockShape := [DIM, BLOCK_N], strides := [1, DIM], offsets := [0, c] }⟩) ∧
  s.regs .blockPtr [BLOCK_N, DIM] "V_block_ptr" = some
    (⟨fun _ : TileIndex [BLOCK_N, DIM] =>
      { region := V, baseOffset := base, parentShape := [SEQLEN, DIM],
        blockShape := [BLOCK_N, DIM], strides := [DIM, 1], offsets := [c, 0] }⟩)

set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000 in
/-- The first thirteen body statements (everything before the two `tl.advance`
assigns) never touch the invariant's pinned registers. -/

name: PrefixInvariant
text:
structure PrefixInvariant (p : Layout) (s₀ : BlockState) (Q K V : RegionName)
    (c : Nat) (t : BlockState) : Prop where
  mem : t.mem = s₀.mem
  pids : t.pids = s₀.pids
  undef : t.undef = s₀.undef
  startm : t.regs .nat [] "start_m" = some (Tile.scalar (s₀.pids 0))
  bshead : t.regs .nat [] "off_bs_head" = some (Tile.scalar (s₀.pids 1))
  base : t.regs .nat [] "qkv_base_offset" = some (Tile.scalar (Formula.base p (s₀.pids 1)))
  offm : t.regs .nat [p.BLOCK_M] "off_m" =
    some (Tile.vec (fun i => row p (s₀.pids 0) i.val))
  offn : t.regs .nat [p.BLOCK_N] "off_n" = some (Tile.vec (fun j => j.val))
  query : t.regs .real [p.BLOCK_M,p.DIM] "q" = some (RealExecution.query p s₀ Q)
  maximum : t.regs .real [p.BLOCK_M] "max" = some (prefixMax p s₀ Q K V c)
  denominator : t.regs .real [p.BLOCK_M] "denom" = some (prefixDen p s₀ Q K V c)
  accumulator : t.regs .real [p.BLOCK_M,p.DIM] "out_buffer" = some (prefixAcc p s₀ Q K V c)
  key : t.regs .blockPtr [p.DIM,p.BLOCK_N] "K_block_ptr" =
    some (keyPointer p K (s₀.pids 1) (c*p.BLOCK_N))
  value : t.regs .blockPtr [p.BLOCK_N,p.DIM] "V_block_ptr" =
    some (valuePointer p V (s₀.pids 1) (c*p.BLOCK_N))
  lo : t.regs .nat [] "lo" = some (Tile.scalar 0)
  hi : t.regs .nat [] "hi" = some (Tile.scalar (Formula.hi p (s₀.pids 0)))

name: AddressBounds
text:
structure AddressBounds (p : Layout) (s : BlockState) (Q K V L O : RegionName)
    (bounds : RegionBounds) : Prop where
  reads : ∀ r o, readWindow p Q K V (s.pids 0) (s.pids 1) r o → o < bounds r
  writes : ∀ r o, writeWindow p L O (s.pids 0) (s.pids 1) r o → o < bounds r

text:
def active (_s : BlockState) (head_dim : Nat) (i : Fin BLOCK_DMODEL) : Prop :=

name: Rules
text:
abbrev Rules := FP.ScalarArithmetic.Rules

/-- The actual combined input (multiplier * input + x) and bias must be finite.
This includes inactive lanes since arithmetic executes before the masked store.
No input distribution, positivity or nonzero restriction is required. -/

name: activeLane
text:
def activeLane (s : BlockState) (rnumel RBLOCK : Nat) (i : Fin RBLOCK) : Prop :=
  rIndex s RBLOCK i < rnumel

name: activeV
text:
def activeV (s : BlockState) (V BV : Nat) (jv : Fin BV) : Prop :=

name: activeK
text:
def activeK (s : BlockState) (K BK : Nat) (jk : Fin BK) : Prop :=

name: activeKV
text:
def activeKV (s : BlockState) (K V BK BV : Nat) (idx : TileIndex [BV, BK]) : Prop :=

name: active
text:
def active (s : BlockState) (D BD : Nat) (i : Fin BD) : Prop :=
  dIndex s BD i < D

name: HgrnFwdInv
text:
def HgrnFwdInv (s0 : BlockState) (x g o h0 : RegionName) (U : Bool)
    (T D BD n : Nat) (i : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  i ≤ n
  ∧ s.regs .bool [BD] "mask" = some ⟨fun j => decide (hgrnChan s0 BD j < D)⟩
  ∧ s.regs .ptr [BD] "p_x" = some ⟨fun j => (x, hgrnAddr s0 T D BD i j)⟩
  ∧ s.regs .ptr [BD] "p_g" = some ⟨fun j => (g, hgrnAddr s0 T D BD i j)⟩
  ∧ s.regs .ptr [BD] "p_o" = some ⟨fun j => (o, hgrnAddr s0 T D BD i j)⟩
  ∧ s.regs .real [BD] "b_h" = some ⟨fun j => some (if hgrnChan s0 BD j < D then
      hgrnStateClosed s0 x g h0 U T D BD i j.1 else 0)⟩
  ∧ (∀ r, r ≠ o → ∀ off, s.mem r off = s0.mem r off)
  ∧ (∀ t, t < i → ∀ j : TileIndex [BD], hgrnChan s0 BD j < D →
      s.readMem o (hgrnAddr s0 T D BD t j)
        = hgrnStateClosed s0 x g h0 U T D BD (t + 1) j.1)

set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000 in
/-- **Cross-step carry fold for the forward loop (genuine).** Running the
kernel's own `forRange "_i" 0 n 1` from a state satisfying the invariant at `0`
lands the invariant at exactly `n`: the register carry `b_h` holds
`hgrnStateClosed n` on every active lane, and every output row `t < n` of `o`
holds `hgrnStateClosed (t+1)` there — the kernel's actual output.

The carry never leaves the register file — this is the `forRange_inv` route, not
the memory-threaded `CarryFold` one, and it models what the Python loop does.

Side conditions, both necessary: `x ≠ o` and `g ≠ o`, without which the body's
store into `o` could disturb the very inputs `hgrnStateClosed` reads. -/

name: ForwardImplements
text:
def ForwardImplements (kernel : ComputeKernel) (p : Layout) (r : ForwardRegions)
    (hasSeed storeFinal : Bool) : Prop :=
  (∀ initial : BlockState, r.q ≠ r.o → r.k ≠ r.o → r.v ≠ r.o →
    (storeFinal = Bool.true → r.o ≠ r.final) →
    ∃ final, exec kernel.toAlgKernel initial = some final ∧
      ForwardReal.Post p r hasSeed storeFinal initial final) ∧
  (∀ initial : BlockState, r.q ≠ r.o → r.k ≠ r.o → r.v ≠ r.o →
    (storeFinal = Bool.true → r.o ≠ r.final) →
    ComputeCorrect.RealizesFrame_without_Rounding kernel initial
      (ForwardSurface.writes p (launch initial) r storeFinal) (ForwardSurface.expected p r hasSeed initial)) ∧
  (∀ A : FlatAlloc, A.Disjoint → (∀ q, q ∉ A.regions → A.extent q = 0) →
    ∀ initial : BlockState, r.q ≠ r.o → r.k ≠ r.o → r.v ≠ r.o →
      (storeFinal = Bool.true → r.o ≠ r.final) →
      SafetyAccess.Bounds p (launch initial) r hasSeed storeFinal A.extent →
      ∃ final, exec (A.flattenKernel kernel.toAlgKernel) (A.flattenState initial) = some final ∧
        ForwardIO.Post A p r hasSeed storeFinal initial final)

name: BackwardImplements
text:
def BackwardImplements (kernel : ComputeKernel) (p : Layout) (r : BackwardRegions)
    (hasSeed : Bool) : Prop :=
  (∀ initial : BlockState, BackwardReal.Disjoint r →
    ∃ final, exec kernel.toAlgKernel initial = some final ∧ BackwardReal.Post p r hasSeed initial final) ∧
  (∀ initial : BlockState, BackwardReal.Disjoint r →
    ComputeCorrect.RealizesFrame_without_Rounding kernel initial
      (BackwardSurface.writes p (launch initial) r) (BackwardSurface.expected p r hasSeed initial)) ∧
  (∀ A : FlatAlloc, A.Disjoint → (∀ q, q ∉ A.regions → A.extent q = 0) →
    ∀ initial : BlockState, BackwardReal.Disjoint r → BackwardSafety.Bounds p (launch initial) r hasSeed A.extent →
      ∃ final, exec (A.flattenKernel kernel.toAlgKernel) (A.flattenState initial) = some final ∧
        BackwardIO.Post A p r hasSeed initial final)

name: Bounds
text:
structure Bounds (p : Layout) (l : Launch) (r : BackwardRegions)
    (hasSeed : Bool) (bounds : RegionBounds) : Prop where
  query : ∀ (t : Nat) (k : Fin p.BK), t < p.T → activeKey p l k.val →
    keyAddress p l t k.val < bounds r.q
  key : ∀ (t : Nat) (k : Fin p.BK), t < p.T → activeKey p l k.val →

  dv : ∀ (t : Nat) (j : Fin p.BV), t < p.T → activeValue p l j.val →
    outputAddress p l t j.val < bounds r.dv
  seed : hasSeed = Bool.true → ∀ (k : Fin p.BK) (j : Fin p.BV),

@[simp] theorem scatter_regs {α ι : Type} (items : List ι) (s : State α)
    (region : ι → RegionName) (offset : ι → Nat) (active : ι → Prop)
    [DecidablePred active] (value : ι → Cell α) :
    (items.foldl (fun t i => if active i then
      t.write (region i) (offset i) (value i) else t) s).regs = s.regs := by
  induction items generalizing s with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons i rest ih =>
    simp only [List.foldl_cons, ih]
    split <;> rfl

text:
def FullScatterIO (input output : Storage) (index : IndexStorage) (v : Bool)
    (out idx inp : RegionName) (rows n c s0 s1 BI BC : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ (A : FlatAlloc), A.Disjoint → A.regions = [inp,idx,out] →
    (∀ r, r ∉ A.regions → A.extent r = 0) →
  ∀ (s : BlockState) (ids : Fin BI → Int) (xs : Fin BI → Fin BC → ℝ),
    s.undef = (fun _ _ => 0) →
    (∀ (i : Fin BI), s.pids 0 * BI + i.val < n → 0 ≤ ids i) →
    (∀ (i : Fin BI), s.pids 0 * BI + i.val < n →
      s.pids 0 * BI + i.val < A.extent idx) →
    (∀ (i : Fin BI) (j : Fin BC), s.pids 0 * BI + i.val < n →
      s.pids 1 * BC + j.val < c →
      (s.pids 0 * BI + i.val) * s0 + (s.pids 1 * BC + j.val) * s1 < A.extent inp) →
    (∀ (i : Fin BI) (j : Fin BC), s.pids 0 * BI + i.val < n →
      s.pids 1 * BC + j.val < c →
      (ids i).toNat * s0 + (s.pids 1 * BC + j.val) * s1 < A.extent out) →
    (∀ (i : Fin BI), s.pids 0 * BI + i.val < n →
      s.readMemValue .int idx (s.pids 0 * BI + i.val) = ids i) →
    (∀ (i : Fin BI) (j : Fin BC), s.pids 0 * BI + i.val < n →
      s.pids 1 * BC + j.val < c →
      s.readMem inp ((s.pids 0 * BI + i.val) * s0 + (s.pids 1 * BC + j.val) * s1) = xs i j) →
    ∃ t, exec (A.flattenKernel
        (source input output index v out idx inp rows n c s0 s1 BI BC).eraseDType.toAlgKernel)
        (A.flattenState s) = some t ∧
      (∀ r ∈ A.regions, ∀ o, o < A.extent r →
        t.mem A.flat (A.addr r o) = A.trCell
          (scatterCell BI BC (s.pids 0) (s.pids 1) n c s0 s1 ids xs out r o (s.mem r o))) ∧
      (∀ r o, (r ≠ A.flat ∨ ∀ (i : Fin BI) (j : Fin BC),
          s.pids 0 * BI + i.val < n → s.pids 1 * BC + j.val < c →
          o ≠ A.addr out ((ids i).toNat * s0 + (s.pids 1 * BC + j.val) * s1)) →
        t.mem r o = (A.flattenState s).mem r o)

name: active
text:
def active
    (s : BlockState) (num_indices num_cols BLOCK_SIZE_INDEX BLOCK_SIZE_COL : Nat)
    (idx : TileIndex [BLOCK_SIZE_INDEX, BLOCK_SIZE_COL]) : Prop :=
  outputIndex s BLOCK_SIZE_INDEX idx.1 < num_indices ∧
    colIndex s BLOCK_SIZE_COL idx.2.1 < num_cols
