name: FullGatherIO
text:
def FullGatherIO (input output : Storage) (index : IndexStorage) (v : Bool)
    (out idx inp : RegionName) (n c s0 s1 BI BC : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ (A : FlatAlloc), A.Disjoint → A.regions = [inp,idx,out] →
    (∀ r, r ∉ A.regions → A.extent r = 0) →
  ∀ (s : BlockState) (ids : Fin BI → Int) (xs : Fin BI → Fin BC → ℝ),
    s.undef = (fun _ _ => 0) →
    (∀ (i : Fin BI), s.pids 0 * BI + i.val < n → 0 ≤ ids i) →
    (∀ (i : Fin BI), s.pids 0 * BI + i.val < n →
      s.pids 0 * BI + i.val < A.extent idx) →
    (∀ (i : Fin BI) (j : Fin BC), s.pids 0 * BI + i.val < n →
      s.pids 1 * BC + j.val < c →
      (ids i).toNat * s0 + (s.pids 1 * BC + j.val) * s1 < A.extent inp) →
    (∀ (i : Fin BI) (j : Fin BC), s.pids 0 * BI + i.val < n →
      s.pids 1 * BC + j.val < c →
      (s.pids 0 * BI + i.val) * s0 + (s.pids 1 * BC + j.val) * s1 < A.extent out) →
    (∀ (i : Fin BI), s.pids 0 * BI + i.val < n →
      s.readMemValue .int idx (s.pids 0 * BI + i.val) = ids i) →
    (∀ (i : Fin BI) (j : Fin BC), s.pids 0 * BI + i.val < n →
      s.pids 1 * BC + j.val < c →
      s.readMem inp ((ids i).toNat * s0 + (s.pids 1 * BC + j.val) * s1) = xs i j) →
    ∃ t, exec (A.flattenKernel
        (source input output index v out idx inp n c s0 s1 BI BC).eraseDType.toAlgKernel)
        (A.flattenState s) = some t ∧
      (∀ r ∈ A.regions, ∀ o, o < A.extent r →
        t.mem A.flat (A.addr r o) = A.trCell
          (gatherCell BI BC (s.pids 0) (s.pids 1) n c s0 s1 xs out r o (s.mem r o))) ∧
      (∀ r o, (r ≠ A.flat ∨ ∀ (i : Fin BI) (j : Fin BC),
          s.pids 0 * BI + i.val < n → s.pids 1 * BC + j.val < c →
          o ≠ A.addr out ((s.pids 0 * BI + i.val) * s0 + (s.pids 1 * BC + j.val) * s1)) →
        t.mem r o = (A.flattenState s).mem r o)

name: active
text:
def active
    (s : BlockState) (num_indices num_cols BLOCK_SIZE_INDEX BLOCK_SIZE_COL : Nat)
    (idx : TileIndex [BLOCK_SIZE_INDEX, BLOCK_SIZE_COL]) : Prop :=

    colBase s BLOCK_SIZE_COL idx.2.1 < num_cols

name: i4Inv
text:
noncomputable def i4Inv (s0 : BlockState) (a bs : RegionName)
    (b bzp : Region .nat)
    (M N group_size stride_am stride_ak stride_bk stride_bn stride_bsk
      stride_bsn stride_bzpk stride_bzpn BM BN BK GM numKBlocks : Nat)
    (i : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  i ≤ numKBlocks
  ∧ s.mem = s0.mem
  ∧ s.pids = s0.pids
  ∧ s.regs .nat [] "pid_m" = some (Tile.scalar (pidM s0 M N BM BN GM))
  ∧ s.regs .nat [] "pid_n" = some (Tile.scalar (pidN s0 M N BM BN GM))
  ∧ s.regs .nat [BK] "offs_k" = some (i4Offs 0 BK)
  ∧ s.regs .nat [BN] "offs_bn"
      = some (i4WrapOffs (pidN s0 M N BM BN GM * BN) BN N)
  ∧ s.regs .ptr [BM, BK] "a_ptrs"
      = some (i4APtrs a M stride_am stride_ak BM BK (pidM s0 M N BM BN GM) i)
  ∧ s.regs .ptr [BK, BN] "b_ptrs"
      = some (i4BPtrs b N stride_bk stride_bn BN BK (pidN s0 M N BM BN GM) i)
  ∧ s.regs .real [BM, BN] "accumulator"
      = some (i4AccTile s0 a bs b bzp M N group_size stride_am stride_ak
          stride_bk stride_bn stride_bsk stride_bsn stride_bzpk stride_bzpn
          BM BN BK (pidM s0 M N BM BN GM) (pidN s0 M N BM BN GM) i)

/-- The loop combinator writes the induction variable before each iteration,
and `i4Inv` constrains no register named `"k"`. -/

name: i8Inv
text:
noncomputable def i8Inv (s0 : BlockState) (A B : Region .int)
    (state_x state_w : RegionName)
    (M N stride_am stride_ak stride_bk stride_bn BM BN BK GM numKBlocks : Nat)
    (i : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  i ≤ numKBlocks
  ∧ s.mem = s0.mem
  ∧ s.pids = s0.pids
  ∧ s.regs .nat [BM] "rm" = some (i8Offs (pidM s0 M N BM BN GM * BM) BM)
  ∧ s.regs .nat [BN] "rn" = some (i8Offs (pidN s0 M N BM BN GM * BN) BN)
  ∧ s.regs .real [1, BN] "w_factor"
      = some (i8WTile s0 state_w N BN (pidN s0 M N BM BN GM))
  ∧ s.regs .real [BM, 1] "x_factor"
      = some (i8XTile s0 state_x M BM (pidM s0 M N BM BN GM))
  ∧ s.regs .ptr [BM, BK] "A"
      = some (i8APtrs A M stride_am stride_ak BM BK (pidM s0 M N BM BN GM) i)
  ∧ s.regs .ptr [BK, BN] "B"
      = some (i8BPtrs B N stride_bk stride_bn BN BK (pidN s0 M N BM BN GM) i)
  ∧ s.regs .int [BM, BN] "acc"
      = some (i8AccTile s0 A B M N stride_am stride_ak stride_bk stride_bn
          BM BN BK (pidM s0 M N BM BN GM) (pidN s0 M N BM BN GM) i)

/-- The loop combinator writes the induction variable before each iteration,
and `i8Inv` constrains no register named `"k"`. -/

name: imIInv
text:
noncomputable def imIInv (s0 : BlockState) (A : Region .int) (B : Region .nat)
    (M N stride_am stride_ak stride_bk stride_bn BM BN BK GM numKBlocks i : Nat)
    (j : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  j ≤ numKBlocks
  ∧ s.mem = s0.mem
  ∧ s.pids = s0.pids
  ∧ s.regs .nat [] "i" = some (Tile.scalar i)
  ∧ s.regs .nat [] "pid_m" = some (Tile.scalar (pidM s0 M N BM BN GM))
  ∧ s.regs .nat [] "pid_n" = some (Tile.scalar (pidN s0 M N BM BN GM))
  ∧ s.regs .nat [BK] "offs_k" = some (imOffs 0 BK)
  ∧ s.regs .nat [BN] "offs_bn"
      = some (imWrapOffs (pidN s0 M N BM BN GM * BN) BN N)
  ∧ s.regs .ptr [BM, BK] "a_ptrs"
      = some (imAPtrs A M stride_am stride_ak BM BK (pidM s0 M N BM BN GM)
          (i * numKBlocks + j))
  ∧ s.regs .ptr [BK, BN] "b_ptrs"
      = some (imBPtrs B N stride_bk stride_bn BN BK (pidN s0 M N BM BN GM) j)
  ∧ s.regs .int [BM, BN] "accumulator"
      = some (imAccTile s0 A B M N stride_am stride_ak stride_bk stride_bn
          BM BN BK numKBlocks (pidM s0 M N BM BN GM) (pidN s0 M N BM BN GM) i j)

/-- The state carried across outer fields. -/

name: imOInv
text:
noncomputable def imOInv (s0 : BlockState) (A : Region .int) (B : Region .nat)
    (M N stride_am stride_ak stride_bk stride_bn BM BN BK GM numKBlocks : Nat)
    (i : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  i ≤ 4
  ∧ s.mem = s0.mem
  ∧ s.pids = s0.pids
  ∧ s.regs .nat [] "pid_m" = some (Tile.scalar (pidM s0 M N BM BN GM))
  ∧ s.regs .nat [] "pid_n" = some (Tile.scalar (pidN s0 M N BM BN GM))
  ∧ s.regs .nat [BK] "offs_k" = some (imOffs 0 BK)
  ∧ s.regs .nat [BN] "offs_bn"
      = some (imWrapOffs (pidN s0 M N BM BN GM * BN) BN N)
  ∧ s.regs .ptr [BM, BK] "a_ptrs"
      = some (imAPtrs A M stride_am stride_ak BM BK (pidM s0 M N BM BN GM)
          (i * numKBlocks))
  ∧ s.regs .int [BM, BN] "accumulator"
      = some (imAccTile s0 A B M N stride_am stride_ak stride_bk stride_bn
          BM BN BK numKBlocks (pidM s0 M N BM BN GM) (pidN s0 M N BM BN GM) i 0)

/-- The inner combinator writes `"j"` before each iteration; `imIInv`
constrains no register named `"j"`. -/

name: qInv1
text:
noncomputable def qInv1 (s0 : BlockState) (fpa : RegionName) (a_ptr : Region .int)
    (M K sfm sfk sam sak BM BK numKBlocks : Nat) (i : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  i ≤ numKBlocks
  ∧ s.mem = s0.mem
  ∧ s.pids = s0.pids
  ∧ s.regs .nat [] "pid_m" = some (Tile.scalar (s0.pids 0))
  ∧ s.regs .nat [BK] "offs_k" = some (Tile.vec (fun e : Fin BK => e.val))
  ∧ s.regs .nat [BM] "offs_am" = some (qOffs (s0.pids 0 * BM) BM)
  ∧ s.regs .ptr [BM, BK] "fpa_ptrs" = some (qFpaPtrs fpa sfm sfk BM BK (s0.pids 0) i)
  ∧ s.regs .ptr [BM, BK] "a_ptrs"
      = some (qAPtrs (Region.cast a_ptr) sam sak BM BK (s0.pids 0) 0)
  ∧ s.regs .real [BM] "a_max" = some (qMaxTile s0 fpa K sfm sfk BM BK (s0.pids 0) i)

/-- The loop combinator writes the induction variable before each iteration;
`qInv1` constrains no register named `"k"`. -/

name: qInv2
text:
noncomputable def qInv2 (s0 : BlockState) (fpa : RegionName) (a_ptr : Region .int)
    (K sfm sfk sam sak BM BK numKBlocks : Nat) (i : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  i ≤ numKBlocks
  ∧ s.pids = s0.pids
  ∧ (∀ o, s.mem fpa o = s0.mem fpa o)
  ∧ s.regs .nat [] "pid_m" = some (Tile.scalar (s0.pids 0))
  ∧ s.regs .nat [BK] "offs_k" = some (Tile.vec (fun e : Fin BK => e.val))
  ∧ s.regs .real [BM] "a_scale"
      = some (qScaleTile s0 fpa K sfm sfk BM BK numKBlocks (s0.pids 0))
  ∧ s.regs .ptr [BM, BK] "fpa_ptrs"
      = some (qFpaPtrs fpa sfm sfk BM BK (s0.pids 0) i)
  ∧ s.regs .ptr [BM, BK] "a_ptrs"
      = some (qAPtrs (Region.cast a_ptr) sam sak BM BK (s0.pids 0) i)
  ∧ (∀ (r : Fin BM) (kg : Nat), kg < K → kg < i * BK →
      s.mem (Region.cast a_ptr) (qAAddrK sam sak BM (s0.pids 0) r.val kg)
        = MemCell.of .int (qInt8Spec K BK numKBlocks
            (qFpaElem s0 fpa sfm sfk (s0.pids 0 * BM + r.val)) kg))

name: mmInv
text:
noncomputable def mmInv (s0 : BlockState) (A B : Region .int)
    (as_ptr bs_ptr : RegionName)
    (M N K stride_am stride_ak stride_asm stride_bk stride_bn stride_bsn
      BM BN BK GM numKBlocks : Nat)
    (i : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  i ≤ numKBlocks
  ∧ s.mem = s0.mem
  ∧ s.pids = s0.pids
  ∧ s.regs .nat [] "pid_m" = some (Tile.scalar (mmPidM s0 M N BM BN GM))
  ∧ s.regs .nat [] "pid_n" = some (Tile.scalar (mmPidN s0 M N BM BN GM))
  ∧ s.regs .nat [BK] "offs_k" = some (mmOffs 0 BK)
  ∧ s.regs .real [BM] "a_scale"
      = some (mmAScaleTile s0 as_ptr M stride_asm BM (mmPidM s0 M N BM BN GM))
  ∧ s.regs .real [BN] "b_scale"
      = some (mmBScaleTile s0 bs_ptr N stride_bsn BN (mmPidN s0 M N BM BN GM))
  ∧ s.regs .ptr [BM, BK] "a_ptrs"
      = some (mmAPtrs A M stride_am stride_ak BM BK (mmPidM s0 M N BM BN GM) i)
  ∧ s.regs .ptr [BK, BN] "b_ptrs"
      = some (mmBPtrs B N stride_bk stride_bn BN BK (mmPidN s0 M N BM BN GM) i)
  ∧ s.regs .int [BM, BN] "accumulator"
      = some (mmAccTile s0 A B M N K stride_am stride_ak stride_bk stride_bn
          BM BN BK (mmPidM s0 M N BM BN GM) (mmPidN s0 M N BM BN GM) i)

/-- The loop combinator writes the induction variable before each iteration,
and `mmInv` constrains no register named `"k"`. -/

name: mmInv
text:
noncomputable def mmInv (s0 : BlockState) (a_ptr b_ptr : Region .int)
    (M N K sam sak sbk sbn BM BN BK GM : Nat) (c : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  s.mem = s0.mem
  ∧ s.undef = s0.undef
  ∧ s.pids = s0.pids
  ∧ s.regs .nat [] "pid_m" = some (Tile.scalar (mmPidM s0 M N BM BN GM))
  ∧ s.regs .nat [] "pid_n" = some (Tile.scalar (mmPidN s0 M N BM BN GM))
  ∧ s.regs .blockPtr [BM, BK] "a_block_ptr"
      = some (mmBPTile (Region.cast a_ptr) M K sam sak BM BK (mmPidM s0 M N BM BN GM * BM) c)
  ∧ s.regs .blockPtr [BK, BN] "b_block_ptr"
      = some (mmBPTile (Region.cast b_ptr) K N sbk sbn BK BN c (mmPidN s0 M N BM BN GM * BN))
  ∧ s.regs .int [BM, BN] "accumulator"
      = some (mmAccTile s0 a_ptr b_ptr M N K sam sak sbk sbn BM BN
          (mmPidM s0 M N BM BN GM) (mmPidN s0 M N BM BN GM) c)

/-- The loop combinator writes the counter register `"k"` (unused by the
body); `mmInv` constrains no register named `"k"`. -/

name: smInv
text:
noncomputable def smInv (s0 : BlockState) (a_ptr b_ptr : Region .int)
    (M N K sam sak sbk sbn BM BN BK GM numKBlocks : Nat)
    (j : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  j ≤ numKBlocks
  ∧ s.mem = s0.mem
  ∧ s.pids = s0.pids
  ∧ s.regs .nat [] "pid_m" = some (Tile.scalar (smPidM s0 M N BM BN GM))
  ∧ s.regs .nat [] "pid_n" = some (Tile.scalar (smPidN s0 M N BM BN GM))
  ∧ s.regs .nat [BK] "rk" = some (smOffs 0 BK)
  ∧ s.regs .ptr [BM, BK] "A"
      = some (smAPtrs a_ptr M sam sak BM BK (smPidM s0 M N BM BN GM) j)
  ∧ s.regs .ptr [BK, BN] "B"
      = some (smBPtrs b_ptr N sbk sbn BK BN (smPidN s0 M N BM BN GM) j)
  ∧ s.regs .int [BM, BN] "acc"
      = some (smAccTile s0 a_ptr b_ptr M N K sam sak sbk sbn BM BN BK
          (smPidM s0 M N BM BN GM) (smPidN s0 M N BM BN GM) j)

/-- The loop combinator writes `"j"`; `smInv` constrains no register named
`"j"`. -/

name: correct_target
text:
def correct_target {α : Type} [Inhabited α] (model : Algebra α → Algebra α)
    (classify : α → Bool) (kernel : ComputeKernel) (p : Parameters) : Prop :=
  ∀ (rest : Algebra α) (bits : Nat → α) (initial : State α),
    p.input ≠ p.output → 0 < p.outputStride → InputBits p bits initial →
    ∃ final, FP.Structural.exec (model rest) kernel initial = some final ∧
      Post classify p bits initial final

name: Contract32
text:
def Contract32 (kernel : ComputeKernel) (p : Parameters) : Prop :=
  correct_target (fun rest => engine (backend32 rest)) finite32 kernel p

name: Contract64
text:
def Contract64 (kernel : ComputeKernel) (p : Parameters) : Prop :=
  correct_target (fun rest => engine (backend64 rest)) finite64 kernel p

name: assumptions
text: def assumptions : Spec.Assumptions FP.GuardedFragment := []

name: InputBits
text:
def InputBits {α : Type} (p : Parameters) (bits : Nat → α) (s : State α) : Prop :=
  ∀ x, x < p.size → s.mem p.input (x * p.inputStride) = .mk .real (bits x)

name: Written
text:
def Written (p : Parameters) (pid numCtas : Nat) (r : RegionName) (o : Nat) : Prop :=
  r = p.output ∧ ∃ x, SourceCovers p pid numCtas x ∧ o = x * p.outputStride

name: Post
text:
def Post {α : Type} (classify : α → Bool) (p : Parameters) (bits : Nat → α)
    (initial final : State α) : Prop :=
  (∀ x, SourceCovers p (initial.pids 0) (initial.numPids 0) x →
    final.mem p.output (x * p.outputStride) = .mk .bool (classify (bits x))) ∧
  (∀ r o, ¬Written p (initial.pids 0) (initial.numPids 0) r o →
    final.mem r o = initial.mem r o)

name: OneReady
text:
def OneReady {α : Type} (pid : Nat) (s : State α) : Prop :=
  s.regs .nat [] "pid" = some (fun _ => pid)

name: LoopReady
text:
def LoopReady {α : Type} (pid numCtas : Nat) (s : State α) : Prop :=
  OneReady pid s ∧ s.regs .nat [] "num_ctas" = some (fun _ => numCtas)

name: TileCovers
text:
def TileCovers (p : Parameters) (base x : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ i : Fin p.block, base + i.val = x ∧ x < p.size

name: IterCovers
text:
def IterCovers (p : Parameters) (pid numCtas : Nat) : Nat → Nat → Nat → Prop
  | 0, _, _ => False
  | n + 1, cur, x =>
      TileCovers p ((pid + cur * numCtas) * p.block) x ∨
      IterCovers p pid numCtas n (cur + 1) x

name: SourceCovers
StepTransport
text:
def StepTransport (st : ComputeStmt) (s : State α) : Prop :=
  ∀ t, FP.Structural.step M st s = some t →
    FP.Structural.step M (flattenComputeStmt A st)
      (flattenState A background flatUndef s) = some (flattenState A background flatUndef t)

name: RunTransport
text:
def RunTransport (body : List ComputeStmt) (s : State α) : Prop :=
  ∀ t, FP.Structural.run M body s = some t →
    FP.Structural.run M (flattenComputeStmts A body)
      (flattenState A background flatUndef s) = some (flattenState A background flatUndef t)

name: LocalTransport
text:
def LocalTransport (A : FlatAlloc) (M : Algebra α)
    (background : RegionName → Nat → Cell α)
    (flatUndef : (d : TileDType) → RegionName → Nat → Value α d) :
    List ComputeStmt → State α → Prop
  | [], _ => True
  | st :: rest, s => StepTransport A M background flatUndef st s ∧
      ∀ u, FP.Structural.step M st s = some u →
        LocalTransport A M background flatUndef rest u

name: FlatPost
text:
def FlatPost (A : FlatAlloc) (classify : α → Bool) (p : Parameters) (bits : Nat → α)
    (initial final : State α) : Prop :=
  (∀ x, SourceCovers p (initial.pids 0) (initial.numPids 0) x →
    final.mem A.flat (A.addr p.output (x * p.outputStride)) = .mk .bool (classify (bits x))) ∧
  (∀ r o, ¬FlatWritten A (Written p (initial.pids 0) (initial.numPids 0)) r o →
    final.mem r o = initial.mem r o)

name: OpSame
OpCommutes
text:
def OpCommutes (p : Option ComputeDType) {d : TileDType} {sh : TileShape}
    (e : Op d sh) : Prop :=
  evalOp M p (A.flattenOp e) (flattenState A background flatUndef s) =
    (evalOp M p e s).map (trValues A)

name: ComputeSame
ComputeCommutes
ExprSame
text:
def ExprSame {d : AlgDType} {sh : TileShape} (e : ComputeExpr d sh) : Prop :=
  evalExpr M (flattenExpr A e) (flattenState A background flatUndef s) = evalExpr M e s

name: ExprCommutes
UndefCompatible
text:
def UndefCompatible (d : TileDType) : Prop :=
  ∀ r o, flatUndef d A.flat (A.addr r o) = s.undef d r o

name: SourcePtrSafe
text:
def SourcePtrSafe (p : Parametric.Parameters) (name : RegName) (s : State α) : Prop :=
  ∀ ps, s.regs .blockPtr [p.block] name = some ps → ∀ i,
    (ps i).inBounds (TileShape.indexToList [p.block] i) [0] = Bool.true →
    (ps i).region ∈ A.regions ∧
      (ps i).address (TileShape.indexToList [p.block] i) < A.extent (ps i).region

name: FlatWritten
GridReady
ivdmInvariant
text:
noncomputable def ivdmInvariant
    (A B : RegionName) (s0 : BlockState)
    (PM PN M N BM BN SAM SAK SBK SBN BLOCK_K numKBlocks : Nat)
    (c : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  s.pids = s0.pids ∧ c ≤ numKBlocks ∧
  (s.regs .real [BM, BN] "accumulator" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BM, BN] =>
      some (accPartial s0 A B PM PN BM BN M N SAM SAK SBK SBN BLOCK_K idx.1 idx.2.1 c)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [] "pid_m" = some (Tile.scalar PM)) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [] "pid_n" = some (Tile.scalar PN)) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [BM] "offs_am" = some (Tile.vec (fun i : Fin BM => (PM * BM + i.val) % M))) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [BN] "offs_bn" = some (Tile.vec (fun j : Fin BN => (PN * BN + j.val) % N))) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [BLOCK_K] "offs_k" = some (Tile.vec (fun e : Fin BLOCK_K => e.val))) ∧
  (s.regs .ptr [BM, BLOCK_K] "a_ptr" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BM, BLOCK_K] =>
      (A.cast, (PM * BM + idx.1.val) % M * SAM + idx.2.1.val * SAK)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .ptr [BLOCK_K, BN] "b_ptr" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BLOCK_K, BN] =>
      (B.cast, idx.1.val * SBK + (PN * BN + idx.2.1.val) % N * SBN)⟩) ∧
  (∀ rg o, s.undef rg o = 0) ∧ (s.mem = s0.mem)

set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000 in
/-- **preLoop** (statements 0–9): from a clean input state (`undef = 0`), the
prologue steps to a state satisfying `ivdmInvariant … 0` — the base case
(`accumulator = 0`, `a_ptr`/`b_ptr` bases seeded). -/

name: ivdmSafeInv
text:
private def ivdmSafeInv (A B : RegionName) (PM PN M N BM BN SAM SAK SBK SBN BK : Nat)
    (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  (s.regs .nat [] "pid_m" = some (Tile.scalar PM)) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [] "pid_n" = some (Tile.scalar PN)) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [BK] "offs_k" = some (Tile.vec (fun e : Fin BK => e.val))) ∧
  (∃ zT : Tile .real [BM, BN], s.regs .real [BM, BN] "accumulator" = some zT) ∧
  (s.regs .ptr [BM, BK] "a_ptr" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BM, BK] =>
      (A.cast, (PM * BM + idx.1.val) % M * SAM + idx.2.1.val * SAK)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .ptr [BK, BN] "b_ptr" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BK, BN] =>
      (B.cast, idx.1.val * SBK + (PN * BN + idx.2.1.val) % N * SBN)⟩)

set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000 in
/-- Weak `preLoop`: from an **arbitrary** state the prologue steps to a state
satisfying `ivdmSafeInv` (no clean-`undef` hypothesis; the value half of
`ivdm_preLoop` is dropped). -/

name: ForwardElementIO
text:
def ForwardElementIO (kernel : ComputeKernel) (A : FlatAlloc) (s : BlockState)
    (Y T O : RegionName) (sy st so N : Nat) (eps : ℝ) (flag : Bool) : Prop :=
  kernel.eraseDType.toAlgKernel.TraceSafeR .triv A.extent s ∧
    ∃ t, exec (A.flattenKernel kernel.eraseDType.toAlgKernel)
      (A.flattenState s) = some t ∧
    (∀ k : Fin N,
      t.readMem A.flat (A.addr O (s.pids 0 * so + k.val)) =
        FullMath.loss flag eps (s.readMem Y (s.pids 0 * sy + k.val))
          (s.readMem T (s.pids 0 * st + k.val))) ∧
    (∀ r off, (r ≠ A.flat ∨ ∀ k : Fin N,
      off ≠ A.addr O (s.pids 0 * so + k.val)) →
        t.mem r off = (A.flattenState s).mem r off)

the independent whole-row loss before one scalar store, with a full raw frame. -/

name: ForwardReductionIO

      (A.flattenState s) = some t ∧
    t.readMem A.flat (A.addr O (s.pids 0 * so)) =
      FullMath.rowLoss flag eps (fun k ↦ s.readMem Y (s.pids 0 * sy + k))
        (fun k ↦ s.readMem T (s.pids 0 * st + k)) N ∧
    (∀ r off, (r ≠ A.flat ∨ off ≠ A.addr O (s.pids 0 * so)) →
      t.mem r off = (A.flattenState s).mem r off)

name: ExpInputSupported
text:
def ExpInputSupported (target : Storage) : Prop :=
  target = .fp32 ∨ target = .fp64

/-- A nonzero reduction carries the original fp32 `loss_sum = 0.0`.
An fp64 prediction or target would change its type in the dry-visited loop body,
which pinned Triton rejects. Runtime N=0 does not remove this type restriction.
Output storage does not determine the accumulator's type. -/

name: CarrySupported
text:
def CarrySupported (pred target : Storage) (reduction : Nat) : Prop :=
  reduction = 0 ∨ (pred ≠ .fp64 ∧ target ≠ .fp64)

/-- Frontend admission for a Python-float runtime fp32 epsilon argument.
The default clamp promotes narrower targets before log; the log-target branch
uses raw exp. This predicate states these frontend restrictions only: native
launch validity, integer overflow and hardware lowering remain separate. -/

name: ForwardSourceSupported
text:
def ForwardSourceSupported (pred target : Storage) (_output : Storage)
    (logTarget : Bool) (reduction : Nat) : Prop :=
  (logTarget = Bool.true → ExpInputSupported target) ∧
    CarrySupported pred target reduction

name: ForwardDefaultSupported
text:
def ForwardDefaultSupported (pred target output : Storage) (reduction : Nat) : Prop :=
  ForwardSourceSupported pred target output Bool.false reduction

name: ForwardLogSupported
text:
def ForwardLogSupported (pred : Storage) (target : MathStorage)
    (output : Storage) (reduction : Nat) : Prop :=
  ForwardSourceSupported pred target.storage output Bool.true reduction

/-- Pinned Triton exposes nonzero floating scalar builders for these four
storage types. Its fp8 type builders do not supply nonzero scalar values. -/

name: NonzeroScalarSupported
text:
def NonzeroScalarSupported (target : Storage) : Prop :=
  target ≠ .f8e4 ∧ target ≠ .f8e5

requires the nonzero weak scalar -1; log-target exp has its own restriction. -/

name: ForwardIO
text:
def ForwardIO (kernel : ComputeKernel) (Y T O : RegionName)
    (sy st so N B : Nat) (flag : Bool) (reduction : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ (A : FlatAlloc) (s : BlockState), A.Disjoint → A.regions = [Y, T, O] →
    (∀ r, r ∉ A.regions → A.extent r = 0) → s.undef = (fun _ _ ↦ 0) →
    (∀ k : Fin N, s.pids 0 * sy + k.val < A.extent Y) →
    (∀ k : Fin N, s.pids 0 * st + k.val < A.extent T) →
    (∀ k : Fin (FullMath.outputCount N B reduction),
      s.pids 0 * so + k.val < A.extent O) →
    kernel.eraseDType.toAlgKernel.TraceSafeR .triv A.extent s ∧
    ∃ t, exec (A.flattenKernel kernel.eraseDType.toAlgKernel) (A.flattenState s) = some t ∧
      (∀ k : Fin (FullMath.outputCount N B reduction),
        t.readMem A.flat (A.addr O (s.pids 0 * so + k.val)) =
          FullMath.forwardOutput flag (fun i ↦ s.readMem Y (s.pids 0 * sy + i))
            (fun i ↦ s.readMem T (s.pids 0 * st + i)) N B reduction k.val) ∧
      (∀ r off, (r ≠ A.flat ∨ ∀ k : Fin (FullMath.outputCount N B reduction),
        off ≠ A.addr O (s.pids 0 * so + k.val)) →
          t.mem r off = (A.flattenState s).mem r off)

/-- Actual access safety, successful full flat backward execution, independent
scalar gradients and every untouched cell. -/

name: BackwardIO
text:
def BackwardIO (kernel : ComputeKernel) (T O : RegionName)
    (st so N : Nat) (flag : Bool) : Prop :=
  ∀ (A : FlatAlloc) (s : BlockState), A.Disjoint → A.regions = [T, O] →
    (∀ r, r ∉ A.regions → A.extent r = 0) → s.undef = (fun _ _ ↦ 0) →
    (∀ k : Fin N, s.pids 0 * st + k.val < A.extent T) →
    (∀ k : Fin N, s.pids 0 * so + k.val < A.extent O) →
    kernel.eraseDType.toAlgKernel.TraceSafeR .triv A.extent s ∧
    ∃ t, exec (A.flattenKernel kernel.eraseDType.toAlgKernel) (A.flattenState s) = some t ∧
      (∀ k : Fin N, t.readMem A.flat (A.addr O (s.pids 0 * so + k.val)) =
        FullMath.gradient flag (s.readMem T (s.pids 0 * st + k.val))) ∧
      (∀ r off, (r ≠ A.flat ∨ ∀ k : Fin N, off ≠ A.addr O (s.pids 0 * so + k.val)) →
        t.mem r off = (A.flattenState s).mem r off)

name: footprint

def footprint (O : RegionName) (base N B reduction : Nat) (address : RegionName × Nat) : Prop :=
  address.1 = O ∧ ∃ k, k < FullMath.outputCount N B reduction ∧ address.2 = base + k

name: Context
text:
structure Context (initial : BlockState) (Y T O : RegionName)

  frame : BlockState.WriteWithin (footprint O base N B reduction) initial s
  inputY : ∀ k, s.mem Y k = initial.mem Y k

name: Inv
text:
structure Inv (initial : BlockState) (Y T O : RegionName)
    (yBase tBase base N B c reduction : Nat) (flag : Bool) (s : BlockState) : Prop where
  context : Context initial Y T O yBase tBase base N B c reduction s
  elements : reduction = 0 → ∀ t lane, t < c → lane < B → t * B + lane < N →
    s.readMem O (base + (t * B + lane)) =
      FullMath.loss flag (initial.readMem Y (yBase + (t * B + lane)))
        (initial.readMem T (tBase + (t * B + lane)))
  chunks : reduction ≠ 0 → ∀ t, t < c → s.readMem O (base + t) =
    FullMath.chunkLoss flag (fun k ↦ initial.readMem Y (yBase + k))
      (fun k ↦ initial.readMem T (tBase + k)) N B t

name: blockFootprint
text:
def blockFootprint (O : RegionName) (base N B current reduction : Nat)
    (address : RegionName × Nat) : Prop :=
  if reduction = 0 then
    address.1 = O ∧ ∃ lane, lane < B ∧ current + lane < N ∧
      address.2 = base + current + lane
  else address.1 = O ∧ address.2 = base

/-- The raw-cell frame includes every region and does not assume output/input separation. -/

name: klInv
text:
def klInv (y_ptr gt_ptr loss_ptr : RegionName)
    (y_stride gt_stride loss_stride n_cols B : Nat)
    (s₀ : BlockState) (i : Nat) (st : BlockState) : Prop :=
  B ∣ i ∧
  st.regs .ptr [] "y_ptr"
      = some (Tile.scalar ((y_ptr : RegionName), s₀.pids 0 * y_stride)) ∧
  st.regs .ptr [] "gt_ptr"
      = some (Tile.scalar ((gt_ptr : RegionName), s₀.pids 0 * gt_stride)) ∧
  st.regs .ptr [] "loss_ptr"
      = some (Tile.scalar ((loss_ptr : RegionName), s₀.pids 0 * loss_stride)) ∧
  st.regs .nat [B] "base_offsets" = some (Tile.vec (fun j : Fin B => j.val)) ∧
  (∀ m, m < n_cols → st.readMem loss_ptr (s₀.pids 0 * loss_stride + m)
      = if m < i then klCell y_ptr gt_ptr y_stride gt_stride s₀ m
        else s₀.readMem loss_ptr (s₀.pids 0 * loss_stride + m)) ∧
  (∀ r oo, (r ≠ loss_ptr ∨ ∀ m, m < n_cols → oo ≠ s₀.pids 0 * loss_stride + m) →
      st.mem r oo = s₀.mem r oo)

/-- Cell-level frame of a `Bool`-masked exact `writeMem` scatter `foldl`:
every cell not hit by an active lane is untouched. (The cell-level sibling of
the shared `foldl_store_preserve`, which is stated for `readMem`.) -/

name: inRow
text: def inRow (base N offset : Nat) : Prop := base ≤ offset ∧ offset < base + N

name: written
text:
def written (f : Flags) (r : Regions) (stride : Strides)
    (M N row : Nat) (region : RegionName) (offset : Nat) : Prop :=
  (f.w1 = true ∧ region = r.y1 ∧ inRow (row * stride.y1) N offset) ∨
  (region = r.y ∧ inRow (row * stride.y) N offset) ∨
  (region = r.rstd ∧ offset = row) ∨
  (f.rms = false ∧ region = r.mean ∧ offset = row) ∨
  (f.residualOut = true ∧ region = r.residualOut ∧
    inRow (row * stride.residualOut) N offset) ∨
  (f.dropout = true ∧ f.dropoutMask = true ∧ f.x1 = true ∧
    region = r.dropoutMask ∧ inRow ((M + row) * N) N offset) ∨
  (f.dropout = true ∧ f.dropoutMask = true ∧
    region = r.dropoutMask ∧ inRow (row * N) N offset)

/-- Full exact tagged memory postcondition. Inactive buffers and out-of-row
cells retain the complete MemCell, rather than just its real-valued readback. -/

name: Post
text:
def Post (f : Flags) (r : Regions) (stride : Strides)
    (M N : Nat) (eps p : ℝ) (initial final : BlockState) : Prop :=
  ∀ region offset,
    final.mem region offset =
      (expectedCell f r stride (snapshot r stride initial) M N eps p initial.pid
        region offset).getD (initial.mem region offset)

structure Extents (f : Flags) (r : Regions) (stride : Strides) (M N : Nat)
    (bounds : RegionBounds) : Prop where
  x : span M N stride.x ≤ bounds r.x
  y : span M N stride.y ≤ bounds r.y
  weight : N ≤ bounds r.weight
  rstd : M ≤ bounds r.rstd
  bias : f.bias = Bool.true → N ≤ bounds r.bias
  mean : f.rms = Bool.false → M ≤ bounds r.mean
  residual : f.residual = Bool.true → span M N stride.residual ≤ bounds r.residual
  residualOut : f.residualOut = Bool.true → span M N stride.residualOut ≤ bounds r.residualOut
  x1 : f.x1 = Bool.true → span M N stride.x1 ≤ bounds r.x1
  weight1 : f.w1 = Bool.true → N ≤ bounds r.weight1
  bias1 : f.w1 = Bool.true → f.b1 = Bool.true → N ≤ bounds r.bias1
  y1 : f.w1 = Bool.true → span M N stride.y1 ≤ bounds r.y1
  rowscale : f.rowscale = Bool.true → M ≤ bounds r.rowscale
  rowscale1 : f.x1 = Bool.true → f.rowscale = Bool.true → 2*M ≤ bounds r.rowscale
  seeds : f.dropout = Bool.true → M ≤ bounds r.seeds
  seeds1 : f.x1 = Bool.true → f.dropout = Bool.true → 2*M ≤ bounds r.seeds
  mask : f.dropout = Bool.true → f.dropoutMask = Bool.true → M*N ≤ bounds r.dropoutMask
  mask1 : f.x1 = Bool.true → f.dropout = Bool.true → f.dropoutMask = Bool.true →
    2*M*N ≤ bounds r.dropoutMask

/-- Bounds in the coordinates used by each actual load/store expression. -/

name: RowBounds
text:
structure RowBounds (f : Flags) (r : Regions) (stride : Strides) (M N row : Nat)
    (bounds : RegionBounds) : Prop where
  x : ∀ col, col < N → row*stride.x+col < bounds r.x
  y : ∀ col, col < N → row*stride.y+col < bounds r.y
  weight : ∀ col, col < N → col < bounds r.weight
  rstd : row < bounds r.rstd
  bias : f.bias = Bool.true → ∀ col, col < N → col < bounds r.bias
  mean : f.rms = Bool.false → row < bounds r.mean
  residual : f.residual = Bool.true → ∀ col, col < N → row*stride.residual+col < bounds r.residual
  residualOut : f.residualOut = Bool.true → ∀ col, col < N → row*stride.residualOut+col < bounds r.residualOut
  x1 : f.x1 = Bool.true → ∀ col, col < N → row*stride.x1+col < bounds r.x1
  weight1 : f.w1 = Bool.true → ∀ col, col < N → col < bounds r.weight1
  bias1 : f.w1 = Bool.true → f.b1 = Bool.true → ∀ col, col < N → col < bounds r.bias1
  y1 : f.w1 = Bool.true → ∀ col, col < N → row*stride.y1+col < bounds r.y1
  rowscale : f.rowscale = Bool.true → row < bounds r.rowscale
  rowscale1 : f.x1 = Bool.true → f.rowscale = Bool.true → M+row < bounds r.rowscale
  seeds : f.dropout = Bool.true → row < bounds r.seeds
  seeds1 : f.x1 = Bool.true → f.dropout = Bool.true → M+row < bounds r.seeds
  mask : f.dropout = Bool.true → f.dropoutMask = Bool.true →
    ∀ col, col < N → row*N+col < bounds r.dropoutMask
  mask1 : f.x1 = Bool.true → f.dropout = Bool.true → f.dropoutMask = Bool.true →
    ∀ col, col < N → (M+row)*N+col < bounds r.dropoutMask

name: readRegion
text:
def readRegion (f : Flags) (r : Regions) (region : RegionName) : Prop :=
  region = r.x ∨ region = r.weight ∨
  (f.x1 = Bool.true ∧ region = r.x1) ∨
  (f.residual = Bool.true ∧ region = r.residual) ∨
  (f.bias = Bool.true ∧ region = r.bias) ∨
  (f.rowscale = Bool.true ∧ region = r.rowscale) ∨
  (f.dropout = Bool.true ∧ region = r.seeds) ∨
  (f.w1 = Bool.true ∧ region = r.weight1) ∨
  (f.w1 = Bool.true ∧ f.b1 = Bool.true ∧ region = r.bias1)

name: writeRegion
text:
def writeRegion (f : Flags) (r : Regions) (region : RegionName) : Prop :=
  region = r.y ∨ region = r.rstd ∨
  (f.rms = Bool.false ∧ region = r.mean) ∨
  (f.residualOut = Bool.true ∧ region = r.residualOut) ∨
  (f.w1 = Bool.true ∧ region = r.y1) ∨
  (f.dropout = Bool.true ∧ f.dropoutMask = Bool.true ∧ region = r.dropoutMask)

execution and of the output contract. Output-to-output aliases are handled
by the contract's explicit last-store order, not excluded by this predicate. -/

text:
def Implements (kernel : Kernel) (f : Flags) (r : Regions) (stride : Strides)
    (M N : Nat) (eps p : ℝ) (block : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ A : FlatAlloc, A.Disjoint → (∀ q, q ∉ A.regions → A.extent q = 0) →
  ∀ initial : BlockState, initial.pid < M → N ≤ block → Domain.ReadWriteSeparated f r →
    initial.undef = (fun _ _ => 0) → FlatDomain.Extents f r stride M N A.extent →
    ∃ final, exec (A.flattenKernel kernel) (A.flattenState initial) = some final ∧
      FlatContract.Post A f r stride M N eps p initial final ∧
      (∀ region offset, FlatContract.Outside A f r stride M N initial region offset →
        final.mem region offset = (A.flattenState initial).mem region offset)

name: Ready
text:
def Ready (s : State (WithBot ℝ)) : Prop :=
  s.regs .nat [] "row" = some (fun _ => 1) ∧
  s.regs .nat [4] "cols" = some (fun j => j.1.val) ∧
  s.regs .ptr [] "Y" = some (fun _ => (("Y" : RegionName), 4)) ∧
  s.regs .ptr [] "X1" = some (fun _ => (("X1" : RegionName), 7)) ∧
  s.regs .ptr [] "RESIDUAL" = some (fun _ => (("RESIDUAL" : RegionName), 5)) ∧
  s.regs .ptr [] "RESIDUAL_OUT" = some (fun _ => (("RESIDUAL_OUT" : RegionName), 6)) ∧
  s.regs .ptr [] "Y1" = some (fun _ => (("Y1" : RegionName), 8)) ∧
  ∃ x, s.regs .real [4] "x" = some x

/-- A masked store leaves the complete register map intact, including lanes
whose inactive accesses retain unspecified values. -/
@[simp] theorem masked_scatter_regs {α ι : Type} (s : State α) (items : List ι)
    (address : ι → RegionName × Nat) (active : ι → Bool) (value : ι → Cell α) :
    (items.foldl (fun t i => if active i then
      t.write (address i).1 (address i).2 (value i) else t) s).regs = s.regs := by
  induction items generalizing s with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons i rest ih =>
    simp only [List.foldl_cons, ih]
    split <;> rfl

/-- The same register frame after the evaluator simplifies a boolean mask
to its proposition. Separate region/offset functions match actual stores. -/
@[simp] theorem guarded_scatter_regs {α ι : Type} (s : State α) (items : List ι)
    (region : ι → RegionName) (offset : ι → Nat) (active : ι → Prop)
    [DecidablePred active] (value : ι → Cell α) :
    (items.foldl (fun t i => if active i then
      t.write (region i) (offset i) (value i) else t) s).regs = s.regs := by
  induction items generalizing s with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons i rest ih =>
    simp only [List.foldl_cons, ih]
    split <;> rfl

@[simp] theorem scatter_regs {α ι : Type} (s : State α) (items : List ι)
    (region : ι → RegionName) (offset : ι → Nat) (value : ι → Cell α) :
    (items.foldl (fun t i => t.write (region i) (offset i) (value i)) s).regs = s.regs := by
  induction items generalizing s with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons i rest ih =>
    rw [List.foldl_cons, ih]
    rfl

name: ExactIO
text:
def ExactIO (kernel : ComputeKernel) (alloc : FlatAlloc) (s : BlockState)
    (OUT : RegionName) (M N K soutm soutn BM BN BK : Nat) (EPS : ℝ)
    (xs : Fin (Mathematics.steps K BK) → Fin BM → Fin BK → ℝ)
    (rs : Fin (Mathematics.steps K BK) → Fin BK → ℝ)
    (w1 w3 : Fin (Mathematics.steps K BK) → Fin BK → Fin BN → ℝ) : Prop :=
  kernel.eraseDType.toAlgKernel.TraceSafe alloc.extent s ∧
  ∃ t, exec (alloc.flattenKernel kernel.eraseDType.toAlgKernel)
      (alloc.flattenState s) = some t ∧
    (∀ idx : TileIndex [BM, BN], active s M N BM BN idx →
      t.readMem alloc.flat (alloc.addr OUT (outOffset s N BM BN soutm soutn idx)) =
        Mathematics.output K BK BM BN EPS xs rs w1 w3 idx.1 idx.2.1) ∧
    (∀ r o, (r ≠ alloc.flat ∨ ∀ idx : TileIndex [BM, BN], active s M N BM BN idx →
      o ≠ alloc.addr OUT (outOffset s N BM BN soutm soutn idx)) →
      t.mem r o = (alloc.flattenState s).mem r o)

/-- Byte-source IO retains finite E5M2 values in the independent array formula,
actual trace safety, successful finite-flat execution and the full cell frame. -/

name: ByteIO
text:
def ByteIO (kernel : ComputeKernel) (alloc : FlatAlloc) (s : BlockState)
    (OUT : RegionName) (M N K soutm soutn BM BN BK : Nat) (EPS : ℝ)
    (xs : Fin (Mathematics.steps K BK) → Fin BM → Fin BK → ℝ)
    (rs : Fin (Mathematics.steps K BK) → Fin BK → Mathematics.Byte)
    (w1 w3 : Fin (Mathematics.steps K BK) → Fin BK → Fin BN → Mathematics.Byte) : Prop :=
  kernel.eraseDType.toAlgKernel.TraceSafe alloc.extent s ∧
  ∃ t, exec (alloc.flattenKernel kernel.eraseDType.toAlgKernel)
      (alloc.flattenState s) = some t ∧
    (∀ idx : TileIndex [BM, BN], active s M N BM BN idx →
      t.readMem alloc.flat (alloc.addr OUT (outOffset s N BM BN soutm soutn idx)) =
        Mathematics.output K BK BM BN EPS xs (fun t e => (rs t e).value)
          (fun t e j => (w1 t e j).value) (fun t e j => (w3 t e j).value)
          idx.1 idx.2.1) ∧
    (∀ r o, (r ≠ alloc.flat ∨ ∀ idx : TileIndex [BM, BN], active s M N BM BN idx →
      o ≠ alloc.addr OUT (outOffset s N BM BN soutm soutn idx)) →
      t.mem r o = (alloc.flattenState s).mem r o)

name: Inputs
text:
def Inputs (s : BlockState) (A W1 W3 RMS : RegionName)
    (M N K BM BN BK sam sak sw1k sw1n sw3k sw3n srms : Nat)
    (xs : Fin (Mathematics.steps K BK) → Fin BM → Fin BK → ℝ)
    (rs : Fin (Mathematics.steps K BK) → Fin BK → Mathematics.Byte)
    (w1 w3 : Fin (Mathematics.steps K BK) → Fin BK → Fin BN → Mathematics.Byte) : Prop :=
  (∀ t i e, aElem s A M N BM BN sam sak i (t.val * BK + e.val) = xs t i e) ∧
  (∀ t e, s.readMemTyped .int RMS ((t.val * BK + e.val) * srms) = some (rs t e).val) ∧
  (∀ t e j, s.readMemTyped .int W1 ((t.val * BK + e.val) * sw1k + colIndex s N BN j * sw1n) = some (w1 t e j).val) ∧
  (∀ t e j, s.readMemTyped .int W3 ((t.val * BK + e.val) * sw3k + colIndex s N BN j * sw3n) = some (w3 t e j).val)

name: Bytes
text:
def Bytes (s : BlockState) (W1 W3 RMS : RegionName)
    (N BN BK sw1k sw1n sw3k sw3n srms blocks : Nat) : Prop :=
  (∀ t < blocks, ∀ (e : Fin BK) (j : Fin BN),
    ByteLoads.FiniteAt s W1 (e.val * sw1k + colIndex s N BN j * sw1n + t * BK * sw1k)) ∧
  (∀ t < blocks, ∀ (e : Fin BK) (j : Fin BN),
    ByteLoads.FiniteAt s W3 (e.val * sw3k + colIndex s N BN j * sw3n + t * BK * sw3k)) ∧
  (∀ t < blocks, ∀ e : Fin BK,
    ByteLoads.FiniteAt s RMS (e.val * srms + t * BK * srms))

/-- Numerical registers follow the real recurrence of the finite decoded
input view; the source state retains every original typed memory cell. -/

name: Invariant
text:
def Invariant (A W1 W3 RMS : RegionName) (initial : BlockState)
    (M N BM BN BK sam sak sw1k sw1n sw3k sw3n srms blocks t : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  ffInvariant A W1 W3 RMS (ByteLoads.view W1 W3 RMS initial)
    M N BM BN BK sam sak sw1k sw1n sw3k sw3n srms blocks t
    (ByteLoads.view W1 W3 RMS s) ∧ s.mem = initial.mem

RMS moment by the actual loaded values, preserving the original raw memory. -/

name: FiniteAt
text:
def FiniteAt (s : BlockState) (r : RegionName) (o : Nat) : Prop :=
  Float8E5Bits.isInt8 (s.readMemValue .int r o) = Bool.true ∧
    (Float8E5Bits.ofInt (s.readMemValue .int r o)).decodeRat.isSome = Bool.true

/-- The input view decodes finite weight cells and retains all other original
cells, including nonfinite or invalid bytes. Only finite loaded cells are used
by the real recurrence; no NaN/Inf encoding is assigned a real zero. -/

name: active
text:
def active (s : BlockState) (M N BM BN : Nat) (idx : TileIndex [BM, BN]) : Prop :=
  rowGlobal s N BM BN idx.1 < M ∧ colGlobal s N BN idx.2.1 < N

name: ffInvariant
text:
noncomputable def ffInvariant (A W1 W3 RMS : RegionName) (s0 : BlockState)
    (M N BM BN BK sam sak sw1k sw1n sw3k sw3n srms numKBlocks : Nat)
    (c : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  s.pids = s0.pids ∧ c ≤ numKBlocks ∧
  (s.regs .nat [] "pid_m" = some (Tile.scalar (pidM (s0.pids 0) N BN))) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [] "pid_n" = some (Tile.scalar (pidN (s0.pids 0) N BN))) ∧
  (s.regs .real [BM, BN] "acc1" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BM, BN] =>
      some (accPartial s0 A W1 RMS M N BM BN sam sak sw1k sw1n srms BK idx.1 idx.2.1 c)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .real [BM, BN] "acc2" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BM, BN] =>
      some (accPartial s0 A W3 RMS M N BM BN sam sak sw3k sw3n srms BK idx.1 idx.2.1 c)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .real [BM, BK] "a_sum" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BM, BK] =>
      some (aSumPartial s0 A M N BM BN sam sak BK idx.1 idx.2.1 c)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .ptr [BM, BK] "a_ptrs" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BM, BK] =>
      (A.cast, rowIndex s0 M N BM BN idx.1 * sam + idx.2.1.val * sak + c * BK * sak)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .ptr [BK, BN] "w1_ptrs" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BK, BN] =>
      (W1.cast, idx.1.val * sw1k + colIndex s0 N BN idx.2.1 * sw1n + c * BK * sw1k)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .ptr [BK, BN] "w3_ptrs" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BK, BN] =>
      (W3.cast, idx.1.val * sw3k + colIndex s0 N BN idx.2.1 * sw3n + c * BK * sw3k)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .ptr [1, BK] "rms_w_ptrs" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [1, BK] =>
      (RMS.cast, idx.2.1.val * srms + c * BK * srms)⟩) ∧
  (∀ rg o, s.undef rg o = 0) ∧ (s.mem = s0.mem)

name: Inputs
text:
def Inputs (s : BlockState) (A W1 W3 RMS : RegionName)
    (M N K BM BN BK sam sak sw1k sw1n sw3k sw3n srms : Nat)
    (xs : Fin (Mathematics.steps K BK) → Fin BM → Fin BK → ℝ)
    (rs : Fin (Mathematics.steps K BK) → Fin BK → ℝ)

text:
def Reads (bounds : RegionBounds) (s : BlockState) (A W1 W3 RMS : RegionName)
    (M N K BM BN BK sam sak sw1k sw1n sw3k sw3n srms : Nat) : Prop :=
  (∀ t < cdiv K BK, ∀ (i : Fin BM) (e : Fin BK),
    rowIndex s M N BM BN i * sam + (t * BK + e.val) * sak < bounds A) ∧
  (∀ t < cdiv K BK, ∀ (e : Fin BK) (j : Fin BN),
    (t * BK + e.val) * sw1k + colIndex s N BN j * sw1n < bounds W1) ∧
  (∀ t < cdiv K BK, ∀ (e : Fin BK) (j : Fin BN),
    (t * BK + e.val) * sw3k + colIndex s N BN j * sw3n < bounds W3) ∧
  (∀ t < cdiv K BK, ∀ e : Fin BK, (t * BK + e.val) * srms < bounds RMS)

name: gemvWbInv
text:
noncomputable def gemvWbInv
    (input_ptr lora_ptr out_ptr : RegionName) (lora_indices : Region .nat)
    (K split_n_length xm_stride xk_stride l0_stride lora_k_stride
      lora_n_stride cm_stride cn_stride BLOCK_N BLOCK_K : Nat)
    (s0 sorig : BlockState) (i : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  s.pids = s0.pids ∧ (BLOCK_N ∣ i) ∧
  s.regs .nat [BLOCK_K] "offset_k" = some (Tile.vec (fun k : Fin BLOCK_K => k.val)) ∧
  s.regs .nat [BLOCK_N] "offset_n" = some (Tile.vec (fun j : Fin BLOCK_N => j.val)) ∧
  s.regs .real [BLOCK_K] "tiled_a" =
    some (tiledA s0 input_ptr K xm_stride xk_stride BLOCK_K) ∧
  s.regs .ptr [] "b_ptr" =
    some (Tile.scalar (bPtrVal s0 lora_ptr lora_indices split_n_length l0_stride
      lora_k_stride)) ∧
  s.regs .ptr [] "c_ptr" =
    some (Tile.scalar (cPtrVal s0 out_ptr split_n_length cm_stride)) ∧
  s.readMem lora_ptr = s0.readMem lora_ptr ∧
  (∀ m : Fin split_n_length,
    s.readMem out_ptr (outOffG s0 split_n_length cm_stride cn_stride m.val)
      = if m.val < i then
          gemvSpec s0 input_ptr lora_ptr lora_indices K split_n_length
            xm_stride xk_stride l0_stride lora_k_stride lora_n_stride m.val
        else
          sorig.readMem out_ptr (outOffG s0 split_n_length cm_stride cn_stride m.val))

name: Implements
text:
def Implements (io : IntMasked2DKernelIO₂)
    (f : Nat → Nat → (Fin io.B → Int) → (Fin io.B → ℝ) → (Fin io.B → ℝ) →
      Fin io.B → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ A : FlatAlloc,
    A.Disjoint →
    A.regions = [io.in1, io.in2, io.mbuf, io.out] →
    (∀ r, r ∉ A.regions → A.extent r = 0) →
  ∀ pid₀ pid₁ : Nat,
    (∀ j : Fin io.B, io.mask pid₀ pid₁ j →
      io.read1 pid₀ pid₁ j < A.extent io.in1) →
    (∀ j : Fin io.B, io.mask pid₀ pid₁ j →
      io.read2 pid₀ pid₁ j < A.extent io.in2) →
    (∀ j : Fin io.B, io.mask pid₀ pid₁ j →
      io.readm pid₀ pid₁ j < A.extent io.mbuf) →
    (∀ j : Fin io.B, io.mask pid₀ pid₁ j →
      io.write pid₀ pid₁ j < A.extent io.out) →
  ∀ (bs : Fin io.B → Int) (xs ys : Fin io.B → ℝ) (s₀ : BlockState),
    s₀.pids 0 = pid₀ →
    s₀.pids 1 = pid₁ →
    s₀.undef = (fun _ _ => 0) →
    (∀ j : Fin io.B, io.mask pid₀ pid₁ j →
      s₀.readMem io.in1 (io.read1 pid₀ pid₁ j) = xs j) →
    (∀ j : Fin io.B, io.mask pid₀ pid₁ j →
      s₀.readMem io.in2 (io.read2 pid₀ pid₁ j) = ys j) →
    (∀ j : Fin io.B, io.mask pid₀ pid₁ j →
      s₀.readMemValue .int io.mbuf (io.readm pid₀ pid₁ j) = bs j) →
    ∃ s',
      exec (A.flattenKernel io.kernel.toAlgKernel) (A.flattenState s₀)
        = some s'
      ∧ (∀ j : Fin io.B, io.writeMask pid₀ pid₁ bs j →
          s'.readMem A.flat (A.addr io.out (io.write pid₀ pid₁ j))
            = f pid₀ pid₁ bs xs ys j)
      ∧ (∀ r' o',
          (r' ≠ A.flat ∨
            (∀ j : Fin io.B, io.writeMask pid₀ pid₁ bs j →
              o' ≠ A.addr io.out (io.write pid₀ pid₁ j))) →
          s'.mem r' o' = (A.flattenState s₀).mem r' o')

name: mdqInv
text:
noncomputable def mdqInv (s0 : BlockState) (a scales : RegionName)
    (b zeros : Region .nat) (NO_GROUPS : Bool)
    (M N K groupsize stride_am stride_ak stride_bk stride_bn
      stride_scales_g stride_scales_n stride_zeros_g stride_zeros_n
      BM BN BK GM : Nat) (i : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  i ≤ numPidK K BK
  ∧ s.mem = s0.mem
  ∧ s.pids = s0.pids
  ∧ s.regs .nat [] "bits" = some (Tile.scalar 4)
  ∧ s.regs .nat [] "infearure_per_bits" = some (Tile.scalar 8)
  ∧ s.regs .nat [] "pid_m" = some (Tile.scalar (pidM s0 M N BM BN GM))
  ∧ s.regs .nat [] "pid_n" = some (Tile.scalar (pidN s0 M N BM BN GM))
  ∧ s.regs .bool [BM, 1] "a_mask"
      = some (mdqAMask M BM (pidM s0 M N BM BN GM))
  ∧ s.regs .nat [BK] "shifter" = some (mdqShifter BK)
  ∧ s.regs .nat [BN] "zeros_shifter"
      = some (mdqZerosShifter BN (pidN s0 M N BM BN GM))
  ∧ s.regs .ptr [BN] "scales_ptrs"
      = some (mdqScalesPtrs scales stride_scales_n BN (pidN s0 M N BM BN GM))
  ∧ s.regs .ptr [BN] "zeros_ptrs"
      = some (mdqZerosPtrs zeros stride_zeros_n BN (pidN s0 M N BM BN GM))
  ∧ s.regs .ptr [BM, BK] "a_ptrs"
      = some (mdqAPtrs a stride_am stride_ak BM BK (pidM s0 M N BM BN GM) i)
  ∧ s.regs .ptr [BK, BN] "b_ptrs"
      = some (mdqBPtrs b stride_bk stride_bn BN BK (pidN s0 M N BM BN GM) i)
  ∧ s.regs .real [BM, BN] "accumulator"
      = some (mdqAccTile s0 a scales b zeros NO_GROUPS M groupsize stride_am
          stride_ak stride_bk stride_bn stride_scales_g stride_scales_n
          stride_zeros_g stride_zeros_n BM BN BK (pidM s0 M N BM BN GM)
          (pidN s0 M N BM BN GM) i)
  ∧ (NO_GROUPS = Bool.true →
      s.regs .real [BN] "scales"
        = some (mdqScalesTile s0 scales stride_scales_g stride_scales_n BN
            (pidN s0 M N BM BN GM) 0)
      ∧ s.regs .real [BN] "zeros"
        = some (mdqZerosTile s0 scales zeros stride_scales_g stride_scales_n
            stride_zeros_g stride_zeros_n BN (pidN s0 M N BM BN GM) 0))

/-- Under `NO_GROUPS` the group row is `0` at every step, so the loop-invariant
pre-load is exactly what every iteration needs. -/

name: i4Inv
text:
noncomputable def i4Inv (s0 : BlockState) (a bs : RegionName)
    (b bzp : Region .nat)
    (M N group_size stride_am stride_ak stride_bk stride_bn stride_bsk
      stride_bsn stride_bzpk stride_bzpn BM BN BK GM numKBlocks : Nat)
    (i : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  i ≤ numKBlocks
  ∧ s.mem = s0.mem
  ∧ s.pids = s0.pids
  ∧ s.regs .nat [] "pid_m" = some (Tile.scalar (pidM s0 M N BM BN GM))
  ∧ s.regs .nat [] "pid_n" = some (Tile.scalar (pidN s0 M N BM BN GM))
  ∧ s.regs .nat [BK] "offs_k" = some (i4Offs 0 BK)
  ∧ s.regs .nat [BN] "offs_bn"
      = some (i4WrapOffs (pidN s0 M N BM BN GM * BN) BN N)
  ∧ s.regs .ptr [BM, BK] "a_ptrs"
      = some (i4APtrs a M stride_am stride_ak BM BK (pidM s0 M N BM BN GM) i)
  ∧ s.regs .ptr [BK, BN] "b_ptrs"
      = some (i4BPtrs b N stride_bk stride_bn BN BK (pidN s0 M N BM BN GM) i)
  ∧ s.regs .real [BM, BN] "accumulator"
      = some (i4AccTile s0 a bs b bzp M N group_size stride_am stride_ak
          stride_bk stride_bn stride_bsk stride_bsn stride_bzpk stride_bzpn
          BM BN BK (pidM s0 M N BM BN GM) (pidN s0 M N BM BN GM) i)

/-- The loop combinator writes the induction variable before each iteration,
and `i4Inv` constrains no register named `"k"`. -/

name: matmulInvariant
text:
noncomputable def matmulInvariant
    (A B : RegionName) (s0 : BlockState) (BM BN BLOCK_K numKBlocks : Nat)
    (c : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  s.pids = s0.pids ∧ c ≤ numKBlocks ∧
  (s.regs .nat [] "pid_m" = some (Tile.scalar (s0.pids 0))) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [] "pid_n" = some (Tile.scalar (s0.pids 1))) ∧
  (s.regs .real [BM, BN] "accumulator" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BM, BN] =>
      some (accPartial s0 A B BM BN BLOCK_K idx.1 idx.2.1 c)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [BM] "offs_am" = some (Tile.vec (fun r : Fin BM => rowIndex s0 BM r))) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [BN] "offs_bn" = some (Tile.vec (fun j : Fin BN => colIndex s0 BN j))) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [BLOCK_K] "offs_k" = some (Tile.vec (fun e : Fin BLOCK_K => e.val))) ∧
  (s.regs .ptr [BM, BLOCK_K] "a_ptrs" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BM, BLOCK_K] =>
      (A.cast, rowIndex s0 BM idx.1 * 4096 + idx.2.1.val * 1 + c * BLOCK_K)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .ptr [BLOCK_K, BN] "b_ptrs" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BLOCK_K, BN] =>
      (B.cast, idx.1.val * 4096 + colIndex s0 BN idx.2.1 * 1 + c * BLOCK_K * 4096)⟩) ∧
  (∀ rg o, s.undef rg o = 0) ∧ (s.mem = s0.mem)

/-- **preLoop scalars** (statements 0–4): `pid_m`, `pid_n`, and the 3 index
vectors `offs_am` / `offs_bn` / `offs_k`. -/

name: matmulSafeInv
text:

    (c : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=

  (s.regs .nat [] "pid_m" = some (Tile.scalar (s0.pids 0))) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [] "pid_n" = some (Tile.scalar (s0.pids 1))) ∧
  (∃ zT : Tile .real [BM, BN], s.regs .real [BM, BN] "accumulator" = some zT) ∧
  (s.regs .ptr [BM, BLOCK_K] "a_ptrs" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BM, BLOCK_K] =>
      (A.cast, rowIndex s0 BM idx.1 * 4096 + idx.2.1.val * 1 + c * BLOCK_K)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .ptr [BLOCK_K, BN] "b_ptrs" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BLOCK_K, BN] =>
      (B.cast, idx.1.val * 4096 + colIndex s0 BN idx.2.1 * 1 + c * BLOCK_K * 4096)⟩)

name: mlrInvariant
text:
noncomputable def mlrInvariant
    (A B : RegionName) (s0 : BlockState)
    (PM PN M N BM BN SAM SAK SBK SBN BLOCK_K numKBlocks : Nat)
    (c : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  s.pids = s0.pids ∧ c ≤ numKBlocks ∧
  (s.regs .real [BM, BN] "accumulator" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BM, BN] =>
      some (accPartial s0 A B PM PN BM BN M N SAM SAK SBK SBN BLOCK_K idx.1 idx.2.1 c)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [] "pid_m" = some (Tile.scalar PM)) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [] "pid_n" = some (Tile.scalar PN)) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [BM] "offs_am" = some (Tile.vec (fun i : Fin BM => (PM * BM + i.val) % M))) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [BN] "offs_bn" = some (Tile.vec (fun j : Fin BN => (PN * BN + j.val) % N))) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [BLOCK_K] "offs_k" = some (Tile.vec (fun e : Fin BLOCK_K => e.val))) ∧
  (s.regs .ptr [BM, BLOCK_K] "a_ptrs" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BM, BLOCK_K] =>
      (A.cast, (PM * BM + idx.1.val) % M * SAM + idx.2.1.val * SAK + c * BLOCK_K * SAK)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .ptr [BLOCK_K, BN] "b_ptrs" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BLOCK_K, BN] =>
      (B.cast, idx.1.val * SBK + (PN * BN + idx.2.1.val) % N * SBN + c * BLOCK_K * SBK)⟩) ∧
  (∀ rg o, s.undef rg o = 0) ∧ (s.mem = s0.mem)

name: Contiguous
text:
def Contiguous (block : Nat) (v : Nat → Int) : Prop :=
  ∀ lane, lane < block → v lane = v 0 + (lane : Int)

name: Aligned
text:

  v 0 % (block : Int) = 0

name: TilePromises
text:
def TilePromises (block : Nat) (v : Nat → Int) : Prop :=
  0 < block ∧ Aligned block v ∧ Contiguous block v

name: Fits
text: def Fits (value : Int) : Prop := -(2147483648 : Int) ≤ value ∧ value < 2147483648

name: Exact
text: def Exact (value : BitVec 32) (math : Int) : Prop := value.toInt = math

name: RecordedCompileProfile
text:
def RecordedCompileProfile (p : Parameters) (storage : TypedSource.Storage)
    (warps pipelineStages : Nat) : Prop :=
  p.BM = 128 ∧ p.BN = 256 ∧ p.BK = blockK storage ∧ p.GM = 8 ∧ p.SMS = 132 ∧
    warps = 8 ∧ pipelineStages = stages storage

name: ArangeChecks
text:
def ArangeChecks (n : Nat) : Prop :=
  0 < n ∧ n < 2^32 ∧ (∃ k : Nat, n = 2^k)

/-- Numeric checks read from installed Triton 3.7.1: power-of-two block
dimensions, 2^20 tensor-element cap and sm90 dot minimum K of 16/32. -/

name: FrontendChecks
text:
def FrontendChecks (p : Parameters) (storage : TypedSource.Storage) (warps : Nat) : Prop :=
  ArangeChecks p.BM ∧ ArangeChecks p.BN ∧ ArangeChecks p.BK ∧
    p.BM*p.BK ≤ 1048576 ∧ p.BK*p.BN ≤ 1048576 ∧ p.BM*p.BN ≤ 1048576 ∧
    1 ≤ p.BM ∧ 1 ≤ p.BN ∧ (match storage with | .fp16 => 16 | .f8e4 => 32) ≤ p.BK ∧
    0 < warps ∧ (∃ k : Nat, warps = 2^k)

    (s t : BlockState) : Prop where
  output : ∀ q j, outputMask p (s.pids 0) q j →
    t.mem A.flat (A.addr p.C (outputWindow p (s.pids 0) q j)) =
      MemCell.real (expected p xs (s.pids 0) q j)
  input_a : ∀ r k, r < p.M → k < p.K →
    t.mem A.flat (A.addr p.A (r*p.sam+k*p.sak)) = MemCell.real (xs.a r k)
  input_b : ∀ k c, k < p.K → c < p.N →
    t.mem A.flat (A.addr p.B (k*p.sbk+c*p.sbn)) = MemCell.real (xs.b k c)
  frame : ∀ r o, Outside p A (s.pids 0) r o →
    t.mem r o = (A.flattenState s).mem r o

/-- A successful full-source run in one finite flat address space, independent
GEMM results on every assigned active output, original inputs and full frame.
The undef condition is the shared finite-allocation bridge's convention. -/

name: Implements
text:
def Implements (p : Parameters) (kernel : Kernel) : Prop :=
  ∀ (A : FlatAlloc) (s : BlockState) (xs : RealMath.Inputs),
    A.Disjoint → A.regions = [p.A,p.B,p.C] →
    (∀ r, r ∉ A.regions → A.extent r = 0) →
    s.undef = (fun _ _ => 0) → Launch p s →
    RealAccess.Bounds p A.extent → RealInput.Represents p xs s →
    ∃ t, exec (A.flattenKernel kernel) (A.flattenState s) = some t ∧ Results p A xs s t

name: Represents
text:
structure Represents (p : Parameters) (xs : RealMath.Inputs) (s : BlockState) : Prop where
  a : ∀ row k, row < p.M → k < p.K →
    s.mem p.A (row*p.sam+k*p.sak) = MemCell.real (xs.a row k)
  b : ∀ k column, k < p.K → column < p.N →
    s.mem p.B (k*p.sbk+column*p.sbn) = MemCell.real (xs.b k column)

name: Ready
text:
structure Ready (p : Parameters) (xs : RealMath.Inputs) (pid i : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop where
  fixed : Fixed p s
  ki : s.regs .int [] "ki" = some (Tile.scalar (phase p i : Int))
  tile : s.regs .int [] "tile_id" = some (Tile.scalar (tile p pid i : Int))
  coords : Coordinates p pid i s
  acc : s.regs .real [p.BM,p.BN] "accumulator" = some (accumulator p xs pid i)

name: Outside
text:
def Outside (p : Parameters) (pid : Nat) (r : RegionName) (o : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ q, q<work p pid → ∀ j,
    RealStore.active p (tileRow p pid q) (tileColumn p pid q) j →
    ¬(p.C=r ∧ RealStore.offset p (tileRow p pid q) (tileColumn p pid q) j=o)

name: Holds
text:
structure Holds (p : Parameters) (xs : RealMath.Inputs) (pid : Nat) (s₀ : BlockState)
    (i : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop where
  registers : RealLoopState.Holds p xs pid i s
  bound : i≤stop p pid
  input : RealInput.Represents p xs s
  frame : ∀ r o, Outside p pid r o → s.mem r o = s₀.mem r o

name: Fixed
text:
structure Fixed (p : Parameters) (s : BlockState) : Prop where
  count : s.regs .nat [] "k_tiles" = some (Tile.scalar (count p))
  rows : s.regs .nat [] "num_pid_m" = some (Tile.scalar (RealGroup.rows p))
  group : s.regs .nat [] "num_pid_in_group" = some (Tile.scalar (p.GM*RealGroup.columns p))
  lanes : s.regs .nat [p.BK] "offs_k_for_mask" = some (Tile.vec Fin.val)

name: Coordinates
text:
structure Coordinates (p : Parameters) (pid i : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop where
  row : s.regs .int [] "pid_m" = some (Tile.scalar (row p pid i : Int))
  column : s.regs .int [] "pid_n" = some (Tile.scalar (column p pid i : Int))
  a : s.regs .int [p.BM] "offs_am" = some (Tile.vec fun j =>
    (RealTiles.clamp p.M (RealStore.rows p (RealLoopState.row p pid i) j) : Int))
  b : s.regs .int [p.BN] "offs_bn" = some (Tile.vec fun j =>
    (RealTiles.clamp p.N (RealStore.columns p (RealLoopState.column p pid i) j) : Int))

/-- The invariant is indexed by the original flat source iteration. At a K
restart, the accumulator is already zero while coordinates may still describe
the preceding tile; the source setup, rather than a premise, replaces them. -/

name: Holds
text:
structure Holds (p : Parameters) (xs : RealMath.Inputs) (pid i : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop where
  fixed : Fixed p s
  ki : s.regs .int [] "ki" = some (Tile.scalar (previousK p i))
  tile : s.regs .int [] "tile_id" = some (Tile.scalar (FlatSchedule.previousTile p.SMS pid (count p) i))
  acc : s.regs .real [p.BM,p.BN] "accumulator" = some (accumulator p xs pid i)
  coords : phase p i ≠ 0 → Coordinates p pid i s

name: Injective
text:
def Injective (p : Parameters) : Prop :=
  Function.Injective (fun x : Fin p.M × Fin p.N => p.scm*x.1.val+p.scn*x.2.val)

name: active
text:
def active (p : Parameters) (row column : Nat) (i : TileIndex [p.BM,p.BN]) : Prop :=
  rows p row i.1 < p.M ∧ columns p column i.2.1 < p.N

name: FlatPreservesMemory
text:
def FlatPreservesMemory (kernel : Kernel) : Prop :=
  ∀ (A : FlatAlloc) (s : BlockState), A.Disjoint →
    (∀ r, r ∉ A.regions → A.extent r = 0) → s.undef = (fun _ _ => 0) →
    ∃ t, exec (A.flattenKernel kernel) (A.flattenState s) = some t ∧
      t.mem = (A.flattenState s).mem

name: matmulInvariant
text:
noncomputable def matmulInvariant
    (X Y Z : RegionName) (s0 : BlockState) (KS NS NB M N BLOCK_K numKBlocks : Nat)
    (i : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  let c := i / BLOCK_K
  s.pids = s0.pids ∧ i = c * BLOCK_K ∧ c ≤ numKBlocks ∧
  (s.regs .real [M, N] "z" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [M, N] =>
      some (accPartial s0 X Y KS NS NB M N BLOCK_K idx.1 idx.2.1 c)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [M] "m_offsets" = some (Tile.vec (fun r : Fin M => rowIndex s0 NS NB M r))) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [N] "n_offsets" = some (Tile.vec (fun j : Fin N => colIndex s0 NS NB N j))) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [BLOCK_K] "k_offsets" = some (Tile.vec (fun e : Fin BLOCK_K => e.val))) ∧
  (s.regs .ptr [M, N] "z_ptrs" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [M, N] =>
      (Z.cast, rowIndex s0 NS NB M idx.1 * NS + colIndex s0 NS NB N idx.2.1)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .ptr [M, BLOCK_K] "x_ptrs" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [M, BLOCK_K] =>
      (X.cast, rowIndex s0 NS NB M idx.1 * KS + idx.2.1.val + c * BLOCK_K)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .ptr [BLOCK_K, N] "y_ptrs" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BLOCK_K, N] =>
      (Y.cast, idx.1.val * NS + colIndex s0 NS NB N idx.2.1 + c * BLOCK_K * NS)⟩) ∧
  (∀ rg o, s.undef rg o = 0) ∧ (s.mem = s0.mem)

/-- **preLoop scalars** (statements 0–6): the 4 scalar offsets + the 3 index
vectors. Steps to a state with the `m_offsets`/`n_offsets`/`k_offsets`
readbacks the pointer chunk needs. -/

name: matmulSafeInv
text:
private def matmulSafeInv (X Y Z : RegionName) (s0 : BlockState)
    (KS NS M N BLOCK_K T : Nat) (i : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  let c := i / BLOCK_K
  i = c * BLOCK_K ∧ c ≤ T ∧
  (∃ zT : Tile .real [M, N], s.regs .real [M, N] "z" = some zT) ∧
  (s.regs .ptr [M, N] "z_ptrs" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [M, N] =>
      (Z.cast, rowIndex s0 NS N M idx.1 * NS + colIndex s0 NS N N idx.2.1)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .ptr [M, BLOCK_K] "x_ptrs" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [M, BLOCK_K] =>
      (X.cast, rowIndex s0 NS N M idx.1 * KS + idx.2.1.val + c * BLOCK_K)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .ptr [BLOCK_K, N] "y_ptrs" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BLOCK_K, N] =>
      (Y.cast, idx.1.val * NS + colIndex s0 NS N N idx.2.1 + c * BLOCK_K * NS)⟩)

set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000 in
/-- Weak `preLoop`: from an **arbitrary** state the prologue steps to a state
satisfying `matmulSafeInv … 0` (no clean-`undef` hypothesis; the value half of
`preLoop` is dropped). -/

name: matmulInvariant
text:
noncomputable def matmulInvariant
    (A B : RegionName) (s0 : BlockState) (M N BM BN GM SAM SAK SBK SBN BLOCK_K numKBlocks : Nat)
    (i : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  let c := i
  s.pids = s0.pids ∧ c ≤ numKBlocks ∧
  (s.regs .real [BM, BN] "accumulator" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BM, BN] =>
      some (accPartial s0 A B M N BM BN GM SAM SAK SBK SBN BLOCK_K idx.1 idx.2.1 c)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [BM] "offs_am" = some (Tile.vec (fun r : Fin BM => rowIndex s0 M N BM BN GM r))) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [BN] "offs_bn" = some (Tile.vec (fun j : Fin BN => colIndex s0 M N BM BN GM j))) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [BLOCK_K] "offs_k" = some (Tile.vec (fun e : Fin BLOCK_K => e.val))) ∧
  (s.regs .ptr [BM, BLOCK_K] "a_ptrs" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BM, BLOCK_K] =>
      (A.cast, rowIndex s0 M N BM BN GM idx.1 * SAM + idx.2.1.val * SAK + c * BLOCK_K * SAK)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .ptr [BLOCK_K, BN] "b_ptrs" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BLOCK_K, BN] =>
      (B.cast, idx.1.val * SBK + colIndex s0 M N BM BN GM idx.2.1 * SBN + c * BLOCK_K * SBK)⟩) ∧
  (∀ rg o, s.undef rg o = 0) ∧ (s.mem = s0.mem)

/-- The 15-statement prologue (grouped-pid scheduling + pointer seeding + zero
init), transcribed at the algorithm layer. -/

name: active
text:
def active (s0 : BlockState) (M N BM BN GM : Nat) (idx : TileIndex [BM, BN]) : Prop :=
  rowIndex s0 M N BM BN GM idx.1 < M ∧ colIndex s0 M N BM BN GM idx.2.1 < N

name: matmulTriton2SafeInv
text:
private def matmulTriton2SafeInv (A B : RegionName) (s0 : BlockState)
    (M N BM BN GM SAM SAK SBK SBN BK T : Nat) (c : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  c ≤ T ∧
  (s.regs .nat [BM] "offs_am"
    = some (Tile.vec (fun i : Fin BM => rowIndex s0 M N BM BN GM i))) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [BN] "offs_bn"
    = some (Tile.vec (fun j : Fin BN => colIndex s0 M N BM BN GM j))) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [BK] "offs_k" = some (Tile.vec (fun e : Fin BK => e.val))) ∧
  (∃ zT : Tile .real [BM, BN], s.regs .real [BM, BN] "accumulator" = some zT) ∧
  (s.regs .ptr [BM, BK] "a_ptrs" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BM, BK] =>
      (A.cast, rowIndex s0 M N BM BN GM idx.1 * SAM + idx.2.1.val * SAK + c * BK * SAK)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .ptr [BK, BN] "b_ptrs" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BK, BN] =>
      (B.cast, idx.1.val * SBK + colIndex s0 M N BM BN GM idx.2.1 * SBN + c * BK * SBK)⟩)

set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000 in
/-- Weak `preLoop`: from an **arbitrary** state the prologue steps to a state
satisfying `matmulTriton2SafeInv … 0` (no clean-`undef` hypothesis; the value
half of `preLoop` is dropped). -/

name: matmulInvariant
text:
noncomputable def matmulInvariant
    (A B : RegionName) (s0 : BlockState) (M N BM BN GM sam sak sbk sbn BLOCK_K numKBlocks : Nat)
    (c : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  s.pids = s0.pids ∧ c ≤ numKBlocks ∧
  (s.regs .nat [] "pid_m" = some (Tile.scalar (pidM (s0.pids 0) M N BM BN GM))) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [] "pid_n" = some (Tile.scalar (pidN (s0.pids 0) M N BM BN GM))) ∧
  (s.regs .real [BM, BN] "accumulator" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BM, BN] =>
      some (accPartial s0 A B M N BM BN GM sam sak sbk sbn BLOCK_K idx.1 idx.2.1 c)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [BM] "offs_am" = some (Tile.vec (fun r : Fin BM => rowIndex s0 M N BM BN GM r))) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [BN] "offs_bn" = some (Tile.vec (fun j : Fin BN => colIndex s0 M N BM BN GM j))) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [BLOCK_K] "offs_k" = some (Tile.vec (fun e : Fin BLOCK_K => e.val))) ∧
  (s.regs .ptr [BM, BLOCK_K] "a_ptrs" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BM, BLOCK_K] =>
      (A.cast, rowIndex s0 M N BM BN GM idx.1 * sam + idx.2.1.val * sak + c * BLOCK_K * sak)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .ptr [BLOCK_K, BN] "b_ptrs" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BLOCK_K, BN] =>
      (B.cast, idx.1.val * sbk + colIndex s0 M N BM BN GM idx.2.1 * sbn + c * BLOCK_K * sbk)⟩) ∧
  (∀ rg o, s.undef rg o = 0) ∧ (s.mem = s0.mem)

/-- **preLoop scalars** (statements 0–11): the 9 L2-schedule scalars and the 3
index vectors `offs_am`/`offs_bn`/`offs_k`. -/

name: active
text:
def active (s0 : BlockState) (M N BM BN GM : Nat) (idx : TileIndex [BM, BN]) : Prop :=
  rowGlobal s0 M N BM BN GM idx.1 < M ∧ colGlobal s0 M N BM BN GM idx.2.1 < N

name: matmulAutotuneSafeInv
text:
private def matmulAutotuneSafeInv (A B : RegionName) (s0 : BlockState)
    (M N BM BN GM sam sak sbk sbn BK T : Nat) (c : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  c ≤ T ∧
  (s.regs .nat [] "pid_m" = some (Tile.scalar (pidM (s0.pids 0) M N BM BN GM))) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [] "pid_n" = some (Tile.scalar (pidN (s0.pids 0) M N BM BN GM))) ∧
  (∃ zT : Tile .real [BM, BN], s.regs .real [BM, BN] "accumulator" = some zT) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [BK] "offs_k" = some (Tile.vec (fun e : Fin BK => e.val))) ∧
  (s.regs .ptr [BM, BK] "a_ptrs" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BM, BK] =>
      (A.cast, rowIndex s0 M N BM BN GM idx.1 * sam + idx.2.1.val * sak + c * BK * sak)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .ptr [BK, BN] "b_ptrs" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BK, BN] =>
      (B.cast, idx.1.val * sbk + colIndex s0 M N BM BN GM idx.2.1 * sbn + c * BK * sbk)⟩)

set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000 in
/-- Weak `preLoop`: from an **arbitrary** state the prologue steps to a state
satisfying `matmulAutotuneSafeInv … 0` (no clean-`undef` hypothesis; the

name: assumptions
text: def assumptions : Spec.Assumptions FP.GuardedFragment := []

name: mv_kernel_general_prop
text:
abbrev mv_kernel_general_prop
    (A B C : RegionName)
    (N M stride_an stride_am stride_bm stride_cn BLOCK_N BLOCK_M : Nat)
    (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  (∃ alg, (mv_kernel A B C N M stride_an stride_am stride_bm stride_cn
      BLOCK_N BLOCK_M).toAlgorithm? = Except.ok alg) ∧
  ComputeCorrect.Realizes_without_Rounding
    (kernel := mv_kernel_one_block A B C N M stride_an stride_am stride_bm
      stride_cn BLOCK_N BLOCK_M)
    (initialState := s)
    (write := ComputeCorrect.WriteMap.writeIf
      (fun i : Fin BLOCK_N => nIndex s BLOCK_N i < N)
      (fun i => (C, cOffset s stride_cn BLOCK_N i)))
    (expected := fun i =>
      mvSpec s A B N M stride_an stride_am stride_bm BLOCK_N BLOCK_M i)

/-! ### ════════ ★ MAIN THEOREM ★ ════════ -/
/-- **Dimension-general public summary for `mv_kernel`.**

For symbolic dimensions `N M BLOCK_N BLOCK_M` and arbitrary strides, the full
matrix-vector surface lowers to the algorithm layer and its one-block slice
realizes the genuine input-only specification `mvSpec` (a masked row-wise
`Tile.reduceSum` of `A · B`), writing each active output row `i` of `C`.

The only hypothesis is the honest output-offset injectivity condition
`hOutInj`; there are no shape-specific assumptions. -/

name: assumptions
text: def assumptions : Spec.Assumptions FP.GuardedFragment := []

name: DimensionIO
text:
def DimensionIO (storage : Storage) (v : Bool) (inp ov oi : RegionName)
    (M N K BM BN : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ (A : FlatAlloc), A.Disjoint → A.regions = [inp,ov,oi] →
    (∀ r, r ∉ A.regions → A.extent r = 0) →
  ∀ (s : BlockState) (xs : TileIndex [BM,BN] → ℝ),
    s.undef = (fun _ _ => 0) →
    (∀ i : Fin BM, ∀ j : Fin BN, s.pids 0 * BM + i.val < M → j.val < N →
      (s.pids 0 * BM + i.val) * N * K + j.val * K + s.pids 1 < A.extent inp) →
    (∀ i : Fin BM, s.pids 0 * BM + i.val < M →
      maxKernelOutOffset s K BM i < A.extent ov) →
    (∀ i : Fin BM, s.pids 0 * BM + i.val < M →
      maxKernelOutOffset s K BM i < A.extent oi) →
    (∀ i : Fin BM, ∀ j : Fin BN, s.pids 0 * BM + i.val < M → j.val < N →
      s.readMem inp ((s.pids 0 * BM + i.val) * N * K + j.val * K + s.pids 1) =
        xs (i,j,PUnit.unit)) →
    ∃ t,
      exec (A.flattenKernel (dimensionSource storage v inp ov oi M N K BM BN).eraseDType.toAlgKernel)
        (A.flattenState s) = some t ∧
      (∀ i : Fin BM, s.pids 0 * BM + i.val < M →
        t.readMem A.flat (A.addr ov (maxKernelOutOffset s K BM i)) =
          rowMaximum M N BM BN (s.pids 0) xs i ∧
        t.readMemValue .int A.flat (A.addr oi (maxKernelOutOffset s K BM i)) =
          Int.ofNat (rowMaximumIndex M N BM BN (s.pids 0) xs i)) ∧
      (∀ r o, (r ≠ A.flat ∨ ∀ i : Fin BM, s.pids 0 * BM + i.val < M →
        o ≠ A.addr ov (maxKernelOutOffset s K BM i) ∧
        o ≠ A.addr oi (maxKernelOutOffset s K BM i)) →
        t.mem r o = (A.flattenState s).mem r o)

/-- Assembly uses the real execution of the entire source and the proved
flat-memory bridge; no output or precomputed reduction is assumed. -/

name: meanRowActive
text:
def meanRowActive (s : BlockState) (M BLOCK_M : Nat) (i : Fin BLOCK_M) : Prop :=
  meanOutOffset s BLOCK_M i < M

name: meanLoopInvariant
text:
def meanLoopInvariant
    (s0 : BlockState) (X : RegionName) (M N BLOCK_M BLOCK_N : Nat)
    (off : Nat) (st : BlockState) : Prop :=
  off % BLOCK_N = 0 ∧
    st.regs .real [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_N] "_mean" =
      some (meanMaskedAccumulatorSpec s0 X M N BLOCK_M BLOCK_N off)

name: mean_dim_kernel_correct_target
text:
def mean_dim_kernel_correct_target
    (X Mean : RegionName)
    (M N BLOCK_M BLOCK_N : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  ComputeCorrect.Realizes_without_Rounding
    (kernel := mean_dim_kernel X Mean M N BLOCK_M BLOCK_N)
    (initialState := s)
    (write := ComputeCorrect.WriteMap.writeIf
      (fun i : Fin BLOCK_M => meanOutOffset s BLOCK_M i < M)
      (fun i => (Mean, meanOutOffset s BLOCK_M i)))
    (expected := fun i => meanSpec s X N BLOCK_M i)

name: mean_dim_kernel_alg_post
text:
def mean_dim_kernel_alg_post
    (X Mean : RegionName)
    (M N BLOCK_M _BLOCK_N : Nat) (s s' : BlockState) : Prop :=
  ∀ i : Fin BLOCK_M,
    meanOutOffset s BLOCK_M i < M →
    s'.readMem Mean (meanOutOffset s BLOCK_M i) =
      meanSpec s X N BLOCK_M i

name: meanLoopContextInvariant
text:
def meanLoopContextInvariant
    (s0 : BlockState) (X Mean : RegionName) (M N BLOCK_M BLOCK_N : Nat)
    (off : Nat) (st : BlockState) : Prop :=
  meanLoopInvariant s0 X M N BLOCK_M BLOCK_N off st ∧
    st.regs .ptr [BLOCK_M, 1] "X" =
      some { data := fun idx : TileIndex [BLOCK_M, 1] =>
        (X, meanOutOffset s0 BLOCK_M idx.1 * N) } ∧
    st.regs .ptr [BLOCK_M, 1] "Mean" =
      some { data := fun idx : TileIndex [BLOCK_M, 1] =>
        (Mean, meanOutOffset s0 BLOCK_M idx.1) } ∧
    st.regs .bool [BLOCK_M, 1] "row_mask" =
      some { data := fun idx : TileIndex [BLOCK_M, 1] =>
        meanRowActive s0 M BLOCK_M idx.1 } ∧
    (∀ offset, st.readMem X offset = s0.readMem X offset)

name: meanReadActive
text:
def meanReadActive (M N BLOCK_M BLOCK_N p₀ t : Nat)
    (l : Fin (BLOCK_M * BLOCK_N)) : Prop :=
  p₀ * BLOCK_M + l.val / BLOCK_N < M ∧ t * BLOCK_N + l.val % BLOCK_N < N

/-- Output lane `i`'s terminal write address: `Mean + pid·BLOCK_M + i`. -/

name: meanWriteActive
text:
def meanWriteActive (M BLOCK_M p₀ : Nat) (i : Fin BLOCK_M) : Prop :=
  p₀ * BLOCK_M + i.val < M

/-- The guarded per-step summand of the stream spec: lane `(i, j)` of step
`t` contributes its streamed value inside the column window
`t·BLOCK_N + j < N`, and `0` outside (the kernel's `other=0.0`). -/

name: assumptions
text: def assumptions : Spec.Assumptions FP.GuardedFragment := []

name: active
msaInvariantAGS
text:
noncomputable def msaInvariantAGS
    (Q K V : RegionName) (Seqlens : Region .nat)
    (Blocks BlockOffsets ColCounts Cols : Region .nat) (Out : RegionName)
    (BM BN BD H NR NS NV : Nat)
    (scoreA : Nat → Fin BM → Fin BN → WithBot ℝ) (vblkA : Nat → Fin BN → Fin BD → ℝ)
    (qF : TileIndex [BM, BD] → WithBot ℝ) (kpF : TileIndex [BD, 1] → RegionName × Nat)
    (vpF : TileIndex [1, BD] → RegionName × Nat) (opF : TileIndex [BM, BD] → RegionName × Nat)
    (s0 : BlockState) (c : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  s.pids = s0.pids
  ∧ s.mem = s0.mem
  ∧ (∀ rg o, s.undef rg o = 0)
  ∧ s.regs .nat [] "start_m" = some (Tile.scalar (s0.pids 0))
  ∧ s.regs .nat [] "off_hz" = some (Tile.scalar (s0.pids 1))
  ∧ s.regs .nat [] "seqlen" = some (Tile.scalar (seqLen s0 H (Region.cast Seqlens)))
  ∧ s.regs .nat [BM] "offs_m" = some (Tile.vec (fun i : Fin BM => s0.pids 0 * BM + i.val))
  ∧ s.regs .nat [BN] "offs_n" = some (Tile.vec (fun j : Fin BN => j.val))
  ∧ s.regs .nat [BD] "offs_d" = some (Tile.vec (fun e : Fin BD => e.val))
  ∧ s.regs .nat [] "num_blks" =
      some (Tile.scalar (s0.readMemValue .nat (Region.cast Blocks)
        (s0.pids 1 * NR + s0.pids 0)))
  ∧ s.regs .nat [] "num_cols" =
      some (Tile.scalar (s0.readMemValue .nat (Region.cast ColCounts)
        (s0.pids 1 * NR + s0.pids 0)))
  ∧ s.regs .ptr [] "blks_ptr" =
      some (Tile.scalar (Region.cast BlockOffsets, (s0.pids 1 * NR + s0.pids 0) * NS))
  ∧ s.regs .ptr [] "cols_ptr" =
      some (Tile.scalar (Region.cast Cols, (s0.pids 1 * NR + s0.pids 0) * NV))
  ∧ s.regs FloatDType.fp16.toTileDType [BM, BD] "q" =
      some (⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BM, BD] =>
        FloatDType.real.cast FloatDType.fp16 (qF idx)⟩ : Tile FloatDType.fp16.toTileDType [BM, BD])
  ∧ s.regs .ptr [BD, 1] "k_ptrs" =
      some (⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BD, 1] => kpF idx⟩ : Tile .ptr [BD, 1])
  ∧ s.regs .ptr [1, BD] "v_ptrs" =
      some (⟨fun idx : TileIndex [1, BD] => vpF idx⟩ : Tile .ptr [1, BD])
  ∧ s.regs .ptr [BM, BD] "o_ptrs" =
      some (⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BM, BD] => opF idx⟩ : Tile .ptr [BM, BD])
  ∧ s.regs .bool [BM, 1] "m_mask" =
      some (⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BM, 1] =>
        decide (s0.pids 0 * BM + idx.1.val < seqLen s0 H (Region.cast Seqlens))⟩ : Tile .bool [BM, 1])
  ∧ s.regs .nat [] "max_num_blks" = some (Tile.scalar 8)
  ∧ s.regs .real [BM] "m_i" =
      some (⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BM] => msaMPartial BM BN scoreA c idx.1⟩ : Tile .real [BM])
  ∧ s.regs .real [BM] "l_i" =
      some (⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BM] =>
        (some (msaLPartial BM BN scoreA c idx.1) : WithBot ℝ)⟩ : Tile .real [BM])
  ∧ s.regs .real [BM, BD] "acc" =
      some (⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BM, BD] =>
        (some (msaOPartial BM BN BD scoreA vblkA c idx.1 idx.2.1) : WithBot ℝ)⟩
          : Tile .real [BM, BD])

/-- Symbolic Loop-B invariant. -/

name: msaInvariantBGS
text:
noncomputable def msaInvariantBGS
    (Q K V : RegionName) (Seqlens : Region .nat)
    (Blocks BlockOffsets ColCounts Cols : Region .nat) (Out : RegionName)
    (BM BN BD H NR NS NV : Nat)
    (scoreB : Nat → Fin BM → Fin BN → WithBot ℝ) (vblkB : Nat → Fin BN → Fin BD → ℝ)
    (mA : Fin BM → WithBot ℝ) (lA : Fin BM → ℝ) (oA : Fin BM → Fin BD → ℝ)
    (qF : TileIndex [BM, BD] → WithBot ℝ) (kpF : TileIndex [BD, 1] → RegionName × Nat)
    (vpF : TileIndex [1, BD] → RegionName × Nat) (opF : TileIndex [BM, BD] → RegionName × Nat)
    (s0 : BlockState) (c : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  s.pids = s0.pids
  ∧ s.mem = s0.mem
  ∧ (∀ rg o, s.undef rg o = 0)
  ∧ s.regs .nat [] "start_m" = some (Tile.scalar (s0.pids 0))
  ∧ s.regs .nat [] "off_hz" = some (Tile.scalar (s0.pids 1))
  ∧ s.regs .nat [] "seqlen" = some (Tile.scalar (seqLen s0 H (Region.cast Seqlens)))
  ∧ s.regs .nat [BM] "offs_m" = some (Tile.vec (fun i : Fin BM => s0.pids 0 * BM + i.val))
  ∧ s.regs .nat [BN] "offs_n" = some (Tile.vec (fun j : Fin BN => j.val))
  ∧ s.regs .nat [BD] "offs_d" = some (Tile.vec (fun e : Fin BD => e.val))
  ∧ s.regs .nat [] "num_blks" =
      some (Tile.scalar (s0.readMemValue .nat (Region.cast Blocks)
        (s0.pids 1 * NR + s0.pids 0)))
  ∧ s.regs .nat [] "num_cols" =
      some (Tile.scalar (s0.readMemValue .nat (Region.cast ColCounts)
        (s0.pids 1 * NR + s0.pids 0)))
  ∧ s.regs .ptr [] "blks_ptr" =
      some (Tile.scalar (Region.cast BlockOffsets, (s0.pids 1 * NR + s0.pids 0) * NS))
  ∧ s.regs .ptr [] "cols_ptr" =
      some (Tile.scalar (Region.cast Cols, (s0.pids 1 * NR + s0.pids 0) * NV))
  ∧ s.regs FloatDType.fp16.toTileDType [BM, BD] "q" =
      some (⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BM, BD] =>
        FloatDType.real.cast FloatDType.fp16 (qF idx)⟩ : Tile FloatDType.fp16.toTileDType [BM, BD])
  ∧ s.regs .ptr [BD, 1] "k_ptrs" =
      some (⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BD, 1] => kpF idx⟩ : Tile .ptr [BD, 1])
  ∧ s.regs .ptr [1, BD] "v_ptrs" =
      some (⟨fun idx : TileIndex [1, BD] => vpF idx⟩ : Tile .ptr [1, BD])
  ∧ s.regs .ptr [BM, BD] "o_ptrs" =
      some (⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BM, BD] => opF idx⟩ : Tile .ptr [BM, BD])
  ∧ s.regs .bool [BM, 1] "m_mask" =
      some (⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BM, 1] =>
        decide (s0.pids 0 * BM + idx.1.val < seqLen s0 H (Region.cast Seqlens))⟩ : Tile .bool [BM, 1])
  ∧ s.regs .nat [] "max_num_blks" = some (Tile.scalar 8)
  ∧ s.regs .nat [] "max_num_cols" = some (Tile.scalar 16)
  ∧ s.regs .real [BM] "m_i" =
      some (⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BM] =>
        msaSeedMax BM BN mA scoreB c idx.1⟩ : Tile .real [BM])
  ∧ s.regs .real [BM] "l_i" =
      some (⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BM] =>
        (some (msaLPartialSeed BM BN mA lA scoreB c idx.1) : WithBot ℝ)⟩ : Tile .real [BM])
  ∧ s.regs .real [BM, BD] "acc" =
      some (⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BM, BD] =>
        (some (msaOPartialSeed BM BN BD mA lA oA scoreB vblkB c idx.1 idx.2.1) : WithBot ℝ)⟩
          : Tile .real [BM, BD])

/-- Symbolic `q_ptrs` lane. -/

name: assumptions
text:
def assumptions : Spec.Assumptions FP.GuardedFragment := []

/-- The default fp32 backend profile retains explicit source-local fp64 loads.
No payload arithmetic or conversion is introduced for homogeneous storage. -/

name: RegionCopy
text:
def RegionCopy (storage : Storage) (version : Bool) (bounds : RegionBounds)
    (s : BlockState) (src dst : RegionName) (sm sn : Nat) : Prop :=
  FullReal.TileInjective sm sn ∧
  PayloadReal.RegionCopyContract (PayloadReal.carrier storage)
    (RealCandidate.algorithm storage version src dst sm sn) s src dst sm sn ∧
  (RealCandidate.algorithm storage version src dst sm sn).TraceSafe bounds s

/-- The complete flat-memory version retains translated cell types and the full
outside-footprint frame, with source access safety and native lane injectivity. -/

name: FlatCopy
text:
def FlatCopy (storage : Storage) (version : Bool) (A : FlatAlloc)
    (s : BlockState) (src dst : RegionName) (sm sn : Nat) : Prop :=
  FullReal.TileInjective sm sn ∧
  PayloadReal.FlatCopyContract (PayloadReal.carrier storage) A
    (RealCandidate.algorithm storage version src dst sm sn) s src dst sm sn ∧
  (RealCandidate.algorithm storage version src dst sm sn).TraceSafe A.extent s

name: footprint
FlatCopyContract
text:
def FlatCopyContract (payload : TileDType) (A : FlatAlloc) (program : Kernel) (s : BlockState)
    (src dst : RegionName) (sm sn : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ final, exec (A.flattenKernel program) (A.flattenState s) = some final ∧
    BlockState.WriteWithin (flatFootprint A (outputFootprint dst sm sn))
      (A.flattenState s) final ∧
    ∀ address, address < A.extent dst →
      final.mem A.flat (A.addr dst address) = A.trCell
        (CopyMath.expected (fun n ↦ storedCell payload (s.readMemValue payload src n))
          (s.mem dst) sm sn address)

/-- The library flattening bridge's zero-undef assumption is explicit; the
region-level source theorem has no such restriction. -/

name: RegionCopyContract
text:
def RegionCopyContract (payload : TileDType) (program : Kernel) (s : BlockState) (src dst : RegionName)
    (sm sn : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ final, exec program s = some final ∧
    BlockState.WriteWithin (outputFootprint dst sm sn) s final ∧
    final.mem dst = CopyMath.expected
      (fun address ↦ storedCell payload (s.readMemValue payload src address))
      (s.mem dst) sm sn

name: CopyInvariant
text:
structure CopyInvariant (payload : TileDType) (initial : BlockState) (src dst : RegionName)
    (sm sn count : Nat) (current : BlockState) : Prop where
  output : current.mem dst = CopyMath.expectedPrefix
    (fun address ↦ storedCell payload (initial.readMemValue payload src address))
    (initial.mem dst) sm sn count
  frame : ∀ r, r ≠ dst → current.mem r = initial.mem r

name: TileInjective
text:
def TileInjective (sm sn : Nat) : Prop :=
  Function.Injective (fun i : TileIndex [2,2] ↦ i.1.val * sm + i.2.1.val * sn)

name: FlatCopyContract
text:
def FlatCopyContract (A : FlatAlloc) (program : Kernel) (s : BlockState)
    (src dst : RegionName) (sm sn : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ final, exec (A.flattenKernel program) (A.flattenState s) = some final ∧
    BlockState.WriteWithin (flatFootprint A (outputFootprint dst sm sn))
      (A.flattenState s) final ∧
    ∀ address, address < A.extent dst →
      final.mem A.flat (A.addr dst address) = A.trCell
        (CopyMath.expected (fun n ↦ MemCell.of .int (s.readMemValue .int src n))
          (s.mem dst) sm sn address)
