are exactly the `m_prev = ⊥` / `l_prev = 0` / `acc = 0` preLoop inits. -/

name: taInvariantG
text:
noncomputable def taInvariantG
    (Q K V Out : RegionName) (s0 : BlockState) (sc : ℝ)
    (stride_hz_2d D0 BLOCK_M BLOCK_N BLOCK_DMODEL numKVBlocks : Nat)
    (i : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  let qS := s0.pids 0 * BLOCK_M
  let qT := fwdQTileG s0 Q stride_hz_2d BLOCK_DMODEL BLOCK_M BLOCK_DMODEL
  let kT := fwdKTileG s0 K stride_hz_2d BLOCK_DMODEL (BLOCK_N * numKVBlocks) BLOCK_DMODEL
  let vT := fwdVTileG s0 V stride_hz_2d BLOCK_DMODEL (BLOCK_N * numKVBlocks) BLOCK_DMODEL
  s.pids = s0.pids ∧ i % BLOCK_N = 0 ∧ i ≤ BLOCK_N * numKVBlocks ∧
  (s.regs .real [BLOCK_M] "m_prev" = some ⟨fun r : TileIndex [BLOCK_M] =>
      mPartial BLOCK_N qS qT numKVBlocks kT sc (i / BLOCK_N) r.1⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .real [BLOCK_M] "l_prev" = some ⟨fun r : TileIndex [BLOCK_M] =>
      ((lPartial BLOCK_N qS qT numKVBlocks kT sc (i / BLOCK_N) r.1 : ℝ) : WithBot ℝ)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .real [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_DMODEL] "acc" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_DMODEL] =>
      ((oPartial BLOCK_N qS qT numKVBlocks kT vT sc (i / BLOCK_N) idx
          / lPartial BLOCK_N qS qT numKVBlocks kT sc (i / BLOCK_N) idx.1 : ℝ) : WithBot ℝ)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .real [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_DMODEL] "q" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_DMODEL] => some (qT idx)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [BLOCK_M] "offs_m" = some (Tile.vec (fun r : Fin BLOCK_M => qS + r.val))) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [BLOCK_N] "offs_n" = some (Tile.vec (fun j : Fin BLOCK_N => j.val))) ∧
  (s.regs .blockPtr [BLOCK_N, BLOCK_DMODEL] "k_tile_ptr" = some
    (taKVPtrTileG K D0 BLOCK_N BLOCK_DMODEL (s0.pids 1 * stride_hz_2d + i))) ∧
  (s.regs .blockPtr [BLOCK_N, BLOCK_DMODEL] "v_tile_ptr" = some
    (taKVPtrTileG V D0 BLOCK_N BLOCK_DMODEL (s0.pids 1 * stride_hz_2d + i))) ∧
  (s.regs .blockPtr [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_DMODEL] "out_tile_ptr" = some
    (⟨fun _ : TileIndex [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_DMODEL] =>
      { region := Out, baseOffset := 0, parentShape := [D0, BLOCK_DMODEL],
        blockShape := [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_DMODEL], strides := [BLOCK_DMODEL, 1],
        offsets := [s0.pids 1 * stride_hz_2d + s0.pids 0 * BLOCK_M, 0] }⟩)) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [] "off_hz" = some (Tile.scalar (s0.pids 1))) ∧
  (∀ rg o, s.undef rg o = 0) ∧ (s.mem = s0.mem)

open VeriTile.Examples.FA1MathCausal in
/-- **General invariant base case.** At `c = 0` the running registers are
`mPartial 0 = ⊥`, `lPartial 0 = 0`, `oPartial 0 / lPartial 0 = 0 / 0 = 0`. -/

name: bwdInnerInvariantG
text:
noncomputable def bwdInnerInvariantG (base : Nat)
    (s0 : BlockState) (Q K V DO M Delta DQ : RegionName)
    (BM BD D0 NCTX n num_block : Nat) (sc : ℝ)
    (i : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  s.pids = s0.pids ∧ i % BM = 0 ∧ n * BM ≤ i ∧ i ≤ num_block * BM ∧
  (∀ R o, R ≠ DQ → s.mem R o = s0.mem R o) ∧
  (∀ I e : Nat, I < num_block * BM → e < BD →
    s.readMem DQ (base + I * BD + e)
      = s0.readMem DQ (base + I * BD + e)
        + (if n * BM ≤ I ∧ I < i then bwdDqKeyContrib base s0 Q K V DO M Delta BM BD NCTX sc n I e else 0)) ∧
  (∀ rg o, s.undef rg o = 0) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [BM] "offs_m" = some (Tile.vec (fun iL : Fin BM => iL.val))) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [BM] "offs_n" = some (Tile.vec (fun j : Fin BM => n * BM + j.val))) ∧
  (s.regs .blockPtr [BM, BD] "q_tile_ptr" = some (bwdPtrTileG Q (base) D0 BM BD i)) ∧
  (s.regs .blockPtr [BM, BD] "do_tile_ptr" = some (bwdPtrTileG DO (base) D0 BM BD i)) ∧
  (s.regs .blockPtr [BM, BD] "dq_tile_ptr" = some (bwdPtrTileG DQ (base) D0 BM BD i)) ∧
  (s.regs .real [BM, BD] "k"
    = some (⟨fun ij : TileIndex [BM, BD] => some (bwdKernelKG base s0 K BD (n * BM + ij.1.val) ij.2.1.val)⟩)) ∧
  (s.regs .real [BM, BD] "v"
    = some (⟨fun ij : TileIndex [BM, BD] => some (bwdKernelVG base s0 V BD (n * BM + ij.1.val) ij.2.1.val)⟩)) ∧
  (s.regs .real [BM, BD] "dv"
    = some (⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BM, BD] =>
        some (bwdAccDvCell base s0 Q K M DO BM BD NCTX sc n (i / BM - n) idx.1.val idx.2.1.val)⟩)) ∧
  (s.regs .real [BM, BD] "dk"
    = some (⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BM, BD] =>
        some (bwdAccDkCell base s0 Q K V DO M Delta BM BD NCTX sc n (i / BM - n) idx.1.val idx.2.1.val)⟩)) ∧
  (s.regs .ptr [] "m_ptrs" = some (Tile.scalar (M, s0.pids 0 * NCTX))) ∧
  (s.regs .ptr [] "D_ptrs" = some (Tile.scalar (Delta, s0.pids 0 * NCTX))) ∧
  (∃ t, s.regs .ptr [BM, BD] "dq_ptrs" = some t)

/-- **`dv` accumulator recurrence.** At query block `n+t` (counter `(n+t)·BM`) and
KV block `n`, `bwdInnerDvG` folds the block-`(n+t)` sub-sum onto the running
accumulator tile, advancing `bwdAccDvCell` from `t` to `t+1`. -/

name: bwdOuterInvariantG
text:
private def bwdOuterInvariantG (H stride_qz stride_qh : Nat) (base : Nat)
    (s : BlockState) (Q K V DO DQ DK DV M Delta : RegionName)
    (BM BD D0 nb : Nat) (sc : ℝ) (n : Nat) (st : BlockState) : Prop :=
  st.pids = s.pids ∧ (∀ rg o, st.undef rg o = 0) ∧
  (∀ J e : Nat, J < n * BM → e < BD →
    st.mem DV (base + J * BD + e)
      = MemCell.of .fp16 (FloatDType.real.cast FloatDType.fp16
          (some (∑ I : Fin (BM * nb),
            bwdFp16 (bwdKernelPG base s Q K M BD (BM * nb) sc I.val J) * bwdKernelDOG base s DO BD I.val e)))) ∧
  (∀ J e : Nat, J < n * BM → e < BD →
    st.mem DK (base + J * BD + e)
      = MemCell.of .fp16 (FloatDType.real.cast FloatDType.fp16
          (some (∑ I : Fin (BM * nb),
            bwdFp16 (bwdKernelDSG base s Q K V DO M Delta BD (BM * nb) sc I.val J) * bwdKernelQG base s Q BD I.val e)))) ∧
  (∀ J e : Nat, J ≥ n * BM → J < nb * BM → e < BD →
    st.mem DV (base + J * BD + e) = s.mem DV (base + J * BD + e)) ∧
  (∀ J e : Nat, J ≥ n * BM → J < nb * BM → e < BD →
    st.mem DK (base + J * BD + e) = s.mem DK (base + J * BD + e)) ∧
  (∀ I e : Nat, I < nb * BM → e < BD →
    st.readMem DQ (base + I * BD + e)
      = s.readMem DQ (base + I * BD + e)
        + (∑ n' ∈ Finset.range n, ∑ jL : Fin BM,
            bwdFp16 (bwdKernelDSG base s Q K V DO M Delta BD (BM * nb) sc I (n' * BM + jL.val)) *
              bwdKernelKG base s K BD (n' * BM + jL.val) e)) ∧
  (∀ (R' : RegionName) (o : Nat), R' ≠ DV → R' ≠ DK → R' ≠ DQ → st.mem R' o = s.mem R' o) ∧
  st.regs .blockPtr [BM, BD] "k_tile_ptr" = some (bwdPtrTileG K (base) D0 BM BD (n * BM)) ∧
  st.regs .blockPtr [BM, BD] "v_tile_ptr" = some (bwdPtrTileG V (base) D0 BM BD (n * BM)) ∧
  st.regs .blockPtr [BM, BD] "dk_tile_ptr" = some (bwdPtrTileG DK (base) D0 BM BD (n * BM)) ∧
  st.regs .blockPtr [BM, BD] "dv_tile_ptr" = some (bwdPtrTileG DV (base) D0 BM BD (n * BM)) ∧
  st.regs .nat [] "off_hz" = some (Tile.scalar (s.pids 0)) ∧
  st.regs .nat [] "off_z" = some (Tile.scalar (s.pids 0 / H)) ∧
  st.regs .nat [] "off_h" = some (Tile.scalar (s.pids 0 % H)) ∧
  st.regs .nat [] "stride_qz_2d" = some (Tile.scalar (stride_qz / BD)) ∧
  st.regs .nat [] "stride_qh_2d" = some (Tile.scalar (stride_qh / BD))

set_option maxHeartbeats 16000000 in
set_option maxRecDepth 8000 in
/-- **Multi-block backward exec** (dimension-general). Running `_bwd_kernel` at
contiguous strides `[BD,1]` with symbolic `stride_qz`, `stride_qh`, `H` and
`N_CTX = BM·nb`, from a clean honest state reaches a final state whose `DV`/`DK`
memory (fp16 `MemCell` level) holds the genuine general column sums at every key
row, and whose `DQ` memory (real) holds `bwdKernelDQSpecG`. Driven by the outer
`forRange_inv` over KV blocks `start_n ∈ [0, nb)` with `bwdOuterInvariantG`. -/

name: inMask
text:
def inMask (s0 : BlockState)
    (batch_dim in_height in_width OH OW BHW IGD SH SW PH PW : Nat)
    (h w c : Nat) (i : Fin BHW) (e : Fin BIN) : Prop :=
  ((((batchIdx s0 OH OW BHW i < batch_dim ∧ c + e.val < IGD) ∧
      (0 : Int) ≤ inHeightOff s0 OH OW BHW SH PH h i) ∧
      inHeightOff s0 OH OW BHW SH PH h i < (in_height : Int)) ∧
      (0 : Int) ≤ inWidthOff s0 OW BHW SW PW w i) ∧
      inWidthOff s0 OW BHW SW PW w i < (in_width : Int)

name: wMask
text:
def wMask (s0 : BlockState) (IGD OGD OF c : Nat) (e : Fin BIN) (j : Fin OF) : Prop :=
  c + e.val < IGD ∧ featIdx s0 OF j < OGD

name: ConvCtx
text:
structure ConvCtx (s0 : BlockState) (Input Weight : RegionName)
    (BHW BIN OF batch_dim out_height out_width
      IBS IIFS WOFS OH OW IGD OGD : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop where
  pids : s.pids = s0.pids
  undef : ∀ rg o, s.undef rg o = 0
  mem : s.mem = s0.mem
  group_pid : s.regs .nat [] "group_pid" = some (Tile.scalar (s0.pids 2))
  in_group_dim : s.regs .nat [] "in_group_dim" = some (Tile.scalar IGD)
  out_group_dim : s.regs .nat [] "out_group_dim" = some (Tile.scalar OGD)
  batch_offset : s.regs .nat [BHW] "batch_offset" =
    some (Tile.vec (fun i : Fin BHW => batchIdx s0 OH OW BHW i))
  output_height_offset : s.regs .nat [BHW] "output_height_offset" =
    some (Tile.vec (fun i : Fin BHW => heightIdx s0 OH OW BHW i))
  output_width_offset : s.regs .nat [BHW] "output_width_offset" =
    some (Tile.vec (fun i : Fin BHW => widthIdx s0 OW BHW i))
  output_feat_offset : s.regs .nat [OF] "output_feat_offset" =
    some (Tile.vec (fun j : Fin OF => featIdx s0 OF j))
  inputReg : s.regs .ptr [BHW, 1] "Input" =
    some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BHW, 1] => (Input.cast, inputBase s0 IBS IIFS OH OW BHW IGD idx.1)⟩
  weightReg : s.regs .ptr [1, OF] "Weight" =
    some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [1, OF] => (Weight.cast, weightBase s0 WOFS OF OGD idx.2.1)⟩

/-- The fp16 round-trip on a loaded `.real` tile is the identity: casting the
tile to `.fp16` then reading it back through `castFloat .fp16 .real` recovers the
original cell values (the in-model fp16 cast is the identity). -/

name: convCInv
text:
noncomputable def convCInv
    (s0 : BlockState) (Input Weight : RegionName)
    (BHW BIN OF batch_dim in_height in_width
      IBS IIFS IHS IWS WOFS WIFS WHS WWS OBS OOFS OHS OWS OH OW IGD OGD SH SW PH PW : Nat)
    (hc wc : Nat) (accBase : Fin BHW → Fin OF → ℝ)
    (i : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  ConvCtx s0 Input Weight BHW BIN OF batch_dim 0 0 IBS IIFS WOFS OH OW IGD OGD s ∧
  i = i / BIN * BIN ∧ i ≤ IGD ∧
  s.regs .nat [] "h" = some (Tile.scalar hc) ∧
  s.regs .nat [] "w" = some (Tile.scalar wc) ∧
  s.regs .real [BHW, OF] "accum" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BHW, OF] =>
    some (accBase idx.1 idx.2.1
      + accC s0 Input Weight BHW BIN OF batch_dim in_height in_width
          IBS IIFS IHS IWS WOFS WIFS WHS WWS OH OW IGD OGD SH SW PH PW hc wc (i / BIN) idx.1 idx.2.1)⟩

/-- `readMem` is insensitive to a `Region.cast` on the region name. -/

name: convWInv
text:
noncomputable def convWInv
    (s0 : BlockState) (Input Weight : RegionName)
    (BHW BIN OF batch_dim in_height in_width
      IBS IIFS IHS IWS WOFS WIFS WHS WWS OBS OOFS OHS OWS OH OW IGD OGD SH SW PH PW numCBlocks : Nat)
    (hc : Nat) (accBaseH : Fin BHW → Fin OF → ℝ)
    (wCount : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  ConvCtx s0 Input Weight BHW BIN OF batch_dim 0 0 IBS IIFS WOFS OH OW IGD OGD s ∧
  s.regs .nat [] "h" = some (Tile.scalar hc) ∧
  s.regs .real [BHW, OF] "accum" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BHW, OF] =>
    some (accBaseH idx.1 idx.2.1
      + accW s0 Input Weight BHW BIN OF batch_dim in_height in_width
          IBS IIFS IHS IWS WOFS WIFS WHS WWS OH OW IGD OGD SH SW PH PW numCBlocks hc wCount idx.1 idx.2.1)⟩

set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000 in
/-- **Width-loop step**: one kernel-width iteration runs a full c-loop, advancing
`convWInv` by one width block (`accW … (wCount+1) = accW … wCount + accC …`). -/

name: convHInv
text:
noncomputable def convHInv
    (s0 : BlockState) (Input Weight : RegionName)
    (BHW BIN OF batch_dim in_height in_width
      IBS IIFS IHS IWS WOFS WIFS WHS WWS OBS OOFS OHS OWS OH OW IGD OGD SH SW PH PW KW numCBlocks : Nat)
    (hCount : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  ConvCtx s0 Input Weight BHW BIN OF batch_dim 0 0 IBS IIFS WOFS OH OW IGD OGD s ∧
  s.regs .real [BHW, OF] "accum" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BHW, OF] =>
    some (accH s0 Input Weight BHW BIN OF batch_dim in_height in_width
            IBS IIFS IHS IWS WOFS WIFS WHS WWS OH OW IGD OGD SH SW PH PW KW numCBlocks hCount idx.1 idx.2.1)⟩

set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000 in
/-- **Height-loop step**: one kernel-height iteration runs a full width loop,
advancing `convHInv` by one (`accH … (hCount+1) = accH … hCount + accW …`). -/

name: active
pInMask
text:
private def pInMask (pid₀ batch_dim in_height in_width OH OW BHW IGD SH SW PH PW
    h w c i e : Nat) : Prop :=
  ((((pBatch pid₀ OH OW BHW i < batch_dim ∧ c + e < IGD) ∧
      (0 : Int) ≤ pInH pid₀ OH OW BHW SH PH h i) ∧
      pInH pid₀ OH OW BHW SH PH h i < (in_height : Int)) ∧
      (0 : Int) ≤ pInW pid₀ OW BHW SW PW w i) ∧
      pInW pid₀ OW BHW SW PW w i < (in_width : Int)

name: pWMask
text:
private def pWMask (pid₁ IGD OGD OF c e j : Nat) : Prop :=
  c + e < IGD ∧ pFeat pid₁ OF j < OGD

name: pActive
ConvSafeCtx
text:
private structure ConvSafeCtx (pid₀ pid₁ pid₂ : Nat) (Input Weight : RegionName)
    (BHW OF OH OW IGD OGD IBS IIFS WOFS : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop where
  group_pid : s.regs .nat [] "group_pid" = some (Tile.scalar pid₂)
  in_group_dim : s.regs .nat [] "in_group_dim" = some (Tile.scalar IGD)
  out_group_dim : s.regs .nat [] "out_group_dim" = some (Tile.scalar OGD)
  batch_offset : s.regs .nat [BHW] "batch_offset" =
    some (Tile.vec (fun i : Fin BHW => pBatch pid₀ OH OW BHW i.val))
  output_height_offset : s.regs .nat [BHW] "output_height_offset" =
    some (Tile.vec (fun i : Fin BHW => pHeight pid₀ OH OW BHW i.val))
  output_width_offset : s.regs .nat [BHW] "output_width_offset" =
    some (Tile.vec (fun i : Fin BHW => pWidth pid₀ OW BHW i.val))
  output_feat_offset : s.regs .nat [OF] "output_feat_offset" =
    some (Tile.vec (fun j : Fin OF => pFeat pid₁ OF j.val))
  inputReg : s.regs .ptr [BHW, 1] "Input" =
    some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BHW, 1] =>
      (Input.cast, pInputBase pid₀ pid₂ IBS IIFS OH OW BHW IGD idx.1.val)⟩
  weightReg : s.regs .ptr [1, OF] "Weight" =
    some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [1, OF] =>
      (Weight.cast, pWeightBase pid₁ pid₂ WOFS OF OGD idx.2.1.val)⟩
  accum : ∃ accT : Tile .real [BHW, OF], s.regs .real [BHW, OF] "accum" = some accT

set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000 in
/-- **Weak preLoop**: from an *arbitrary* state the 14 prologue statements step
successfully to a `ConvSafeCtx` state. The value half of `conv2d_preLoop`
(clean `undef`, `mem = s.mem`, `accum = 0`) is dropped. -/

name: fmaInvariant
text:
noncomputable def fmaInvariant (A B biasR : RegionName) (s0 : BlockState)
    (M N BM BN GM sam sak sbk sbn BLOCK_K numKBlocks : Nat) (HAS_BIAS : Bool)
    (c : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  c ≤ numKBlocks ∧
  (s.regs .nat [BM] "m_offs" = some (Tile.vec (fun i : Fin BM => rowIndex s0 M N BM BN GM i))) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [BN] "n_offs" = some (Tile.vec (fun j : Fin BN => colIndex s0 M N BM BN GM j))) ∧
  (s.regs .real [BM, BN] "acc" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BM, BN] =>
      some (accPartial s0 A B biasR M N BM BN GM sam sak sbk sbn BLOCK_K HAS_BIAS idx.1 idx.2.1 c)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .ptr [BM, BLOCK_K] "A" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BM, BLOCK_K] =>
      (A.cast, rowIndex s0 M N BM BN GM idx.1 * sam + idx.2.1.val * sak + c * BLOCK_K * sak)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .ptr [BLOCK_K, BN] "B" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BLOCK_K, BN] =>
      (B.cast, idx.1.val * sbk + colIndex s0 M N BM BN GM idx.2.1 * sbn + c * BLOCK_K * sbk)⟩) ∧
  (s.mem = s0.mem)

/-- **preLoop scalars** (statements 0–12): the 8 L2-schedule scalars and the
index vectors `m_offs_untagged`/`n_offs_untagged`/`m_offs`/`n_offs`/
`k_range_offs`. -/

name: matmulInvariant
text:
noncomputable def matmulInvariant
    (A B : RegionName) (s0 : BlockState) (M N BM BN GM sam sak sbk sbn BLOCK_K numKBlocks : Nat)
    (c : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  s.pids = s0.pids ∧ c ≤ numKBlocks ∧
  (s.regs .nat [] "pid_m" = some (Tile.scalar (pidM (s0.pids 0) M N BM BN GM))) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [] "pid_n" = some (Tile.scalar (pidN (s0.pids 0) M N BM BN GM))) ∧
  (s.regs .real [BM, BN] "accumulator" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BM, BN] =>
      some (accPartial s0 A B M N BM BN GM sam sak sbk sbn BLOCK_K idx.1 idx.2.1 c)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [BM] "offs_am" = some (Tile.vec (fun r : Fin BM => rowIndex s0 M N BM BN GM r))) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [BN] "offs_bn" = some (Tile.vec (fun j : Fin BN => colIndex s0 M N BM BN GM j))) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [BLOCK_K] "offs_k" = some (Tile.vec (fun e : Fin BLOCK_K => e.val))) ∧
  (s.regs .ptr [BM, BLOCK_K] "a_ptrs" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BM, BLOCK_K] =>
      (A.cast, rowIndex s0 M N BM BN GM idx.1 * sam + idx.2.1.val * sak + c * BLOCK_K * sak)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .ptr [BLOCK_K, BN] "b_ptrs" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BLOCK_K, BN] =>
      (B.cast, idx.1.val * sbk + colIndex s0 M N BM BN GM idx.2.1 * sbn + c * BLOCK_K * sbk)⟩) ∧
  (∀ rg o, s.undef rg o = 0) ∧ (s.mem = s0.mem)

set_option maxHeartbeats 4000000 in
/-- **preLoop scalars** (statements 0–17): the 9 L2-schedule scalars, the
`start_m`/`start_n` scalars, and the clamped index vectors
`offs_am`/`offs_bn`/`offs_k` (through the `tl.where` clamps and the DSL-erased
`tl.max_contiguous` identity reassignments). -/

name: active
text:
def active (s0 : BlockState) (M N BM BN GM : Nat) (idx : TileIndex [BM, BN]) : Prop :=
  rowGlobal s0 M N BM BN GM idx.1 < M ∧ colGlobal s0 M N BM BN GM idx.2.1 < N

name: matmulSafeInv
text:
private def matmulSafeInv (A B : RegionName) (s0 : BlockState)
    (M N BM BN GM sam sak sbk sbn BK T : Nat) (c : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop :=
  c ≤ T ∧
  (s.regs .nat [] "pid_m" = some (Tile.scalar (pidM (s0.pids 0) M N BM BN GM))) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [] "pid_n" = some (Tile.scalar (pidN (s0.pids 0) M N BM BN GM))) ∧
  (∃ zT : Tile .real [BM, BN], s.regs .real [BM, BN] "accumulator" = some zT) ∧
  (s.regs .nat [BK] "offs_k" = some (Tile.vec (fun e : Fin BK => e.val))) ∧
  (s.regs .ptr [BM, BK] "a_ptrs" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BM, BK] =>
      (A.cast, rowIndex s0 M N BM BN GM idx.1 * sam + idx.2.1.val * sak + c * BK * sak)⟩) ∧
  (s.regs .ptr [BK, BN] "b_ptrs" = some ⟨fun idx : TileIndex [BK, BN] =>
      (B.cast, idx.1.val * sbk + colIndex s0 M N BM BN GM idx.2.1 * sbn + c * BK * sbk)⟩)

set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000 in
/-- Weak `preLoop`: from an **arbitrary** state the prologue steps to a state
satisfying `matmulSafeInv … 0` (no clean-`undef` hypothesis; the value half
of `preLoop` is dropped). -/

multiplication site. Masked lanes still execute arithmetic and are included.
No positivity or nonzero condition is required of the input. -/

name: Bounds
text:
structure Bounds (y : RegionName) (N B pid : Nat) (bounds : RegionBounds) : Prop where
  output : ∀ f : Fin 4, ∀ j : Fin B, SourceDomain.outputIndex pid B f j < N →
    SourceDomain.outputIndex pid B f j < bounds y

name: Outside
text:
def Outside (A : FlatAlloc) (pid : Nat) (y : RegionName)
    (N B : Nat) (r : RegionName) (o : Nat) : Prop :=
  r ≠ A.flat ∨ ∀ f : Fin 4, ∀ j : Fin B, SourceDomain.outputIndex pid B f j < N →
    o ≠ A.addr y (SourceDomain.outputIndex pid B f j)

name: Implements
text:
def Implements (kernel : Kernel) (y : RegionName) (N B : Nat)
    (seed offset : Int) (lower upper : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ A : FlatAlloc, A.Disjoint → (∀ r, r ∉ A.regions → A.extent r = 0) →
  ∀ u : BlockState, N < 2^31 → u.pid < SourceDomain.grid N B →
    Random.IntegerType.i64.inRange seed = Bool.true →
    Random.IntegerType.i64.inRange offset = Bool.true →
    u.undef = (fun _ _ => 0) → FlatMemory.Bounds y N B u.pid A.extent →
    ∃ v, exec (A.flattenKernel kernel) (A.flattenState u) = some v ∧
      (∀ f : Fin 4, ∀ j : Fin B, SourceDomain.outputIndex u.pid B f j < N →
        v.mem A.flat (A.addr y (SourceDomain.outputIndex u.pid B f j)) =
          MemCell.real (Formula.expected B seed offset lower upper (SourceDomain.outputIndex u.pid B f j))) ∧
      (∀ r o, FlatMemory.Outside A u.pid y N B r o →
        v.mem r o = (A.flattenState u).mem r o)

name: LegalBlock
text: def LegalBlock (B : Nat) : Prop := ∃ k : Nat, k ≤ 20 ∧ B = 2^k

name: Captured
text:
structure Captured {B : Nat} (seed offset : Int) (i4 : TileIndex [B] → Nat)
    (s : BlockState) : Prop where
  seedValue : s.regs .int [] "__veritile_direct_random_0" = some (Tile.scalar seed)
  low : s.regs .int [B] "__veritile_direct_random_1" =
    some ⟨fun i => (counterLow offset (i4 i)).toNat⟩
  high : s.regs .int [] "__veritile_direct_random_2" =
    some (Tile.scalar (counterHigh offset).toNat)
  zero2 : s.regs .int [B] "__veritile_direct_random_3" = some ⟨fun _ => 0⟩
  zero3 : s.regs .int [B] "__veritile_direct_random_4" = some ⟨fun _ => 0⟩

name: Captured
text:

    (s : State α) : Prop where

  low : s.regs .int [B] "__veritile_direct_random_1" =

name: floatingFlatCopyContract
text:
def floatingFlatCopyContract (input output : Storage)
    (oldWidth lengthWidth newWidth : Metadata) (v : Bool) (A : FlatAlloc) (s : BlockState)
    (os ol ns : Region .int) (src dst : RegionName) (B : Nat) (length : Int)
    (oldStart newStart : Nat) : Prop :=
    ∃ final, exec (A.flattenKernel
        (typedKernel input output oldWidth lengthWidth newWidth v os ol ns src dst B).eraseDType.toAlgKernel) (A.flattenState s) = some final ∧
      BlockState.WriteWithin (flatFootprint A (footprint dst newStart length B))
        (A.flattenState s) final ∧
      (∀ n, n < Math.copiedLength length B →
        final.readMem A.flat (A.addr dst (newStart + n)) = s.readMem src (oldStart + n))

/-- Full signed-loop IO and frame for either source version. The oracle uses
initial source cells and the actual overcopy count, with no output premises. -/

name: discreteFlatCopyContract
text:
def discreteFlatCopyContract (storage : DiscreteSource.Storage) (v : Bool)
    (A : FlatAlloc) (s : BlockState) (os ol ns : Region .int) (src dst : RegionName)
    (B : Nat) (length : Int) (oldStart newStart : Nat) : Prop :=
    ∃ final, exec (A.flattenKernel
        (DiscreteSource.kernel storage v os ol ns src dst B).eraseDType.toAlgKernel) (A.flattenState s) = some final ∧
      BlockState.WriteWithin (flatFootprint A (footprint dst newStart length B))
        (A.flattenState s) final ∧
      (∀ n, n < Math.copiedLength length B →
        final.readMemValue storage.kind.dtype A.flat (A.addr dst (newStart + n)) = s.readMemValue storage.kind.dtype src (oldStart + n))

/-- Homogeneous integer and boolean payloads retain their exact typed carrier. -/

name: footprint
Inv
text:
structure Inv (k : Kind) (initial : BlockState) (src dst : RegionName)
    (B : Nat) (length : Int) (oldStart newStart c : Nat) (s : BlockState) : Prop where
  frame : BlockState.WriteWithin (footprint dst newStart length B) initial s
  input : ∀ o, s.mem src o = initial.mem src o
  pids : s.pids = initial.pids
  numPids : s.numPids = initial.numPids
  undef : s.undef = initial.undef
  lengthReg : s.regs .int [] "length" = some (Tile.scalar length)
  oldReg : s.regs .int [] "old_start" = some (Tile.scalar (oldStart : Int))
  newReg : s.regs .int [] "new_start" = some (Tile.scalar (newStart : Int))
  oldOffset : s.regs .nat [B] "old_offset" = some (Tile.vec fun i ↦ i.val)
  newOffset : s.regs .nat [B] "new_offset" = some (Tile.vec fun i ↦ i.val)
  values : ∀ t lane, t < c → lane < B → (lane : Int) < length →
    s.readMemValue k.dtype dst (newStart + (t * B + lane)) = initial.readMemValue k.dtype src (oldStart + (t * B + lane))

    {B : Nat} {length : Int} {oldStart newStart c : Nat}
    (h : Inv k initial src dst B length oldStart newStart c s) (index : Int) :
    Inv k initial src dst B length oldStart newStart c
      (s.setReg "i" .int [] (Tile.scalar index)) := by
  exact ⟨h.frame,h.input,h.pids,h.numPids,h.undef,
    by simpa using h.lengthReg, by simpa using h.oldReg, by simpa using h.newReg,
    by simpa using h.oldOffset, by simpa using h.newOffset,h.values⟩

 theorem Inv.mid {k : Kind} {initial s : BlockState} {src dst : RegionName}
    {B : Nat} {length : Int} {oldStart newStart c : Nat}
    (h : Inv k initial src dst B length oldStart newStart c s) :
    Inv k initial src dst B length oldStart newStart c
      (midState k (B := B) s src length oldStart (c * B : Nat)) := by
  exact ⟨h.frame,h.input,h.pids,h.numPids,h.undef,
    by simpa [midState] using h.lengthReg, by simpa [midState] using h.oldReg,
    by simpa [midState] using h.newReg, by simpa [midState] using h.oldOffset,
    by simpa [midState] using h.newOffset,h.values⟩

 theorem invariant_step (k : Kind) (initial s : BlockState) (os ol ns : Region .int)
    (src dst : RegionName) (B : Nat) (length : Int) (oldStart newStart c : Nat)
    (hB : 0 < B) (hc : c < Math.rounds length B) (hsd : src ≠ dst)
    (h : Inv k initial src dst B length oldStart newStart c s) :
    ∃ next, stepStmts (body k os ol ns src dst B)
        (s.setReg "i" .int [] (Tile.scalar (c * B : Nat))) = some next ∧
      Inv k initial src dst B length oldStart newStart (c + 1) next := by
  let indexed := s.setReg "i" .int [] (Tile.scalar (c * B : Nat))
  have hi : Inv k initial src dst B length oldStart newStart c indexed := h.setIndex _
  let middle := midState k (B := B) indexed src length oldStart (c * B : Nat)
  have hm : Inv k initial src dst B length oldStart newStart c middle := hi.mid
  let vals := value k (B := B) indexed src length oldStart (c * B : Nat)
  let next := scatter k middle dst newStart (c * B : Nat) length vals
  have hf := scatter_frame k middle dst newStart (c * B : Nat) length vals
  have hstate := scatter_state k middle dst newStart (c * B : Nat) length vals
  have hstart := (Math.loop_test length hB).mpr hc
  refine ⟨next, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact step k os ol ns src dst B indexed length oldStart newStart (c * B : Nat)
      hi.lengthReg hi.oldReg hi.newReg (by simp [indexed]) hi.oldOffset hi.newOffset
  · constructor
    · intro r o hout
      rw [hm.frame r o hout]
      apply hf r o
      rintro ⟨rfl,lane,hl,hL,ho⟩
      apply hout
      refine ⟨rfl,c * B + lane, (Math.touched_iff length hB).mp ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact ⟨c,lane,hstart,hl,hL,rfl⟩
      · omega
    · intro o
      exact (hf src o (by rintro ⟨he,_⟩; exact hsd he)).symm.trans (hm.input o)
    · exact hstate.2.1.trans hm.pids
    · exact hstate.2.2.1.trans hm.numPids
    · exact hstate.2.2.2.trans hm.undef
    · rw [hstate.1]; exact hm.lengthReg
    · rw [hstate.1]; exact hm.oldReg
    · rw [hstate.1]; exact hm.newReg
    · rw [hstate.1]; exact hm.oldOffset
    · rw [hstate.1]; exact hm.newOffset
    · intro t lane ht hl hL
      by_cases he : t = c
      · subst t
        let i : TileIndex [B] := (⟨lane,hl⟩,PUnit.unit)
        have hv := scatter_value k middle dst newStart (c * B : Nat) length vals i hL
        have hread : indexed.readMemValue k.dtype src (oldStart + (c * B + lane)) =
            initial.readMemValue k.dtype src (oldStart + (c * B + lane)) := by
          cases k <;> simp [Kind.dtype, BlockState.readMemValue, BlockState.readMemTyped, hi.input]
        simpa [next,vals,value,active,i,address_nat,hL,Nat.add_assoc] using hv.trans
          (show vals i = initial.readMemValue k.dtype src (oldStart + (c * B + lane)) by
            simpa only [vals,value,active,i,decide_eq_true_eq,if_pos hL,address_nat,Nat.add_assoc] using hread)
      · have htc : t < c := by omega
        have hmul := Nat.mul_le_mul_right B (show t + 1 ≤ c by omega)
        simp only [Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul] at hmul
        have hcell := hf dst (newStart + (t * B + lane)) (by
          rintro ⟨_,other,_,_,ho⟩
          omega)
        have hread : next.readMemValue k.dtype dst (newStart + (t * B + lane)) =
            middle.readMemValue k.dtype dst (newStart + (t * B + lane)) := by
          cases k <;> simp only [next, Kind.dtype, BlockState.readMemValue, BlockState.readMemTyped, ← hcell]
        exact hread.trans (hm.values t lane htc hl hL)
